name: kind
meaning: 0 selects the trigger path, non-zero the accumulate path. Read as a byte.

name: counterOffset
meaning: The byte offset of this achievement's counter within the achievement counter area at ImageBackedStateBlock +0x384C. The reader calls 0x002536A0, which returns *(void**)0x020927C0, the save buffer + 0x8200, so the area is that pointer + 0x384C. It is 0 and plays no part on the trigger path. The descriptors are an array at 0x00D10460 of 30 entries of 8 bytes, so the stride-8 indexing of this byte is that array being walked, not an array inside the field.

name: mode
meaning: On the trigger path, selects the test: 0 fires unconditionally through 0x003165C0, 1 requires the amount to equal the threshold, and any other value returns without firing.

name: pad03
meaning: The byte between mode +0x02 and threshold +0x04: 0 in all 30 image entries (0x00D10460 + 8 x i) and read by no instruction. No recorded access to the 30 entries and no rip-relative reference falls at 0x00D10463 + 8 x i, and the image-base-relative readers 0x00315E90 ([r15+r14*8+0xBF0462] / +0xBF0464), 0x003162E0 (lea rdx, [rax*8+0xBF0460], r13 = image base; +0 / +1) and 0x00316A50 (+0 / +2 / +4) take kind, counterOffset, mode and threshold only.

name: threshold
meaning: Compared against the caller's amount, and only on mode 1. The accumulate path never reads it.

name: appId
meaning: The dword the constructor stores from ISteamUtils (SteamApiContext +0x18) vtable slot +0x48 (0x0020C80A, 0x0020C80D mov dword [rsi], eax; first cleared to 0 at 0x0020C75D). Every handler compares it, sign-extended, with the callback record's qword +0x00 (0x0020C946, 0x0020C8C6, 0x0020CB20 movsxd rax, dword [rcx]) and ignores a record that differs. Every access is 32-bit and all three readers sign-extend it, so the code treats it as an int32. The name is the Steam SDK's (ISteamUtils slot 9, GetAppID), not the image's.

name: pad04
meaning: Alignment between appId +0x00 (a dword, 0x0020C75D / 0x0020C80D) and the entries pointer +0x08. The recorded accesses of the manager (22 functions through *(0x01F83450)) include no access here, and neither has any other manager-based body. The manager is allocated by operator new without a clear (0x00210EC0(0x80) at 0x0020CD30) and the constructor 0x0020C730 has no memset, so the bytes hold what the heap left.

name: entries
meaning: the entry array, stride 0x198

name: count
meaning: entry count (41)

name: achievedCount
meaning: achieved count

name: statsReceived
meaning: 0 from the constructor (0x0020C75F); set to 1 only by the 0x44D handler 0x0020C940 (0x0020C97F), after it has matched the record's game id against +0x000 and read the record's dword +0x08 as 1 (0x0020C955 / 0x0020C959). Read by 0x0020CE60 (0x0020CE8C), 0x0020CE10 (0x0020CE16), twice by 0x0020CB50 (0x0020CBD5, 0x0020CC42) and by 0x0020C940 itself (0x0020CABA, after its own 0x0020C97F store): while it is 0, 0x0020CE60 / 0x0020CE10 / 0x0020CB50 make no SteamApiContext +0x28 call - 0x0020CE60 and 0x0020CB50 have already set the entry's +0x190 byte to 1 and +0x194 to 0 by then (0x0020CE7B / 0x0020CE82; 0x0020CBC8 / 0x0020CBCF and, in the loop, 0x0020CC33 / 0x0020CC3B), and 0x0020CE60 / 0x0020CE10 return 0 in al (0x0020CED6 / 0x0020CE56). No other writer.

name: pad19
meaning: Alignment between statsReceived +0x18 (a byte, 0x0020C75F, read 0x0020CBD5 / 0x0020CC42 / 0x0020CE8C) and the three callback slots at +0x20. None of the manager's recorded accesses (22 functions) is here. The manager is allocated by operator new without a clear (0x00210EC0(0x80) at 0x0020CD30) and the constructor 0x0020C730 has no memset, so the bytes hold what the heap left.

name: callbacks
meaning: the three registered Steam callbacks: [0] id 0x44D -> 0x0020C940 (sets +0x018), [1] id 0x44E -> 0x0020CB20, [2] id 0x44F -> 0x0020C8C0; filled and registered by 0x0020C730, unregistered by 0x0020CD80 (and, slot by slot, by 0x0020C860/0x0020C880/0x0020C840 on a constructor unwind)

name: unlockedBits
meaning: One bit per achievement id 0..29, set when that achievement has fired. The same bytes are ImageBackedStateBlock +0x3844 (the fired bitmap), followed there by +0x3848 and the 32-byte counter area at +0x384C; this type is the finer decomposition of that part of the block, and the two descriptions agree field for field.

name: flagBitmap004
meaning: The second bitmap with one bit per achievement id. This type sits at ImageBackedStateBlock +0x3844 (its +0x00 unlockedBits is the parent's fired bitmap), so +0x04 is the parent's +0x3848 flagBitmap3848: the setter 0x00315B50 sets and clears bits with bts/btr (0x00315C9A/0x00315C9F) and stores the dword at 0x00315CA7, and the query 0x003156E0 tests them (0x00315752-0x00315755).

name: memberIndex
meaning: the member index i, the same index 0x0028F830 took: stored by the bar at claim (0x00299103-0x00299107, 0x002991B9, from the bar's creation argument +8) and by the party list's reset (0x0029C1EA); indexes the member records at 0x022C8060 + i x 0xC0 (0x00299172-0x00299182; 0x0035D320 returns 0x022C8060)

name: memberTypeCache
meaning: The member's type, cached: byte +0x80 of 0x022C8060 + i x 0xC0 = the type word +0x60 of the member's UnitStatusView at 0x022C8080 + i x 0xC0, stored at claim (0x002991CB-0x002991D3, 0x00299322-0x00299329) and compared with that word on each build (0x00299196-0x002991A2): a change zeroes the action-bar cell and refills it; 0xFF at the party list's reset (0x0029C1F2) and at the bar's (0x002991B5).

name: flags
meaning: bits 0x1 and 0x2 set by the bar's messages (0x00299333, 0x00299351), bit 0x1 cleared (0x00299369); bit 0x4 the action's name has been shown (0x002989FF set, 0x00298A1C cleared); bit 0x8 forced full while the record's flags hold 0x1100 (0x00298BFA set, 0x00298BE7 cleared), tested at 0x00298C6E and 0x00298D8A

name: shownActionId
meaning: the action id whose name was last shown, 0xFFFF at claim and reset (0x00299164, 0x002991C0, 0x00299317, 0x0029933F); written with the new id when the name is shown (0x0029894D); reset by the party list 0x0029BE50 (0x0029C1FA)

name: barAlpha
meaning: the bar's alpha ramp 0..0x80: +0x10 a frame while the bar shows (0x0029896E-0x00298982), -0x10 while it hides (0x002989A2-0x002989AD); 0x80 at once at 0x002993FB

name: nameAlpha
meaning: the action name's alpha ramp, -0x10 a frame to 0 (0x002989DF-0x002989E9); the only write is 0x002989E9, the only read 0x002989DF

name: colourTrackKey
meaning: the key of the four-key colour track the bar cycles: 0x400 (0x00298A2C) or 0x00274870's result (0x00298ADE); passed to 0x00271E50 as r8d (0x00298AEF)

name: state
meaning: 0 filling, 1 flashing (0x00298EA2), 2 fading (0x00298BCC, 0x00298C1C); the dispatch at 0x00298C2B-0x00298C46 (../Menus-And-HUD/party-list.md 'The action bar' steps 3-4)

name: flashFramesLeft
meaning: 8 when the flash starts (0x00298ECE), one less a frame while flashing (0x00298D76-0x00298D80); the flash ends at 0 (0x00298D99)

name: flashStartFrame
meaning: the frame counter 0x0208F570 when the flash started (0x00298EB7); the flash's sin((frame - start) x pi / 15) reads it (../Menus-And-HUD/party-list.md)

name: fadeCount
meaning: the fade count stepping by 0x10 to 0x100 in state 2 (0x00298C4C-0x00298C63); 0 when the flash starts (0x00298EFE)

name: fillAlpha
meaning: the fill's alpha ramp: +0x10 to 0x80 (0x00299029-0x0029903A) or -0x10 to 0 (0x00298D54-0x00298D5F) a frame; copied into the vertex colour at 0x00299045-0x00299049; 0x80 or al at 0x00298D5F

name: fillPercent
meaning: the fill percentage 0..100 (0x64 when the record's flags hold 0x1000, 0x002989C3; the computed pct at 0x00298F33; 0 at 0x00298AA7), -1 for no fill (0x0029918B, 0x002991BC, 0x00299313); feeds the gauge width at 0x00298F4D-0x00298F81; reset by the party list 0x0029BE50 (0x0029C1F6)

name: fillValue
meaning: the fill value stepped by 0x10 toward its target each frame (0x0029879F-0x002987B9: up while the record's action or command word is below 0x4000 and the flag tested at 0x0029879B holds, else down to 0); 0 at claim (0x002991E7); its low byte is read at 0x002987CE

name: stepCounter
meaning: a step counter 0..4 at the end of a fill: 0 when the flash starts or the fill restarts (0x00298ED9, 0x00298EE8), incremented a frame and clamped at 4 (0x00298F0A-0x00298F28)

name: pad18
meaning: Zeroed with the rest of the action-bar cell at claim (0x002991B1 mov qword [rcx+0x18], rax) and otherwise untouched (the bar's two bodies, read whole); reset by the party list 0x0029BE50 (0x0029C1E6).

name: elementMask
meaning: element bits: 0x01 Fire, 0x02 Lightning, 0x04 Ice, 0x08 Earth, 0x10 Water, 0x20 Wind (test byte [rcx+0x13],1 at 0x0038B295)

name: payload
meaning: Copied whole from the caller's rdx: 0x002BE97C-0x002BE988 sets r8d = 0x180 and calls the null-guarded copy 0x00254F30 with the entry as destination. 0x180 bytes move as one unit, which fixes the extent; the interior is untouched here: the allocator reads or writes no field inside it, so its contents are a separate question from this layout.

name: dword0180
meaning: Written from `mov eax, dword ptr [rsi]` - the third argument's first dword - at 0x002BE9C6/0x002BE9CF.

name: word0184
meaning: Written from a word taken off the stack at rsp+0x70 after the 0x0029CD00 call (0x002BE9BA/0x002BE9BF).

name: flags0186
meaning: A flag byte: bit 0x1 is set with `or byte ptr [rbx+0x186], 1` at 0x002BE9C8 as the entry is filled; the filler touches only that bit.

name: byte0187
meaning: Written as `sar eax, 1` of the dword the 0x0029CD00 call left at rsp+0x50: a halved value, stored byte-wide (0x002BE9AE-0x002BE9B4).

name: next
meaning: Forward link. The unlink at 0x002BE8F9-0x002BE93B reads it, hands it to the widget's free head, and repairs the neighbour through `mov qword ptr [rcx+0x188], rax` at 0x002BE934; both links are zeroed at 0x002BE93D/0x002BE944 when the entry is taken.

name: prev
meaning: Back link, the other half of the same unlink: read at 0x002BE913 and 0x002BE921 and repaired through `mov qword ptr [rcx+0x190], rax` at 0x002BE91A.

name: widgetBase0000
meaning: the shared widget base written by 0x002465F0 on every constructed object - handler at +0x00, flags at +0x40, and the rest specified in 16-UI/widgets.md. One row because this type adds nothing to it; the glyph-run page calls +0xC0 onward the widget's private area past the 0xC0 base. The consumers' writes at +0x40, +0x9C and +0x9E land in this base, not in this type's own area.

name: helpBlock
meaning: the help block, the active log's owner, the creation record's first qword (0x002BEF7D-0x002BEF87); the procedure reads it at 0x002BE501 and works the help block's +0x1078 and +0x1080 widgets through it (0x002BE61A-0x002BE674)

name: unobservedSpan00C8
meaning: Sixteen bytes between qword +0xC0 and the entry pool at +0xD8, zero from the widget initialiser memset (0x00244F50 / 0x002497B0, size 0x40C8). No recorded access of the widget reaches any byte of them. Its procedure 0x002BE4F0 (rbx = the widget from 0x002BE4FE, 22 message ids through a jump table) touches only the Widget header (+0x38, +0x98, +0x9C, +0x9E) and the tail words +0x40B0..+0x40B8. The builder 0x002BDCE0 stores the widget at parent +0x1058 and writes only +0x40B0 and +0x40B2, and the consumers 0x002BDB60, 0x002BDC00 and 0x002BDCA0 reach it through that pointer (displacement 0x1058 appears in seven functions of the image, six of them in this family). The forwarders 0x002BDAE0 (to 0x002BED30) and 0x002BDB00 (to 0x002BE8D0) work on the pool: 0x002BED30 zeroes the heads +0x4098, +0x40A0 and +0x40A8 and stores the +0xD8 address into +0x40A8, and 0x002BE8D0 reads and writes +0x40A8 and +0x4098 and, after reloading rcx from +0x4098 at 0x002BE9D5, works on a pool element (+0x188 and +0x190 are element fields).

name: entryPool
meaning: The active-log entry pool, 40 entries of 0x198. The base is the `lea rdi,[rcx+0xD8]` at 0x002BED41, which 0x002BED30 stores into the free-list head at +0x40A8; the element size is the `mov r8d, 0x198` memset at 0x002BE96E; and the count follows from the pool's bounds: 0x4098 - 0xD8 = 16,320 = 40 x 0x198 with no remainder. Entries are threaded into two lists through their own +0x188 and +0x190.

name: liveListHead
meaning: Head of the live list. Zeroed with its two neighbours at 0x002BED48, tested at 0x002BE94D to decide whether the pool may be grown, and set to a freshly filled entry at 0x002BE9E1 when the list is empty.

name: shownListHead
meaning: head of the shown list: the line on screen and the one sliding in. 0x002BEAC0 tests it (0x002BEAF7), sets it to the first queued line when nothing is shown (0x002BEC7A-0x002BEC86) and appends to it (0x002BEC1B-0x002BEC46); 0x002BF010 and 0x002BEE00 retire from it (0x002BF013, 0x002BF082-0x002BF0CD, 0x002BEE00-0x002BEEC1); 0x002BF230 reads it (0x002BF26B)

name: freeListHead
meaning: Head of the free list, which also fixes the pool's base: 0x002BED30 stores `lea rax,[rsi+0xD8]` into it at 0x002BEDA4. 0x002BE8D0 pops from it at 0x002BE8E4 and repoints it to the popped entry's +0x188 at 0x002BE900; when it is null the allocator falls back to 0x002BF480.

name: xOffset40B0
meaning: an x offset the procedure adds to the +0x1078 widget's x (0x002BE65F-0x002BE666), from the creator (0x002BDEA0)

name: yDelta40B2
meaning: the +0x1078 widget's y minus the pane's, computed by the creator (0x002BDEA7-0x002BDECA) and added back to the pane's y on layout (0x002BE621-0x002BE66D, 0x002BE781-0x002BE788, 0x002BE818-0x002BE826)

name: fadeLevel
meaning: the log's fade level, 0 to 0x80: 0x002BEAC0 raises it by 0x10 a tick to 0x80 while bit 0x4 of +0x40B6 is set and lowers it by 0x10 to 0 otherwise (0x002BECB7-0x002BECE4); the procedure writes it (0x002BE69F) and copies it to the pane's +0xEA and the +0x1078 widget's +0xDA (0x002BE6D8-0x002BE6FB); 0 at set-up (0x002BED75)

name: flags40B6
meaning: flags. Bit 0x1 stops the steps (0x002BEAC6): set by 0x002BDB60 (0x002BDBD4) and the procedure (0x002BE7EE), cleared by 0x002BDC00 (0x002BDC75) and the procedure (0x002BE6A6), and 0x002BDCA0 sets it to the inverse of its argument (0x002BDCB6-0x002BDCC9). Bit 0x2: the pane is moving to a new y, set when the position tween 0x002468A0 starts (0x002BE798-0x002BE7BF) and cleared on message 17 with argument 1 (0x002BE805-0x002BE811). Bit 0x4: a line is in view, set at 0x002BEB2F and 0x002BECAF and cleared at 0x002BEC60-0x002BEC65 when the timer is full and nothing is queued; clear, the log fades out

name: slidePos40B8
meaning: the slide-in position of the new line, 0 to 0x100: 32 / [0x01DFE0B4] a tick (0x002BEB64-0x002BEB81); when it reaches 0x100, 0x002BF010 retires the line it replaced (0x002BEB88-0x002BEB95). The dword stores at 0x002BE6AF, 0x002BEC00 and 0x002BF023 write it together with +0x40BA

name: holdTimer40BA
meaning: the hold timer: counts up each tick once the log is fully in and 0x0036D830 answers 0 (0x002BEB9F-0x002BEBB1), capped at 150 x [0x01DFE0B4] (0x002BEBB8-0x002BEBD8), reset when a line is shown (0x002BEC8D); the dword stores at 0x002BE6AF, 0x002BEC00 and 0x002BF023 write it together with +0x40B8

name: lineHoldTime40BC
meaning: the shown line's hold time, copied from the line's +0x184 (0x002BEC06-0x002BEC10, 0x002BEC94-0x002BEC9B) and compared with the timer (0x002BEBF8)

name: tail40C0
meaning: the remaining tail, 8 bytes that no instruction accesses on this object. The only image-wide +0x40C0 displacements are on other objects: 0x001AF60D stores the address 0x01E027F4 next to a +0x3BE0 address store, and 0x006458A0 writes the float 3.4028235e38 there next to floats 1.0 at +0x40B0 and +0x40BC (0x00645A1F-0x00645A3A), where the log keeps words

name: count
meaning: how many u16 values follow. The binder skips the whole section when it is below 2

name: values
meaning: The first of `count` u16 values. The array is variable-length; the store declares one element because it cannot express a variable bound. The binder sums them all: esi and r14d both start at zero and are added together with the tail element at the end, so the two accumulators are a by-2 unroll of one sum, not two interleaved fields.

name: unread00
meaning: The first five dwords of the script image the bind receives (section 0 of an .ebp): +0x00 the format dword, 0x8000000B in the 10,036 scripts shipped in EBP2 containers and 0x80000007 in the nine container-less evt_t0020.ebp (one per language folder); the completion callback 0x0032F850 binds the payload when its first byte is non-zero (0x0032F87E), and the slot initialiser 0x0026CE60 tests its low word against 3 (0x0026CF72, 0x0026D010) before it takes each record's entry from the payload; +0x04 the image's byte length, equal to the section's length or 16, 32 or 48 bytes short of it in all 10,045 shipped scripts; +0x08, +0x0C and +0x10 the offsets of three zero-terminated texts in the image, 0x9C, the byte after the first text and 0x90 in every file: at +0x90 an 11-character stamp 'MM/DD hh:mm' (00/00 00:00 in 10,019 files), at +0x9C the author's account name (30 distinct texts, empty in 153), then the source file name '<script>.src', which matches the .ebp's own name in every file but the cn and kr ttl_a01_e3.ebp (ttl_a01.src).

name: typeCounts
meaning: The offset of the actor type counts, a u16 8 and then eight u16 counts, the directory entries of each actor type (../EBP-Script-Files/ebp-script-image.md line 41). The bind 0x0026C8C0 reads it signed (movsxd, 0x0026CB7D), reads the first u16 as the count (0x0026CB81) and walks the counts after it (0x0026CB8C-0x0026CB97). In all 10,036 shipped images the first u16 is 8 and the eight counts add up to the directory's count at +0x18

name: unread18
meaning: +0x18 the offset of the script's actor directory in the image: a u32 count and one 0x30-byte entry per actor (0x20 bytes below version 8, 0x00266710-0x00266731: the nine evt_t0020 images of version 7) with the offsets of its name, code, function table and jump table (+0x00, +0x08, +0x10, +0x14); the directory follows the +0x14 table in all 10,045 shipped scripts and its entries fit in the image in all 10,036 with format 0x8000000B; +0x1C is 0 in all 10,045; of the head, the bind 0x0026C8C0 and the slot initialisers 0x0026CE60, 0x002679F0 and 0x00266C50 address +0x00, +0x14, +0x20 to +0x2C, +0x38, +0x48, +0x50 and +0x58

name: intPool
meaning: The offset of the integer constant pool, a u32 count and that many s32 values that `PUSHI` pushes (see the EBP script-image page). The bind 0x0026C8C0 reads it signed (movsxd, 0x0026CB3C) and stores the image plus it at the manager record's +0x68 (0x0026CB40-0x0026CB43). It points inside the image in all 10,036 shipped images, with room for its count of values.

name: floatPool
meaning: The offset of the float constant pool, a u32 count and that many f32 values that `PUSHF` pushes (see the EBP script-image page). The bind 0x0026C8C0 reads it signed (movsxd, 0x0026CB47) and stores the image plus it at the manager record's +0x70 (0x0026CB4B-0x0026CB4E). It points inside the image in all 10,036 shipped images, with room for its count of values.

name: variables
meaning: The offset of the variable descriptors, a u32 count and that many 8-byte descriptors that `PUSHV` and `POPV` use (see the EBP script-image page). The bind 0x0026C8C0 reads it signed (movsxd, 0x0026CB60) and stores the image plus it at the manager record's +0x78 (0x0026CB64-0x0026CB6B). It points inside the image in all 10,036 shipped images, with room for its count of descriptors.

name: tagTables
meaning: The offset of the actor tag tables that `PUSHACT` and `PUSHTAG` use (see the EBP script-image page). The bind 0x0026C8C0 reads it signed (movsxd, 0x0026CB52) and stores the image plus it at the manager record's +0x80 (0x0026CB56-0x0026CB59). It points inside the image in all 10,036 shipped images.

name: unread30
meaning: +0x30 the offset of a table in the image, a u32 count and that many u32 offsets, all inside the image (count 0 in 3,968 of the 10,045 shipped scripts); +0x34 the byte length of the region at +[0x38], the slot's file storage +0x40 that 0x0026CE60 sets: in every shipped script those bytes are all 0 and end at or before +[0x48]; +0x3C and +0x40 the length and offset of a data block inside the image, 0 and an offset in 3,183 scripts and holding non-zero bytes in the other 6,862; +0x44 the byte length, a multiple of 4, of the region at +[0x48], the slot's local base +0x50 that the bind sets: all 0 in every shipped script and 0 long in 1,458

name: localOff
meaning: The offset of the local variable storage, whose size is +0x44 (../EBP-Script-Files/ebp-script-image.md lines 52-53). The bind 0x0026C8C0 reads it unsigned (mov, 0x0026CB04), unlike the signed section offsets, and stores the image plus it at the manager record's +0x50 (0x0026CB0F-0x0026CB17). In all 10,036 shipped images it is a multiple of 16 inside the image or at its end, and the name pool +0x4C starts at it plus +0x44 rounded up to 16

name: namePool
meaning: The offset of the name pool, the zero-terminated actor and function names that the directory entries' name offsets index: equal to +0x48 plus +0x44 rounded up to 16 in all of the 10,036 shipped images. 0x00263A30(manager, ordinal) returns the image plus this dword plus the first int of the entry's +0x40 record (0x00263A83-0x00263A8C), the issuer name captureactor 0x00354E10 searches by, and 0x00263E40(image, offset) returns the image plus this dword plus its second argument (0x00263E40-0x00263E4A).

name: startActor
meaning: The ordinal of the actor the start-up run begins: 0x00266C50 does nothing while it is negative (0x00266C60) and otherwise resolves the actor with 0x00358940 (0x00266C7D) and files each non-negative function id of the start list +0x58 on it with 0x003DBB60 (0x00266CB2-0x00266CE1). The bind 0x0026C8C0 sets the manager record's byte +0x12 to 1 when it is not negative (0x0026CD1A-0x0026CD28, ../Characters-And-Objects/actor-managers.md). It is -1 in 4,445 and 0 in 4,835 of the 10,036 shipped images

name: entryDefault
meaning: The entry-point index 0x00264B90 uses for a request of -1 (0x00264BF4) and for any other negative request after -2 and -3 (0x00264C14). It is 0 in 9,766 of the 10,036 shipped images

name: entryPointsA
meaning: The offset of the first entry-point table, a u32 count and 32-byte records: 0x00264B90 reads it for kind 0 (0x00264C2D) when the version word is above 2 (0x00264C23) and returns the first four dwords of record index, which 0x00377AB0 and 0x00377900 take as a position and a fourth value they convert with 0x003A1C50. Non-zero and inside the image in all of the 10,036 shipped images

name: startList
meaning: The offset of the start-up function list, a u16 count and that many s16 function ids for the actor +0x50: 0x00266C50 reads it at 0x00266C6B, resolved through 0x0020E600 (0x00266C78), and files each non-negative id on that actor with 0x003DBB60 (0x00266CD2). Non-zero and inside the image in all of the 10,036 shipped images

name: table5C
meaning: The offset of a table of 0x1C-byte records, a u32 count first: 0x00264390 in mode 0 reads it (0x002643D6, 0x002643E3) and returns a pointer to record index. Non-zero and inside the image in all of the 10,036 shipped images

name: table60
meaning: The offset of a table of 16-byte records, a u32 count first: 0x002642C0 reads it (0x002642E9, 0x002642FA) and, for version 9 and above, returns a pointer to record index. Non-zero and inside the image in all of the 10,036 shipped images

name: weather
meaning: The offset of the weather chances, a u8 3 and three chance bytes: 0x002658B0 reads it from manager 0's image (0x002658EB) for version 7 and above and returns the weather slot's chance byte (../World-Areas-And-Travel/weather.md). Non-zero and inside the image in all of the 10,036 shipped images

name: table68
meaning: The offset of the party-binding lists, a u32 count and list offsets of u16 count and s16 ordinals: 0x003B7210 reads it (0x003B7226) and binds the first list's actors through 0x00262F50 (0x003B72C1), and capturepartyforsummon 0x003B72F0 reads it (0x003B730E) and uses the second list when the count is above 1 (0x003B731D). It is 0, no lists, in 2,935 of the 10,036 shipped images

name: trapRefs
meaning: The offset of the trap reference table, a u32 count and packed references: 0x002641B0 reads it (0x002641E4, 0x002641F1) and returns the base of the reference's class (0x00265770) plus its low 24 bits, refusing class 2 (../World-Areas-And-Travel/traps.md). Non-zero and inside the image in all of the 10,036 shipped images

name: table70
meaning: The offset of a five-entry table, a u32 5 and five s32 offsets: 0x00264AE0 reads it from manager 0's image (0x00264B03, 0x00264B10) and returns the image plus entry index. Non-zero and inside the image in all of the 10,036 shipped images

name: table74
meaning: The offset of a second table of 0x1C-byte records, a u32 count first: 0x00264390 in mode 1 reads it (0x002643B6, 0x002643C3) and returns a pointer to record index. Non-zero and inside the image in all of the 10,036 shipped images

name: entryMinus2
meaning: The entry-point index 0x00264B90 uses for a request of -2 (0x00264BF9-0x00264BFF). It is 0 in 9,316 of the 10,036 shipped images

name: entryMinus3
meaning: The entry-point index 0x00264B90 uses for a request of -3 (0x00264C04-0x00264C0A). It is 0 in 9,325 of the 10,036 shipped images

name: explorationField
meaning: The field whose explored-cell mask the map draws: 0x00264790 returns this signed word of manager 0's image (0x002647A5), or -1 while manager 0's record +0x10 lacks bit `0x1` (0x02098E20, 0x00264790-0x002647AD). 0x003C4AE0 passes a positive value to 0x002551B0(0, field), which indexes the save's exploration bitmaps through 0x003779F0 (0x002551BB), and takes the block at 0x02B45A50 otherwise. 0x00402F00 projects the party leader onto the minimap while it is below 1 (../Menus-And-HUD/map-screens.md, ../Game-Files-And-Data-Tables/menu-map-files.md). It is 0 in 9,136 of the 10,036 shipped images and 289 to 1,143 in the other 900

name: word7E
meaning: A signed word that 0x00264770 returns for manager 0's image (0x00264785), or -1 while manager 0's record +0x10 lacks bit `0x1` (0x02098E20, 0x00264770-0x0026478D). The map screen's point-list pane 0x002BA310 compares it with the words of its list at +0xCC (0x002BA4A0-0x002BA4AA), and the overlay page 0x002B7B80 (0x002B8621) and the icon draw 0x004048E0 (0x00404A6A) read it. It is 1 to 31 in the 900 images whose +0x7C is non-zero and 0 in the other 9,136 of the 10,036 shipped images

name: table80
meaning: The offset of a table of {u32 id, u32 mask} pairs, a u32 count first: 0x0035A270 reads it (0x0035A2A0) and, for each pair whose id resolves, calls 0x002ECAB0(id, bit, 1) for each set bit of mask `0xFFFFFFFE`. Non-zero and inside the image in all of the 10,036 shipped images

name: entryPointsB
meaning: The offset of the second entry-point table, the same 32-byte records as +0x54: 0x00264B90 reads it for a non-zero kind (0x00264C32) when the version word is above 2 (0x00264C23). Non-zero and inside the image in all of the 10,036 shipped images

name: treasureModel
meaning: The chest model index of setuptreasure: 0x0026E060 reads this word from manager 0's image (0x0026E09B) when manager 0's record +0x10 has bit `0x1` and the version word is 11 or above (0x0026E093-0x0026E099), and a value that is not negative is ORed with `0x3000000` to an index above `0xFFFFFF`, which 0x002E9A60 resolves through the script's name table (0x00263F80). Otherwise the model is -1. 0x0026E060's callers are setuptreasure's begin 0x00354400 (0x00354435) and result 0x00355210 (0x003552DE). It is -1 in 6,571, 0 in 3,276 and 4 or 5 in the rest of the 10,036 shipped images

name: pad8A
meaning: The high half of the dword +0x88: 0x0026E060 reads +0x88 as a word (0x0026E09B) and leaves these two bytes, and they are 0 in all of the 10,036 shipped images

name: table8C
meaning: The offset of a table of 16-byte records, a u32 count first, the header's last field: 0x00264870 reads it from manager 0's image (0x00264893, 0x002648A3) and returns a pointer to record index. Non-zero and inside the image in all of the 10,036 shipped images, and the smallest offset any header field holds is 0x90

name: boundDefinitionPayload
meaning: **the bound definition payload (`rdx` of the bind, `0x0026C95A`)**

name: recordPool
meaning: Pointer to the actor record pool this manager slot owns, the single block the record pool allocator 0x002679F0 carves. Its first dword is the record count and the pointer table starts at pool+8, so record i is ((void**)pool)[1+i]. The handle resolver 0x003588B0 walks it the same way as the ordinal getter 0x00358940: cmp ebx, dword [rcx] at 0x358905 bounds the index by the first dword, and mov rax, qword [rcx + rbx*8 + 8] at 0x358909 takes entry i. Extent: with at most 8 groups, u16 counts, +0x20 equal to their sum N and the shipped rounded sizes 816, 944, 816, 848, 720, 1760, 1760, 1648, the block size T = 2*align16(8N + 8) + sum(rounded size * count) is at most 618,650,432 < 2^31, so the dword arithmetic 0x00267A50-0x00267A73 does not wrap. With valid, disjoint storage and an adequate non-null allocation, the pointer stores (0x00267AF5) and the packed-byte stores (0x00267B04, 0x00267B13) through 0x00267B63 overlap neither the count dword at pool+0 nor each other; a count N = 0xFFFFFFFE does make them overlap, and later constructor calls (0x00266530) fall outside this bound. The getter 0x00358940 returns 0 for a null pool, a negative ordinal or an ordinal at or above the signed count, and otherwise the table entry, which may be null; the cleanup's third pass reads byte +0x14 of whatever it returns with no null test (0x0025B212).

name: slotFlags
meaning: A byte of flags. Bit 0x1 marks the slot live: every accessor of the manager-slot tables tests it before touching the slot's table, among them the handle resolver 0x003588B0 (test byte [rax+0x10], 1 at 0x3588FF; it returns 0 when the bit is clear). Bit 0x80 is read by the field runtime pass. Every access is a byte. The bind 0x0026C8C0 ands it with 0xE7 in memory (0x0026CB0B), loads it as f (0x0026CB12), and stores f & 0xFE at 0x0026CB67 (bit 0x1 clear) and f & 0xFE with 0x82 or-ed in at 0x0026CC45 (bit 0x1 clear, bits 0x2 and 0x80 set); no call and no other r9 write lies between the load and either store. A later in-memory and with 0x9B (0x0026CD3F) keeps bits 0x1, 0x2 and 0x80, and the calls from 0x0026CC72 on may write memory. The bind never sets bit 0x1. The initialiser 0x0026CE60 skips its pool allocation (to 0x0026D383) when bit 0x1 is set (0x0026CE94) or byte +0x13 is zero (0x0026CE9E), before any call; otherwise it calls 0x002679F0(slot) at 0x0026CEB0.

name: passFlags
meaning: Bit 0x1 is cleared at the start of every field runtime pass.

name: driveNamedActor
meaning: 1 when the bound definition's word +0x50 (the driven actor's ordinal) is not negative: the bind stores (word [definition+0x50] >= 0, signed); the field runtime pass's settled exit stores r12b, 0 on that path, clearing it; readers test it against 0

name: slotByte13
meaning: A per-slot byte, read by a slot-indexed getter: the world-tick page lists 0x002673F0 as a flag-stub read of 0x02098E23 (array base +0x013). The bind writes it: 0x0026CC6C mov word [rdi+0x13], 0x101 stores 1 here and 1 at +0x14 in one word store, with rdi the computed slot 0x02098E10 + sx32(index)*0x288 (0x0026C8FE-0x0026C90E). The initialiser reads it as its second gate: 0x0026CE9E cmp byte [rbx+0x13], 0 / je 0x0026D383, so zero skips the pool allocation.

name: pathInitByte14
meaning: A byte set to 1 by the bind's word store 0x0026CC6C (together with +0x13) and, among the field map's bound-slot accesses, written 0 by 0x0026C410 and 1 by 0x0026C606. The store 0x003DA497 mov byte [rbx+rdi*8+0x124], 0 (rdi = 3*i) is ActorManagerSlotEntry +0x14 of cameraChannels entry i (slot +0x110 + 0x18*i + 0x14), not this byte. The name pathInitByte14 is a key only.

name: slotIsNotThree
meaning: The slot-3 discriminator: 0x0026CBF9 cmp ebp, 3 / 0x0026CC03 setne al / 0x0026CC0D mov byte ptr [rdi + 0x15], al, where ebp is the slot index (movsxd rbp, ecx at 0x0026C8ED, then imul r8, rbp, 0x288 forms this element). So the byte is 0 for slot 3 and 1 for slots 0, 1, 2 and 4. It agrees with the world tick 0x00314020, which drives slots 0..4 in a loop and slot 3 separately at 0x0031411D. The bind 0x0026C8C0 forms the slot address image-base-relative (lea r14,[rip->0x120000]; lea rdi,[r14 + 0x1f78e10]; imul/add), with no direct lea of the table.

name: sysUnitControl
meaning: A system-unit-control flag byte, not part of a u16: the script verbs 009B sysucoff and 009C sysucon store 0 and 1 here through 0x0026B8A0 and 0x0026B8C0. The object is 0x002640C0() = *(0x02099D70), the bound-slot global holding an ActorManagerSlot* (bound at 0x0026C911).

name: flagByte17
meaning: A byte of flags. 0x0034A26D and 0xFE clears bit 0x1, and 0x0034A27B or byte ptr [rdi + 0x17], cl sets a bit chosen by a register in the same function, so the bits named by literals do not cover every bit this byte can hold. Bit 0x40 is the movie-memory in-use flag: the script verbs 0297 usemoviememory and 0298 stopmoviememory set and clear it through 0x003DDC20 on element ecx of the 0x288-stride slot array at 0x02098E10 (0x00263FF0).

name: cameraFrameOwner
meaning: Reverse lookup for entryTableA: each entry's +0x04 selector indexes here and the value stored is that entry's own index, so it maps a selector back to the entry holding it. Written indexed at 0x003DA4B9 mov word ptr [rbx + rax*2 + 0x18], si with rax taken from the entry by movsxd, and written unrolled at the head of FUN_003DA370. Element 0 is the channel driving the main frame and element 1 the sub frame (getcameramainframe 0x0050F100 returns 0, getcamerasubframe 0x0050D1C0 returns 1); 0x003DA050 reads both and binds that channel's player to the frame through 0x002563C0. A frame argument above 1 is stored unchecked and writes past this table.

name: shakeFrameOwner
meaning: The same reverse lookup for entryTableB, the shake side's frame-owner table: written indexed at 0x003DD2EC mov word ptr [rbx + rax*2 + 0x1c], di and unrolled at the head of FUN_003DCF60, matching cameraFrameOwner +0x18.

name: definitionValueTotal
meaning: The slot's record capacity: the unsigned 32-bit sum of the u16 per-kind counts in the definition payload's counted section, stored at bind (compare recordCountByKind at +0x1D0). Rule: table = payload + sx32(dword payload+0x14) (0x0026CB7D); G = u16 table+0 (0x0026CB81); the dword stored at 0x0026CBD9 is the sum of the G u16 words from table+2 (pair loop 0x0026CBA1-0x0026CBB6 into esi and r14d, odd tail 0x0026CBC1 into r12d, combined at 0x0026CBCE and 0x0026CBD6), with no clamp or mask. It is at most G*65535, at most 0xFFFE0001, so nothing wraps; for G = 8 it is at most 0x7FFF8 (524,280). Every reader reads it as a signed dword: the pool allocator 0x002679F0 as N (0x00267A11; 0x00267AA5 copies it to pool+0, the count the resolvers 0x00358940 and 0x003587C0 compare against), the cleanup 0x0025B070's third pass (0x0025B200, 0x0025B234, re-read every back-edge), and the handle resolver (0x003588FA cmp, 0x003588FD jge), which bounds the handle's record index by it before the pool's own count is checked at 0x358905. A value above 0x7FFFFFFF needs G > 32768; the signed jge on a zero-extended 16-bit index makes a negative value reject every handle.

name: counter0024
meaning: A counter incremented at 0x0025DED5 (inc dword ptr [rbx + 0x24]), immediately before the increment of +0x38 at 0x0025DED8: two counters bumped together by one function.

name: slotIndex
meaning: This slot's own index, written at load by the bind 0x0026C8C0 from the value that selected the slot; rdi there is 0x02098E10 + slot*0x288 (0x0026C8FE lea rdi,[r14+0x1F78E10] with r14 = 0x00120000, 0x0026C907 imul r8,rbp,0x288, 0x0026C90E add rdi,r8). It is also the handle's owner field: the record initialiser 0x00266530 copies its low byte into every record it initialises (0x00266616 load, 0x00266624 store into ActorStorageRecord +0x15), and the packed actor handle carries it in the bits 0xF0000, which the handle resolver 0x003588B0 bounds to < 5 and uses as the index back into this array. It is the routing field that lets a 32-bit handle find its manager.

name: pad2C
meaning: Alignment after slotIndex +0x28. None of the 68,225 recorded accesses to the five slots (by 353 functions) is a slot field here: the accesses listed at this offset are 0x003DA092's indexed word read over the slot and 0x002679F0's record-pool stride. No rip-relative reference reaches 0x02098E10 + k x 0x288 + this offset for k < 5, and no block copy reaches it but the boot initialiser 0x00266D10's per-slot clear (memset 0x288, 0x00266EF0-0x00266F37). Zero at load (.bss) and after every clear.

name: resolvedUnitPtr
meaning: the bound unit pointer the handle resolver returns

name: counter0038
meaning: A counter incremented at 0x0025DED8 (inc dword ptr [rbx + 0x38]), the second of the pair the same function bumps with +0x24.

name: pad3C
meaning: Alignment after passCounter2 +0x38. None of the 68,225 recorded accesses to the five slots (by 353 functions) is a slot field here: the accesses listed at this offset are 0x003DA092's indexed word read over the slot and 0x002679F0's record-pool stride. No rip-relative reference reaches 0x02098E10 + k x 0x288 + this offset for k < 5, and no block copy reaches it but the boot initialiser 0x00266D10's per-slot clear (memset 0x288, 0x00266EF0-0x00266F37). Zero at load (.bss) and after every clear.

name: fileClassBase
meaning: The file-class variable base. The binder leaves this null and the slot initialiser 0x0026CE60 fills it lazily at 0x0026D2F6, so a slot can be bound and still have no file-class home. Lifetime: derived from the loaded image, so it dies with it.

name: persistentPayloadBase
meaning: The persistent save payload base, the same pointer the save-image getter 0x002EF2B0 returns. Its first 0x200 bytes are a 256-entry operand bank, and script globals occupy +0x200..+0xCF4 beyond that. It is the one script-variable home that is saved: variables here survive a save and reload, and those in the other homes do not.

name: localClassBase
meaning: The local-class variable base: image + the offset at image+0x48. The per-actor local area is this plus the actor entry's +0x1C, added by the resolver at 0x00264E30. Lifetime: it dies with the image.

name: fieldScratchBank
meaning: The first scratch bank, the static at 0x02099DF0, byte-addressed by scripts at 74 distinct offsets. It is cleared on every field transition, so it holds the variables that must not outlive the area. The bank is 0x200 bytes; its accessor pair reaches only the first 128.

name: groupPersistentBank
meaning: The second scratch bank, the static at 0x02099FF0, addressed at 77 distinct offsets. Lifetime: this is the group persistent bank, exported and imported whole by the world-persistence pair, so unlike +0x58 it survives a field transition. The bank is 0x200 bytes; its accessor pair reaches only the first 64.

name: payloadSectionC
meaning: Payload base plus the signed 32-bit offset at payload+0x20, installed at load by the bind 0x0026C8C0; rdi there is 0x02098E10 + slot*0x288 (0x0026C8FE lea rdi,[r14+0x1F78E10] with r14 = 0x00120000, 0x0026C907 imul r8,rbp,0x288, 0x0026C90E add rdi,r8). The script interpreter 0x0025E4C0 reads it (mov rax/r8,[r13+0x068]): the interpreter consumes these payload sections. Of the 20 functions that reference the published slot global 0x02099D70 directly, only the binder accesses this offset, with its writes; the 137 callers of the current-slot accessor 0x002640C0 are the other direct route to the slot.

name: payloadSectionD
meaning: Payload base plus the signed 32-bit offset at payload+0x24, installed at load by the bind 0x0026C8C0; rdi there is 0x02098E10 + slot*0x288 (0x0026C8FE lea rdi,[r14+0x1F78E10] with r14 = 0x00120000, 0x0026C907 imul r8,rbp,0x288, 0x0026C90E add rdi,r8). The script interpreter 0x0025E4C0 reads it (mov rax/r8,[r13+0x070]): the interpreter consumes these payload sections. Of the 20 functions that reference the published slot global 0x02099D70 directly, only the binder accesses this offset, with its writes; the 137 callers of the current-slot accessor 0x002640C0 are the other direct route to the slot.

name: variableDescriptorTable
meaning: The script variable descriptor table: a u32 count followed by 8-byte records whose first dword packs offset:24, class:3, float:1, width:4. It tells the resolver which of the five bases above a variable lives in, so it indexes the ownership map rather than being a home itself. It lives as long as the image.

name: payloadSectionF
meaning: Payload base plus the signed 32-bit offset at payload+0x2C, installed at load by the bind 0x0026C8C0; rdi there is 0x02098E10 + slot*0x288 (0x0026C8FE lea rdi,[r14+0x1F78E10] with r14 = 0x00120000, 0x0026C907 imul r8,rbp,0x288, 0x0026C90E add rdi,r8). The four sections are installed out of numeric order, +0x80 before +0x78, which is scheduling, not meaning. The script interpreter 0x0025E4C0 reads it (mov rax/r8,[r13+0x080]): the interpreter consumes these payload sections. Of the 20 functions that reference the published slot global 0x02099D70 directly, only the binder accesses this offset, with its writes; the 137 callers of the current-slot accessor 0x002640C0 are the other direct route to the slot.

name: recordPoolAllocator
meaning: The record pool allocator, a function pointer the slot is configured with; every ActorStorageRecord the slot owns is carved through it, so it points at code, not at a record. The store has no function-pointer ctype, so the ctype is void*, as on +0x098, ItemClassDescriptor +0x048/+0x050 and Widget +0x008.

name: pad90
meaning: The qword between the callback +0x88 and the resolver +0x98. None of the 68,225 recorded accesses to the five slots (by 353 functions) is a slot field here: the accesses listed at this offset are 0x003DA092's indexed word read over the slot and 0x002679F0's record-pool stride. No rip-relative reference reaches 0x02098E10 + k x 0x288 + this offset for k < 5, and no block copy reaches it but the boot initialiser 0x00266D10's per-slot clear (memset 0x288, 0x00266EF0-0x00266F37). Zero at load (.bss) and after every clear.

name: localVariableResolver
meaning: A function pointer, installed with the address of 0x00264E30 and invoked indirectly by the variable resolver, not a data pointer. It turns a descriptor plus the actor entry's +0x1C into an address inside the local-class base. The store has no function-pointer ctype (every pointer in it is void*), so the ctype is void* and the callability is recorded here.

name: stringTableA0
meaning: The bound script's section_002, the zone message bank: set by 0x0026C880 from the section handler 0x00330190, which also stores it at 0x022C6CA0[m]. Zeroed at bind by the bind 0x0026C8C0 (0x0026CC49-0x0026CC5E, rbx zero) and set by the section handler through its setter stub. The teardown 0x0032ED80 does not clear it: it clears only the global mirror 0x022C6CA0[m] (0x0032EE6C, on the arm's nonzero test 0x0032EE3D), and the arm's direct release 0x0032EE67 call 0x003697F0 never runs in the shipping build, because the gate 0x0032EE5B calls 0x005C5230, which is xor eax, eax / ret, and 0x0032EE62 je skips the release. So the field keeps the old pointer until the slot's next bind.

name: stringTableA8
meaning: The bound script's section_003, the field-sign caption bank: set by 0x0026C8A0 from the section handler 0x00330220, which also stores it at 0x022C6CC8[m]. Zeroed at bind by the bind 0x0026C8C0 (0x0026CC49-0x0026CC5E, rbx zero) and set by the section handler through its setter stub. The teardown 0x0032ED80 does not clear it: it clears only the global mirror 0x022C6CC8[m] (0x0032EEAB, on the arm's nonzero test 0x0032EE7C), and the arm's direct release 0x0032EEA6 call 0x003697F0 never runs in the shipping build, because the gate 0x0032EE9A calls 0x005C5230, which is xor eax, eax / ret, and 0x0032EEA1 je skips the release. So the field keeps the old pointer until the slot's next bind.

name: section006TextureBlock
meaning: The bound script's section_006, the TIM2 texture block: set by 0x0026C860 from the section handler 0x00330060, which also stores it at 0x022C6CF0[m] and registers it in the texture cache (0x0029CAC0). It is read at 9 sites (0x002C8D26, 0x0034AE91, 0x00354628, 0x00354F7A, 0x0035564A, 0x0050EB57, 0x003E8F50 and others) and passed on as a call argument: the gauge-label verbs 0x1BC setgaugecounterlabel, 0x1BD setgaugecounterunit and 0x1BE setgaugetimerlabel read it through 0x003E8F50 / 0x003E8FC0 / 0x003E9000 into 0x00408640 / 0x00408700 / 0x00408960, which keep it image-relative (0x0020E620) beside the label. Zeroed at bind by the bind 0x0026C8C0 (0x0026CC49-0x0026CC5E, rbx zero) and set by the section handler through its setter stub. The teardown 0x0032ED80 does not clear it: it calls 0x002E0780(m), 0x0017FA50 and 0x0029CB10 on the pointer and clears only the global mirror 0x022C6CF0[m] (0x0032EF10, on the arm's nonzero test 0x0032EEB3); the arm's direct release 0x0032EF0B call 0x003697F0 never runs in the shipping build, because the gate 0x0032EEFF calls 0x005C5230, which is xor eax, eax / ret, and 0x0032EF06 je skips the release. So the field keeps the old pointer until the slot's next bind.

name: nullablePtrB8
meaning: A nullable 8-byte pointer. Three of its four recorded accesses are `cmp qword ptr [.. + 0xb8], 0` in three different functions, so every consumer null-checks it before use, and the single write stores a register.

name: slotParamDwordC0
meaning: A dword written by 0x003E92F0 and read into ecx or r8d as a call argument by 0x003E9320 and 0x003E9550 (four accesses in all).

name: padC4
meaning: Alignment after the dword +0xC0 (read by 0x003E91E3). None of the 68,225 recorded accesses to the five slots (by 353 functions) is a slot field here: the accesses listed at this offset are 0x003DA092's indexed word read over the slot and 0x002679F0's record-pool stride. No rip-relative reference reaches 0x02098E10 + k x 0x288 + this offset for k < 5, and no block copy reaches it but the boot initialiser 0x00266D10's per-slot clear (memset 0x288, 0x00266EF0-0x00266F37). Zero at load (.bss) and after every clear.

name: zeroedQword00C8
meaning: A qword zeroed at bind: 0x0026CBE6 mov qword ptr [rdi + 0xc8], rbx, with rbx zeroed at 0x0026C905 and not rewritten before this site (over the whole 1,330-byte body rbx is written at 0x0026C905 and next at 0x0026CD8D, after every store that uses it). It is one store of a long interleaved clear run that also covers +0xD0, +0xD8, +0xE0 and +0xF8. The bind 0x0026C8C0 forms the slot address image-base-relative (lea r14,[rip->0x120000]; lea rdi,[r14 + 0x1f78e10]; imul/add).

name: zeroedQword00D0
meaning: A qword zeroed at bind by 0x0026CBEF, the next store of the same clear run as +0xC8. The bind 0x0026C8C0 forms the slot address image-base-relative (lea r14,[rip->0x120000]; lea rdi,[r14 + 0x1f78e10]; imul/add).

name: cameraNameList
meaning: the section_008 CML1 camera name list of the slot's loaded script container, stored by 0x0026CE00. The camera start 0x003DA400 bounds an entry number by the list's +0x04 count and reads the entry's +0x04 shot index. Entries are 16 bytes: 0x003DA400 doubles the entry index (add rax, rax at 0x003DA44A) and reads mov edx, dword ptr [rcx + rax*8 + 0x14] (0x003DA456) with rcx the list pointer from +0xD8, so entry 0's shot index is at +0x14, after a 0x10-byte header holding the count at +0x04. The same function scales a different index by 24 (lea rdi, [rsi + rsi*2] at 0x003DA446, then [rbx + rdi*8 + 0x11C] and [rbx + rdi*8 + 0x11A]) for the 24-byte cameraChannels at +0x110. 0x003DD230 does the same for the B side: 16-byte entries from +0xF0 ([r14 + rax*8 + 0x14]) and 24-byte shakeChannels at +0x170 ([rbx + rsi*8 + 0x17C]). In the shipped byu_x0100 script, entry 1cut2_2 at blob+0x24 reads shot index 14 under the 16-byte stride, where an 8-byte stride would read blob+0x1C and get 0

name: section009CameraTable
meaning: Zeroed at bind (0x0026CBFC) and by the slot initialiser's memset (0x00266EFC), set by the stub 0x0026CE20 from the section handler 0x0032FAC0, cleared through the same stub by the teardown 0x0032ED80. 0x0026CE60 tests it beside +0xD8 (0x0026D350) and, when both are set, runs 0x002572E0 with the slot index (0x0026D35D); 0x0032FA10 tests it (0x0032FA4F) and when set calls 0x003DA1F0 with the slot (0x0032FA5C).

name: ptr00E8
meaning: A pointer-width qword read at 0x0026294B (mov rcx, qword ptr [rbx + 0xe8]) and cleared to zero twice, at 0x0026295C and 0x00262E55 (mov qword ptr [rbx + 0xe8], rbp, with rbp zeroed at 0x0026292A and not rewritten): read as a pointer and reset with the rest of the slot.

name: shakeNameList
meaning: The B-side definition table pointer, the counterpart of +0xD8: the section_010 CML1 shake name list, stored by 0x0026D3A0. The shake start 0x003DD230 guards on it being non-null (0x003DD2DA cmp qword ptr [rbx + 0xf0], 0), as 0x003DA400 guards on +0xD8, and reads its definition rows through it, a count at +4 and 16-byte elements (entry +0x04 at 0x003DD29F); the shake-name resolver 0x003DD120 reads it too. It is compared with 0 as a qword and dereferenced, so it is a pointer, not an inline value.

name: section011ShakeCurveBank
meaning: Written only: zeroed at bind (0x0026CC10) and by the slot initialiser's memset (0x00266EFC), set by the stub 0x0026D3C0 from the section handler 0x003316B0, cleared through the same stub by the teardown 0x0032ED80. Readers use the global 0x022C6DD0[m]; no instruction reads this field.

name: idRemapTable
meaning: Pointer to the slot's id remap table, a CountedU32LookupTable, the target type its accessor reads it as.

name: teardownCallback108
meaning: A callback slot. The stub 0x00268630 stores rdx at 0x02098F18 + slot x 0x288; it is zeroed at bind 0x0026CC65 and by the slot initialiser's memset (0x00266EFC). 0x002628B0 loads it (0x00262F0F), and when it is non-null calls it with the slot in rcx (0x00262F1E), then zeroes it (0x00262F20). 0x0032F96B passes 0x00330050 through the stub; that callback takes the slot index from +0x28 and runs the teardown 0x0032ED80.

name: cameraChannels
meaning: Four 24-byte entries, the four camera channels driven by the camerastart, camerastop, camerachange and cameraratio verbs and ticked by 0x003DA050. FUN_003DA400 builds them, and its guard requires the slot's definition pointer at +0xD8 to be non-null. This A side and the B side at +0x170 have identical element layouts and initialisation; they differ in which definition pointer they read and which uint16 lookup they write back into (+0x18 for A, +0x1C for B). Layout alone also allows one array of eight split by role; the two unrolled mirrors, each covering exactly four elements, favour two arrays of four. See the scripted camera player section 2.2.

name: shakeChannels
meaning: The four camera-shake channels driven by the camerashake verbs (0x003DD230 and its siblings), the mirror of cameraChannels +0x110: built by FUN_003DD230 under a guard on the slot's other definition pointer at +0xF0, writing its reverse lookup into +0x1C rather than +0x18.

name: recordCountByKind
meaning: How many actor records the slot owns of each of the four kinds, accumulated group by group as the pool is carved; the kind is ActorSequenceDescriptor +0x00, whose values across the eight sequences are 0, 1, 2 and 3. Four 2-byte elements: 0x002679F0 walks them with lea rax,[r15 + 0x1d0], movzx ecx, word ptr [rax], mov word ptr [rax + 8], dx, lea rax,[rax + 2], a cursor stepping by two whose twin +0x1D8 is 8 bytes away, and all four are read as words elsewhere: +0x1D0 (0x00267B50), +0x1D2 (0x0025B095, 0x0025BA01, 0x0025C1A5), +0x1D4 (0x0025B281), +0x1D6 (0x0025B122, 0x0025B8AE, 0x0025C1E4, 0x00262400). The slot's two four-entry tables tile 0x110..0x1D0 with a 24-byte stride (lea rdi,[rsi + rsi*2] / [rbx + rdi*8 + 0x110]) and end where this array begins. Reset: the bind zeroes all four words with one qword store, 0x0026CD52 mov qword [rdi+0x1D0], rbx, rbx zero since 0x0026C905; +0x1D8 is not touched. For slot index 1..4 the bind's later stores (0x02099D70 at 0x0026CDC0; 0x003DD790's, in 0x02B581A0 + m*0x1C0 and 0x02B58A60 + m*4) avoid this field; for index 0 the only stores that could reach it are 0x002E83A7 movss [[0x022C6F28]+0x48824] and 0x002EBC37 movss [[0x022C6F28]+0x4881C], whose targets lie inside the 0x48930-byte render pool that 0x003325F1 publishes, so the zero survives while that pointer holds the live, distinct allocation. Tally: the pool allocator adds each group's u16 count with add word (0x00267AD4), so tally[k] = (seed + its groups' counts) mod 65536, and eight u16 groups can wrap (counts 0, 65535, 1 wrap kind 1 to 0); the seed is whatever the field holds at 0x00267AD4. The cleanup 0x0025B070 reads kind 1 (+0x1D2, 0x0025B095) and kind 3 (+0x1D6, 0x0025B122) zero-extended as interval lengths.

name: recordBaseByKind
meaning: The first ordinal of each kind in the slot's record pointer table, an exclusive prefix sum over recordCountByKind +0x1D0: kind k occupies ordinals recordBaseByKind[k] up to that plus recordCountByKind[k], and with the ordinal getter 0x00358940 this turns a kind into records. 0x002679F0 writes it while reading its twin, mov word ptr [rax + 8], dx at 0x00267B53 with rax the cursor into +0x1D0. Four 2-byte elements, all read independently: +0x1D8 (the loop's own write), +0x1DA (0x0025B086, 0x0025B9FA, 0x0025C199), +0x1DC (0x0025B275) and +0x1DE (0x0025B11B, 0x0025B883, 0x0025C1DD, 0x002623F4). 0x00267B53 stores the running sum's low word before 0x00267B5B adds tally k, so +0x1D8 is 0 and element k = (tally[0] + ... + tally[k-1]) mod 65536. The four-term sum is a dword (at most 262,140) and cannot wrap, but the word store can, even with no tally wrap (counts 65535, 1 give 0 for kind 2). The bind's qword zero at 0x0026CD52 does not clear this field. The cleanup 0x0025B070 reads +0x1DA (kind 1) and +0x1DE (kind 3) zero-extended as interval starts (0x0025B086, 0x0025B11B) and adds the matching length in 32 bits, so the interval end is at most 131,070 and does not wrap at 65536.

name: counter01E0
meaning: A dword counter, decremented at 0x002630B7 (dec dword ptr [r14 + 0x1e0]) and incremented at 0x002633C6 (inc dword ptr [rcx + r14 + 0x1e0], through the folded element base: rcx holds i*0x288 and r14 the table base). An 8-byte clear at 0x00262E4B (mov qword ptr [rbx + 0x1e0], rbp, rbp zero) spans this field and +0x1E4, one combined store over two adjacent dword counters, as at Widget +0x98; they are declared as two dwords because the read-modify-writes are 4-byte.

name: counter01E4
meaning: The second dword counter under the 8-byte clear at +0x1E0: decremented at 0x0025B523 and incremented at 0x0025D3CA, both dword ptr [rcx + rax + 0x1e4] through the folded element base.

name: dword01E8
meaning: A dword written twice by 0x00265A20, at 0x00265B3B and 0x00265B4D, through two different bases ([rbp + 0x1e8] and [rcx + 0x1e8]) in the same function.

name: pad1EC
meaning: Alignment after the dword +0x1E8 (0x003DA11E, 0x003DD04F, 0x00265B3B). None of the 68,225 recorded accesses to the five slots (by 353 functions) is a slot field here: the accesses listed at this offset are 0x003DA092's indexed word read over the slot and 0x002679F0's record-pool stride. No rip-relative reference reaches 0x02098E10 + k x 0x288 + this offset for k < 5, and no block copy reaches it but the boot initialiser 0x00266D10's per-slot clear (memset 0x288, 0x00266EF0-0x00266F37). Zero at load (.bss) and after every clear.

name: recordPoolRegionB
meaning: The second region of the record pool block, a pointer published here as the pool is carved. No recorded access reads this field.

name: dword01F8
meaning: A dword zeroed at bind: 0x0026CAE0 mov dword ptr [rdi + 0x1f8], ebx, with ebx zero. The bind 0x0026C8C0 forms the slot address image-base-relative (lea r14,[rip->0x120000]; lea rdi,[r14 + 0x1f78e10]; imul/add).

name: dword01FC
meaning: A dword cleared to zero at 0x00262E3F (mov dword ptr [rbx + 0x1fc], ebp, rbp zero), the first store of the slot's reset run.

name: bitClearedAtBind
meaning: **bit 0x4 cleared at bind (`0x0026C950`)**

name: subStepOptIn
meaning: The sub-step opt-in of the actor-manager slot: sub-steps 1-15 of the world tick run only for slots whose +0x201 is non-zero (0x02099011 + slot*0x288), and two ScriptVM commands (1337, 1306) set it. A second consumer, 0x002E09A0, polls it across five slots and switches every live message window's confirm-dismissable byte on the result (../Menus-And-HUD/fonts.md section 7). 0x00267310 reads it as lea rax,[rip+0x1E31CF0] = 0x02099011, imul rcx,rax,0x288, movzx eax,[rcx+rax]: 0x02098E10 + 0x201 = 0x02099011, so the field offset is folded into the base address and the access carries no displacement. 28 lea sites reach this array at 18 distinct non-zero offsets, seven of them offsets with no row.

name: counter0202
meaning: A 2-byte counter incremented at 0x00262963 (inc word ptr [rbx + 0x202]); that is the only access, and it sets the width.

name: stepPointStatus
meaning: 512 status bits, one per step point, as sixteen dwords. The verb setsteppointstatus (0x04EF, handler 0x003431B0) sets or clears one bit through 0x0026B800 (0x0026B84E or, 0x0026B859 and; the point is clamped to 0..0x1FF), and setsteppointstatusall (0x04F0, handler 0x00343980) fills all sixteen dwords with 0 or -1 through 0x0026B870 (0x0026B898). The bind 0x0026C8C0 and the slot initialiser's memset (0x00266EFC) zero it.

name: stepPointMarks
meaning: 512 mark bits, one per step point, as sixteen dwords. The verb steppoint (0x04EE, handler 0x00342D80) sets point n's bit and setsteppointmarkstatus (0x04F3, handler 0x00343570) sets or clears it, both through 0x0026B790 (0x0026B7DE or, 0x0026B7E9 and; the point is clamped to 0..0x1FF). The bind 0x0026C8C0 and the slot initialiser's memset (0x00266EFC) zero it.

name: dword0284
meaning: A dword cleared to zero at 0x00262E45 (mov dword ptr [rbx + 0x284], ebp, rbp zero) in the same reset run as +0x1FC and +0x1E0; the slot's last four bytes.

name: shotIndex
meaning: The CAM7 record index on the camera side, copied from the definition table the slot points to: 0x003DA456 mov edx, dword ptr [rcx + rax*8 + 0x14] with rcx = [slot+0xD8] and rax = 2*recordIndex, mirrored at 0x003DD29F from [slot+0xF0]. The source is the CML1 entry's authored +0x04 in a 16-byte element of the definition type, which the load-time resolver never overwrites. 0x003DA050 passes it to the player as the shot to evaluate (0x003DA11E). The 0x18 element stride is 3 x 8, formed by lea rdi, [rsi + rsi*2] at 0x003DA446 and a scale-8 operand, and the builder's writes land on the declared offsets: +0x110 shotIndex (0x003DA471), +0x114 frame (0x003DA47D), +0x118 state (0x003DA484), +0x11A entryNumber (0x003DA462), +0x11C clock (0x003DA44D), +0x120 rate = 0x3F800000 (0x003DA48C), +0x124 clockRunning = 0 (0x003DA497).

name: frame
meaning: The frame the channel plays on, 0 main or 1 sub: a caller argument clamped to non-negative at store time (0x003DA46E cmovns ecx, eax after xor ecx, ecx). camerastart_7e pushes -1 (clamped to 0) and camerastart_7d passes getcamerasubframe() = 1. It is read straight back with movsxd to index a uint16 table in the slot, not in this element (0x003DA4B1/0x003DA4B9 [slot + v*2 + 0x18], 0x003DD2E4/0x003DD2EC [slot + v*2 + 0x1C]), and the value written there is the entry's own index, a reverse lookup from frame to entry. The 0x18 element stride is 3 x 8, formed by lea rdi, [rsi + rsi*2] at 0x003DA446 and a scale-8 operand, and the builder's writes land on the declared offsets: +0x110 shotIndex (0x003DA471), +0x114 frame (0x003DA47D), +0x118 state (0x003DA484), +0x11A entryNumber (0x003DA462), +0x11C clock (0x003DA44D), +0x120 rate = 0x3F800000 (0x003DA48C), +0x124 clockRunning = 0 (0x003DA497).

name: state
meaning: The channel state: 0 idle (camerastop 0x003DA4D0, cameraclear 0x003DA000), 1 playing, 2 finished (0x003DA14E, when the player reaches the end marker); 0x003DA050 skips idle channels and stops advancing the clock at 2. Both builders initialise it to the literal 1 (0x003DA478 mov eax, 1 then 0x003DA484; 0x003DD2A4 then 0x003DD2A9), and the unrolled mirrors FUN_003DA370 and FUN_003DCF60 rewrite it in place. The 0x18 element stride is 3 x 8, formed by lea rdi, [rsi + rsi*2] at 0x003DA446 and a scale-8 operand, and the builder's writes land on the declared offsets: +0x110 shotIndex (0x003DA471), +0x114 frame (0x003DA47D), +0x118 state (0x003DA484), +0x11A entryNumber (0x003DA462), +0x11C clock (0x003DA44D), +0x120 rate = 0x3F800000 (0x003DA48C), +0x124 clockRunning = 0 (0x003DA497).

name: entryNumber
meaning: The CML1 entry number the script passed (the index into the name list, not into CAM7); reset to 0xFFFF. The builders reject the call unless the argument is non-negative and below the count at definitionTable+4 (0x003DA434 cmp r8d, dword ptr [rcx + 4] / jae exit; 0x003DD27E for the B side) and store the accepted value here; it is the index used to fetch definitionValue, so it records which definition row the entry was built from. The 0x18 element stride is 3 x 8, formed by lea rdi, [rsi + rsi*2] at 0x003DA446 and a scale-8 operand, and the builder's writes land on the declared offsets: +0x110 shotIndex (0x003DA471), +0x114 frame (0x003DA47D), +0x118 state (0x003DA484), +0x11A entryNumber (0x003DA462), +0x11C clock (0x003DA44D), +0x120 rate = 0x3F800000 (0x003DA48C), +0x124 clockRunning = 0 (0x003DA497).

name: clock
meaning: Frames since the channel started, a float. The builder stores 0.0 with movss (0x003DA44D movss dword ptr [rbx + rdi*8 + 0x11c], xmm2, with xmm2 zeroed by the verb handlers; 0x003DD293 from xmm6). 0x003DA050 adds frameStep(0x02B4E4B0) * rate once clockRunning is set, and passes it to the player as the absolute time. The 0x18 element stride is 3 x 8, formed by lea rdi, [rsi + rsi*2] at 0x003DA446 and a scale-8 operand, and the builder's writes land on the declared offsets: +0x110 shotIndex (0x003DA471), +0x114 frame (0x003DA47D), +0x118 state (0x003DA484), +0x11A entryNumber (0x003DA462), +0x11C clock (0x003DA44D), +0x120 rate = 0x3F800000 (0x003DA48C), +0x124 clockRunning = 0 (0x003DA497).

name: rate
meaning: Playback speed, 1.0 at start: both builders store the literal 0x3F800000 (1.0f) with an integer mov of the bit pattern (0x003DA48C, 0x003DD2C7). cameraratio and cameraratio_115 set it through 0x003DA2D0 (element +0x10 = slot +0x120 + 0x18*ch), and it multiplies the clock step at 0x003DA0FB. The 0x18 element stride is 3 x 8, formed by lea rdi, [rsi + rsi*2] at 0x003DA446 and a scale-8 operand, and the builder's writes land on the declared offsets: +0x110 shotIndex (0x003DA471), +0x114 frame (0x003DA47D), +0x118 state (0x003DA484), +0x11A entryNumber (0x003DA462), +0x11C clock (0x003DA44D), +0x120 rate = 0x3F800000 (0x003DA48C), +0x124 clockRunning = 0 (0x003DA497).

name: clockRunning
meaning: Whether the channel clock runs: 0 at start; 0x003DA11A sets it on the first positive step, and only then does 0x003DA10D advance the clock, so the first ticked frame evaluates time 0. The A builder clears it at 0x003DA497; the B builder has no write here (it stops after the 1.0f at element +0x10), and the 24-byte element holds this byte on both sides. The 0x18 element stride is 3 x 8, formed by lea rdi, [rsi + rsi*2] at 0x003DA446 and a scale-8 operand, and the builder's writes land on the declared offsets: +0x110 shotIndex (0x003DA471), +0x114 frame (0x003DA47D), +0x118 state (0x003DA484), +0x11A entryNumber (0x003DA462), +0x11C clock (0x003DA44D), +0x120 rate = 0x3F800000 (0x003DA48C), +0x124 clockRunning = 0 (0x003DA497).

name: pad15
meaning: Alignment after clockRunning +0x14 to the 0x18 stride. No recorded access to the entries (ActorManagerSlot +0x110 and +0x170, stride 0x18 x4, among the accesses of the 353 functions that reach the slots) falls here, and no block copy reaches it but the slot clear 0x00266EF0-0x00266F37 (memset 0x288). Zero at load (.bss).

name: recordCount
meaning: the number of entries in the pointer array that follows, and the getter's only bound

name: recordPtr
meaning: the first entry of a pointer array of recordCount entries - ActorManagerSlot's records are reached through this table, not by striding a record array

name: next
meaning: next entry index in whichever list this entry is on; 0xFF ends the list

name: prev
meaning: previous entry index; 0xFF at the head

name: channel
meaning: Channel used for normal list scheduling and requester-notification correlation. Mode4 entries are on the detached list even when this byte is nonnegative; the mode, not only channel sign, selects detached removal.

name: requesterWaitSlot
meaning: the requester's currentWaitSlot (its actor record's +0x11), carried so the release request can re-schedule the requester

name: resourceId
meaning: The id the active-entry search 0x003DBF60 matches against its second argument; the search skips the id test when that argument is negative. Entries are indexed at stride 0x14, the record size: 0x003DB7A0 pre-multiplies the entry index by 5 with a lea and the index scale 4 supplies the rest, against the slotsA0 base (ActorStorageRecord +0xA0); there the entry number is the channel head byte (ActorStorageRecord +0x94[channel] at 0x003DB824, or +0x61 at 0x003DB82F), lea rcx, [rdx + rdx*4] at 0x003DB846 with the base loaded at 0x003DB83F, so 0x003DB84A cmp word ptr [rax + rcx*4 + 4], r14w compares this field of entry i. From the script submitter 0x00268850: the function argument F is popped as a full dword from an integer-tagged value (0x0026890D mov r14d, dword [r8+rdx*4+0x184], no clamp; a float tag converts with cvttss2si at 0x00268901); bit 0x8000 of (target or F) rejects with return 0 (0x0026893F-0x00268948); descriptor +4 is the low word of F (0x002689B6 mov word [rsp+0x24], r14w, descriptor base rsp+0x20). Both routes hand that descriptor to 0x003DBCF0 (0x003DB790: mov r8d, 1 / jmp; 0x003DBAE0: rdx from its r8, call at 0x003DBB01), whose gate is u32(zero-extended word +4) < u32(dword at [target+0x48]) (0x003DBD01 movzx, 0x003DBD0C cmp, 0x003DBD0F jb; failure returns 3 at 0x003DBD11), and the insert copies the word here (0x003DB8BB/0x003DB8BF). So the admitted id is 0..0x7FFF, and F = 0x10000, 0xFFFF0000 and 0x80000000 all present id 0 to the gate. Passing the gate is not acceptance: the free-list gate follows (0x003DBD32 returns 2).

name: actorOrdinal
meaning: The actor ordinal half of an actor reference: the entry's index into its manager's actor pointer array. It is argument 2 of the resolver 0x003587C0, whose argument 1 is the dword at entry+0x08; 0x003587C0 resolves argument 1 through 0x00263FF0 to a slot of the actor-manager slot array 0x02098E10 at stride 0x288, then indexes that slot's array at +0x08 (count at [array], 8-byte pointer elements at [array+8+i*8]), returning null for a negative index or one at or above the count. So the pair (entry+0x08 manager index, entry+0x06 ordinal) has the actor-reference shape the steering-target setter 0x0026ADF0 stores as (+0x04 manager index, +0x00 ordinal); compare ActorWaitSlot +0x24 targetOrdinal. 0x8000 is the no-actor sentinel: the free-list build seeds the dword at +0x04 with 0x80000000 (resourceId 0, ordinal 0x8000), and 0x003DB36B tests for exactly 0x8000 before the release; any other value names the actor that is told to drop the resource. The release path also reads +0x08 (dword, the manager index, 0x003DC0DD/0x003DC104), +0x0C (dword, 0x003DC0FD) and +0x03 (byte, 0x003DC0EA), which have no rows of their own.

name: requesterManagerIndex
meaning: The requester's own manager index: with +0x06 actorOrdinal this is the (manager, ordinal) pair identifying the requesting actor; the release path resolves it back to the requester and files request 0x402 on it.

name: requesterReturnPc
meaning: The low 32 bits of the continuation PC, as an offset relative to the requesting actor's bytecode base. The mode-4 notification lookup matches this and the caller's current channel; it is not a generation or unique request token.

name: state
meaning: Request mode, distinct from +11 runState: tested1 ordinary request,2 notify requester at start,3 notify requester at removal/return,4 detached notification. A mode2/3 notification allocation failure is ignored by the producing start/removal path.

name: runState
meaning: The scheduler run state the channel selector 0x003DB6E0 walks: 0 free (both unlink paths write it, and the free-list build zeroes +0x10 and +0x11 together as one word at 0x003DB5C7); 1 filed, which the selector skips; 2 runnable, which the selector picks and starts; 3 started, written by 0x003DBDC0 as it begins execution. The inserting function takes 1 or 2 as its fourth argument, so the caller chooses filed or runnable. +0x10 is a different field, filled by the same insert from the descriptor's byte 1. Entries are indexed at stride 0x14, the record size: the selector forms lea rcx, [rax + rax*4] at 0x003DB724 from the channel head byte (ActorStorageRecord +0x94[channel] at 0x003DB710), loads the slotsA0 base (ActorStorageRecord +0xA0) at 0x003DB728, and 0x003DB733 movzx ecx, byte ptr [rax + rcx*4 + 0x11] reads this field of entry i.

name: classAndFlag
meaning: Bit 0x1 is the value the entry remover 0x003DB2A0 returns; the bits from 0x2 up are the class that the active-entry search 0x003DBF60 compares after a shift right by one, and that the remover passes to 0x00263050 when the whole byte is >= 2.

name: pad13
meaning: Alignment byte to the 0x14 stride: the entry's bytes +0x00..+0x0F and +0x12 are accessed and +0x13 by nothing. None of the 279 recorded accesses to the record (by 120 functions, through the pool pointer and the +0xA0 / +0xA8 chains) falls here, and no block copy covers the record. Zero from the records block's memset at allocation (0x00861EC0 at 0x00267A8B) and untouched after.

name: kind
meaning: The actor kind for this sequence, shifted into the top three bits of the record's packed_03. The table is what pairs kind with sequence: the writer takes the sequence from a loop counter and the kind from here, merges them, and constrains neither.

name: waitArraySelector
meaning: Selects the wait-array base offset: the region planter adds 0xC8 when this is not 1 and 0xA0 when it is, and the same distinction drives the two element counts at record +0x88 and +0x89. Member 1 of each 4-byte entry (stride 4) of the 8-entry table at 0x01E0C328: both readers address it as [image base + i x 4 + 0x1CEC329] with the index i under mask 0x1F, the record's byte +3 at the first (0x0026656F-0x00266588) and at 0x00266B80-0x00266B83.

name: recordSize
meaning: the per-sequence size of the ActorStorageRecord this sequence allocates. 0x328, 0x3A8, 0x330, 0x348, 0x2D0, 0x6E0, 0x6E0, 0x668 for sequences 0 through 7

name: selfIndex
meaning: written with the array index this record was fetched by (r10w) - the record stores its own slot

name: actorIndexClass
meaning: A two-valued class, 1 or 2, not an index. The initialiser compares the actor's index with a bound held as a word at the entry table's +2 and writes 1 + (index < bound), so no other value occurs. The only reader in the image compares it with the literal 1; no instruction uses it to index anything.

name: packedKindAndSequence
meaning: The kind and sequence of the record, written by the carve loop in 0x002679F0 as (kindCode << 5) + (sequenceWithinKind & 0x1F): the kind in bits 0xE0 and the sequence within the kind in bits 0x1F. The steering-mode setter 0x0026AE90 gates on (value & 0xE0) == 0x60, kind 3. The record initialiser 0x00266530 reads it three times and never writes it.

name: hitObjectBindState
meaning: A hit-object bind state byte. The record initialiser 0x00266530's word store of 0xFF00 covers it and +0x05; the readers make it one byte. The verb 03CF bindhitobj's setter 0x002E3580 stores 3 here on the handler's bound record (rdx convention, the same object the sibling 0x00354E10 reads selfIndex and handleTag4 from), after the release 0x0025AB30 and ahead of the tail call 0x002E3500. The only recorded write besides the initialiser's is the constant 3, so it is a state value, not a counter.

name: signedIndex05
meaning: A signed byte used as an index; a negative value means no entry. 0x003DE5F0 reads it, tests the sign (test al,al / js) and returns doing nothing when it is negative; otherwise it sign-extends it (movsx rax, al), scales it by 0x70 into the table at 0x02B58C50, and clears that entry (a dword at +0, qwords at +8 and +0x10, and a byte at the entry's own +5). So the field selects an entry in a 0x70-stride table, and 0x003DE5F0 is that entry's release path.

name: channelActiveMask
meaning: bit ch is set while resource channel ch has a non-empty entry list, and is cleared the moment removing an entry empties that list. Only the low slotCountA8 bits are used

name: flags08
meaning: A byte of flags. Bit 0x80 is noCheckTouchHeight (verb 020F through 0x0026BED0, which clears it with and 0x7F). Bits 0x2 and 0x4 hold the usemapid code written by the verbs 007B usemapid, 040D partyusemapid and 301D through 0x0026AD60 (an argument other than 0 stores the two-bit value 01, an argument of 0 stores 10). Bit 0x1 is written by 0x00269F00, which clears it (0x00269F00 and byte [rcx+8], 0xFE) and ors in (edx & 1) (0x00269F09); with edx = 0 it tail-jumps to 0x0025B500 (0x00269F0E), and with any other edx it returns (0x00269F14). The result thunk of script command family 0 id 22, 0x00353D00 (rectenable), calls it with edx = 1.

name: flags09
meaning: bit 0x20 cleared (&0xDF), later bit 0x80 cleared (&0x7F)

name: stateByte0A
meaning: A state byte, initialised to 0 from r13b and written by the 0x0046B690 / 0x0046B870 / 0x0046BAC0 family; read at 0x002647EE.

name: flagByte0B
meaning: A flag byte, written from al at initialisation and read-modify-written by five functions, the script VM among them (0x00261602).

name: flags0C
meaning: bit 0x1 cleared (&0xFE), later bits under mask `0x70` cleared (&0x8F)

name: flags0D
meaning: bit 0x20 cleared (&0xDF)

name: flags0E
meaning: A byte of flags whose top nibble is set with OR 0xF0. Bit 0x10 is talkIconStatus (verb 0389 through 0x0026BA60), bit 0x20 navimapDrawStatus (038B through 0x0026AF30) and bit 0x40 targetListStatus (053A through 0x00269FC0); all three verbs write the handler's bound record, which is this record, not BattleStatsRecord +0x00E.

name: partyPresenceCode

name: outstandingRequestCount
meaning: Count of outstanding multi-actor requests this actor has issued: incremented by the multi-actor submitter 0x00268B10 on the counted `REQIALL` path, decremented if non-zero on the target's script `RET` 0x2D / `RETN` 0x2E and when a submit is refused; while it is zero (with +0x02 == 1) the issuer takes immediate insertion 0x003DBB60 instead of the deferred 0x003DBBE0.

name: currentWaitSlot
