meaning: which of each member's three gambit banks is live, one int32 per party stats index. The block's last field: +0x7370 + 40*4 = +0x7410, the block's size

name: battleSystemUp
meaning: The battle system's up flag: 1 once battle storage is up. Boot's battle-work set-up 0x002368D0 writes 0 (0x002368F8) and 0x00236A40 writes 1 when the start-up state 0x0022B6E0 moves to state 1 (0x00236A44, 0x0022B77C). While it is 0 the definition installer 0x0023A570 and the fresh stats record 0x0023AC80 return 0 (0x0023A5B5, 0x0023ACE4) and 0x002342F0 does nothing (0x002342F4). Its rip-relative references are these two stores and the three tests.

name: flags
meaning: bit 0x1 survives a reset. The buffer reset 0x00316CF0 reads this byte, masks bit 0x1 into bl, fills all 0x208 bytes, then clears bit 0x1 with and 0xFE and restores it with or bl, so the reset keeps bit 0x1. The perception refresh tests the same bit directly.

name: keyType
meaning: candidate-selection recipe, key kind (0 no key, 1 int key, 2 float key per the contract); written as the low byte of the word stores at +0x01

name: pickRule
meaning: candidate-selection recipe, pick rule (0 nearest, 1 random, 2 minimum, 3 maximum per the contract); written alone as a byte

name: byte03
meaning: a block byte of the buffer: the buffer clears zero it with the rest of the 0x208 bytes (0x00316CF0, memset at 0x00316D0B; the perception cache's 0x00316D30, memset at 0x00316D4E), and for the instance at unit +0x778 0x0030EDA0 copies it back with the action state +0x6B0-+0xB9F (16-byte store at 0x0030EDE7)

name: count
meaning: how many entries are live. The appender refuses at 32 and increments this after each store; the finder walks exactly this many

name: entries
meaning: thirty-two entries of sixteen bytes. Entry 0 begins at +0x008; the appender stores an ActorWork pointer into the entry's first qword and the finder compares that same qword

name: actorWork
meaning: The pointer the appender 0x00316CD0 stores and the finder compares. Declared void* rather than ActorWork* because ActorWork is not a type the store declares; that it points to an actor work object rests on the appender's symbol name alone.

name: entryFlags
meaning: 4 bytes, of which bit 0x100 selects the variant of the events the HP write dispatches, except 0x200E, which flags bit 0x100 of the call selects whatever this bit is (0x00300846-0x0030084D): a surviving target gets 0x2005 with the bit clear and 0x2006 with it set (0x0030087A), a KO'd one 0x2008 with it clear and 0x2007 with it set (0x00300854-0x00300859). The HP write 0x00300530 searches the source unit's target buffer for the target and reads this field of the entry it finds. The field carries flags; its width comes from that instruction.

name: tail000C
meaning: the entry's last four bytes, after the dword +0x08: zeroed with the buffer by its clears (0x00316CF0, memset at 0x00316D0B; 0x00316D30, memset at 0x00316D4E), and for the buffer at unit +0x778 copied back with the action state by 0x0030EDA0's 16-byte stores (0x0030EDB6-0x0030EE44)

name: actor
meaning: The actor of the target slot, as a registry-entry pointer, cleared to 0 and tested against 0 as a qword (0x00303B9D, 0x0031930C); 0x00322760 reads it for a slot whose +0x788 byte is 8 (0x00322810, 0x0032281A) and encodes it as an actor handle with the registry-entry handle encoder 0x003589B0 (0x00322827), which it returns through its out argument (0x00322839).

name: outcome
meaning: the entry code (0x0030DAE0) of the action previewed again against the unit the Reflect bounce lands on: 0x00303A00 hands its own repeat this slot's +0x08 as the out argument (0x00303B75-0x00303B90), which zeroes it (0x00303A76), stores the code (0x00303B28) and tests it against 8 (0x00303B34)

name: tailPad
meaning: Padding: the last four bytes of the fixed 0x10 (16-byte) entry stride, after the 12 bytes of content, zero-initialised by the pool-slot memset 0x002344D2 (interior of the BattleUnit slot). The recorded battle-unit accesses reach only the +0x00 pointer and the outcome dword at +0x08 (taken by address as arg 5 of 0x00303A00), and every read or write inside that callee is four bytes wide, so not one reaches these bytes. Declared as padding, like LegacyPs2GsDerivedSlotRecord +0x21, so a reimplementation keeps the bytes rather than packing the outcome against the next entry.

name: unitFlags
meaning: The unit's 64-bit flag word, accessed as two dwords: bit 0x1 marks the slot in use (the allocator's free-slot marker); bit 0x200000 is cleared at bind; bits 0x200000000 and 0x800000000000 are the group-completion deferral pair, reached through the high dword. Bits 0x20000000000 and 0x40000000000 (mask 0x600 of the high dword) are set by the script verb 0546 setemergency_one through 0x00311F50 on *(record+0x30), this unit.

name: actorHandle
meaning: The bound actor's encoded registry handle, not a pointer and not a bare index. The handle encoder 0x003589B0 returns 0 for a null actor, else ((((u16)actor[0x16] & 0x7FF) << 4 OR (actor[0x15] & 0xF)) << 16) OR (u16)actor[0x00]; the low 16 bits are the actor's own selfIndex. It is not stable across slot reuse: the actor's 11-bit tag +0x16 advances on re-install and repeats after 2047 advances (ActorStorageRecord +0x016).

name: span000C
meaning: the four bytes between the actor handle +0x08 and the bound actor record +0x10; the slot acquire 0x00234480 zeroes the whole 0xF50-byte slot (0x002344C7-0x002344D2)

name: actorWork
meaning: A non-owning pointer to the bound ActorStorageRecord. The reverse link is ActorStorageRecord +0x30, planted by the same bind.

name: definitionTextRef
meaning: The definition's text reference, the first string of the 5:11 text block.

name: bound
meaning: 1 after the bind walk: 0x00265A20 calls 0x00234A00(unit, 1) for a unit whose actor's +0x30 is set (0x00265AA4-0x00265AB4), and 0x00234A00 stores it (0x00234A00)

name: groupLeaderActorHandle
meaning: The group leader's actor handle; in the unit it is this handle, not the stats record's max HP at the same offset. The periodic combat maintenance 0x00310DB0 writes it (0x00310DE4), and the reuse reset 0x00236A60 zeroes it with +0x28 in one qword store (0x00236AD4). The action commit 0x0030F760 reads it (0x0030F89B, 0x0030F8D5, 0x0030F918) and compares other units' +0x24 with it (0x0030F91B); the target-selector evaluator 0x00301AD0 reads and compares it (0x00301BAC, 0x003024C8, 0x003024F0), as do 0x00305E70 (0x00305EEE) and the relation-mode test 0x0030BD00 (0x0030BDBC).

name: pendingEngageTargetHandle
meaning: A pending engage target handle. 0x00307300, on the target unit, writes it (0x00307798); the engage auto-attack commit 0x00312FA0 reads it into esi (0x00312FAF) and clears it (0x00312FB5); 0x00308270 (0x00308282) and the reaction-animation handler 0x003250F0 (0x003251E3) clear it; 0x0031ADB0 reads it (0x0031B120). The reuse reset zeroes it with +0x24 (0x00236AD4).

name: presentationEventParameter
meaning: A presentation event parameter: the presentation-event dispatch 0x003299B0 stores its r8d argument here (0x003299C2) beside the event id it stores at +0x5C (0x003299EE), and clears it (0x003299F6); 0x00328640 writes it from ebx (0x003286A4, 0x003286AC); 0x00317810 (0x00317819, 0x0031782E) and 0x0032A170 (0x0032A1B1, 0x0032A1BD) clear it; 0x0031ADB0 reads it (0x0031AE36). The reuse reset zeroes it with +0x30 in one qword store (0x00236AD0).

name: killerActorHandle
meaning: The killer's actor handle: the source unit's own +0x08, not a record pointer and not a party index. Written by exactly one instruction, 0x003007E5 in the lethal transition, and only when the killing source resolves to a battle unit (0x003007DD test rbp,rbp): a kill with no source unit leaves the previous value standing rather than clearing it, so a reader cannot treat it as 'who killed this body this time' without checking the death it belongs to. Nothing in the transition ever clears it.

name: span0034
meaning: the four bytes after the killer id +0x30; zeroed with the slot by 0x00234480 (0x002344D2)

name: perUnitFrame
meaning: The per-unit frame callback the world tick calls: the script verbs 3004 and 300C btlAtelSetPoint(2) store their argument qword here through 0x002393E0.

name: laneMapCount
meaning: **the lane map (count at +0, slots from +1) installed by the spawn verbs** (page)

name: hpFloor
meaning: The HP floor the HP write clamps to. The unit-definition apply 0x0023A570 zeroes it on every apply, so no authored unit definition sets it; 0x00239820, reached only from the script VM, sets it from a value, and the verb 3061 btlAtelSetHpLowLimit stores its argument dword here through it. A non-zero floor, below which no delta takes the combatant, is therefore set only by script, and it is lost when the definition is applied again.

name: nativeLifecycleRange
meaning: The range of the native lifecycle check, a float: the lifecycle-mode setter 0x00238FC0 stores it (0x00239006) with the mode +0x50 and the anchor index +0x51, and the range retire check 0x002350C0 reads it (0x0023519C).

name: nativeLifecycleMode
meaning: The native lifecycle mode byte: the lifecycle-mode setter 0x00238FC0 stores it (0x00238FE1), and the range retire check 0x002350C0 compares it with bpl (0x00235104) and reads it (0x00235162).

name: nativeLifecycleAnchorIndex
meaning: The anchor index of the native lifecycle check: the lifecycle-mode setter 0x00238FC0 stores it from sil (0x0023900B), and the range retire check 0x002350C0 reads it (0x0023518A).

name: definitionWord80
meaning: A word copied from the unit definition: the unit-definition apply 0x0023A570 stores it (0x0023AC14) and the reuse reset 0x00236A60 sets it to 0 (0x00236B39); the target-selector evaluator 0x00301AD0 reads it zero-extended (0x003021F3).

name: teamId
meaning: The team the unit belongs to: the script verb 3006 btlAtelSetBelong writes this byte through 0x00239170 (0x00239189) on *(boundRecord+0x30), this unit. The unit-definition apply 0x0023A570 (0x0023AC18) and the reuse reset (0x00236B3D) set it to 0xFF. The relation-mode test 0x0030BD00 compares two units' bytes (0x0030BDCB/0x0030BDD1, 0x0030BDF1/0x0030BDF5, 0x0030BE08/0x0030BE0E); 0x00305E70 compares it with cl (0x00305EC3), and the target-selector evaluator 0x00301AD0 reads it (0x0030329B).

name: definitionTypeByte
meaning: A type byte from the unit definition: the unit-definition apply 0x0023A570 stores it (0x0023ABF0), and the reuse reset sets +0x55..+0x56 to 0xFFFF with one word store (0x00236B35). The target eligibility check 0x003083B0 (0x00308451) and 0x0038D400 (0x0038D4D9) compare it with 0xD; the target-selector evaluator 0x00301AD0 (0x003021CC), the formula context builder 0x003847C0 (0x0038487C) and 0x00386AE0 (0x00386B71) read it.

name: definitionCategoryByte
meaning: A category byte from the unit definition: the unit-definition apply 0x0023A570 stores it (0x0023AC11), and the reuse reset sets it to 0xFF with +0x55 (0x00236B35). 0x002FE950 compares it with 0xF (0x002FE97E); the target-selector evaluator 0x00301AD0 reads it (0x003021EC, and 0x003025FC on another unit), and the chain update on defeat 0x00317ED0 reads it (0x00317F21, 0x003180CC).

name: actorClassByte
meaning: A class-derived byte written at bind from 0x00263D30(actor), the actor's entry group +0xF6. The spawn-entry paths read it with movsx: PrepareRandomCandidate 0x00235620, QueryRangeReentryPending 0x00236682, SetCurrentCandidateState 0x00239435 and ApplyUnitDefinition 0x0023A76E.

name: runtimeCategoryModeSets
meaning: **runtime category mode (4 sets spawn-record flag bit 0x20)** (page)

name: span0059
meaning: the three bytes after +0x58 (the entry group is +0x57), before the qword the reuse reset 0x00236A60 clears at +0x5C (0x00236AF8); zeroed with the slot by 0x00234480 (0x002344D2)

name: lastPresentationEventId
meaning: The id of the last presentation event: the presentation-event dispatch 0x003299B0 stores it from ebx (0x003299EE); 0x00317810 (0x00317835) and 0x0032A170 (0x0032A1C4) store 0x2001 and 0x00328640 stores 0x201C (0x003286B4); the reuse reset zeroes it with +0x60 in one qword store (0x00236AF8). No instruction in the access table reads it.

name: renderRecordSelectorWord
meaning: A selector dword: the periodic combat maintenance 0x00310DB0 writes it (0x00310DEC) and the navigation gate 0x00325D90 reads it (0x00325DC2); the reuse reset zeroes it with +0x5C (0x00236AF8).

name: unitScalar64
meaning: A per-unit float written in the init block (0x0023ABD1 movss) beside +0x68 and +0x6C, and read and written through SSE scalar moves by two functions. The dword +0x64 flag tests in the documents are on the stats record reached through +0x698, not on this field.

name: perceptionRangeThreshold
meaning: The perception range threshold, a float: the unit-definition apply 0x0023A570 stores it (0x0023AC0C), and the perception cache rebuild 0x003247F0 reads it (0x00324992) and compares a value with it (0x00324A7A comiss).

name: definitionFloatB
meaning: A float from the unit definition: the unit-definition apply 0x0023A570 stores it from xmm7 (0x0023ABD6), and the reuse reset zeroes it (0x00236B45). No instruction in the access table reads it.

name: primaryResourceRecoveryAccumulator
meaning: A float accumulator of primary-resource recovery: the recovery accumulator add 0x00329A20 (0x00329A5D addss, 0x00329A62) and 0x00329A80 (0x00329ACB addss, 0x00329AD0) add to it, and 0x00320450 reads it (0x0032048D) and zeroes it (0x00320492), returning it; the reuse reset takes it through 0x00320450 (called at 0x00236B0B).

name: attachedEffectHandle
meaning: The handle of an attached effect, -1 when no effect is attached: the action timeline handler 0x00325260 stores it (0x00325646); the unit teardown 0x00300E40 (0x00300ECB, 0x00300F2E) and 0x00301140 (0x0030129E, 0x003012B3) read it and set it to -1; the reuse reset sets it to -1 (0x00236AF1).

name: span0078
meaning: the eight bytes before the locomotion block at +0x80, after the fields the reuse reset clears at +0x64-+0x6F (0x00236B41, 0x00236B45); zeroed with the slot by 0x00234480 (0x002344D2)

name: embeddedBlock0080
meaning: Head of a 1,552-byte region, +0x80..+0x68F, the part of the unit the locomotion solver and the corridor query work on. The reuse reset 0x00236A60 sets up the clear at 0x00236B12 (lea rcx,[rdi+0x80]), 0x00236B1F (xor edx,edx) and 0x00236B28 (mov r8d,0x610), then calls memset 0x00861EC0 at 0x00236BF0 with nothing changing rcx, rdx or r8 between: memset(unit+0x80, 0, 0x610). The targeted-movement advance 0x002FDC30 forms the same base at 0x002FDC42 and reads block+0xE0 at 0x002FDC5C, inside the 0x610 span. The navigation path state +0x200 (0x490 bytes, its last 1,016 bytes from +0x298) ends at 0x298 + 1016 = 0x690, where this memset ends, so those bytes are cleared as the tail of this region. The agent builder 0x00336710 stores this base at agent+0x108 (0x003367B4), reached with rcx = unit+0x80 from nine of ten call sites (for example 0x00308673 lea / 0x0030867A call 0x0033A240; 0x00317E9D lea / 0x00317EA4 call 0x0033C9B0, which passes it as rdx at 0x0033C9C9); the tenth passes an edited 0x610-byte copy of this region (0x00301830). So agent+0x108's +0x10C, +0x110 and +0x174 are this type's +0x18C, +0x190 and +0x1F4. The store divides +0x80..+0x690 into named rows; this field's 64 bytes are its share of that tiling.

name: actionStateDwordC0
meaning: A dword written with the literal 1 while the standard action state advances; no recorded access reads it.

name: span00C4
meaning: bytes +0x44 to +0x4F of the locomotion block at +0x80 (the block the solver 0x00336CE0 takes as its argument), after its goal kind +0x40; zeroed by the reuse reset 0x00236A60 with +0x80-+0x68F (0x00236B12-0x00236BF0)

name: lastNavigablePosition
meaning: The last position on navigable ground, published as a whole 16-byte vector (+0x50 of the locomotion block at +0x80): written with movups by the world-actor snapshot 0x00236300 (0x0023642A), the locomotion position publisher 0x00300310 (0x00300398), 0x00307300 (0x003079C3) and 0x00311F70 (0x00312062). Read as a vector by the action precondition check 0x00301830 (0x003018B1), the order-goal decoder 0x00312730 (0x003128DD; it also passes the address at 0x00312838 to 0x00312DF0, which reads it at 0x00312E24), 0x00319110 (0x00319119, 0x0031912C) and the path reset 0x003291B0 (0x003291DD, 0x003291F0). The combat navigation step 0x00325BB0 passes its address (0x00325C02) to the path builder 0x00383620, which reads it (0x00383627), and the standard action-state advance 0x00304850 forms the address at 0x00304B4D and 0x00304D93.

name: releaseWorldPos
meaning: The unit's world position: written at 0x003003A2 by the locomotion position publisher 0x00300310, read at 0x00265043 by the actor position getter 0x00265020 and by the target-selector evaluator 0x00301AD0, and copied to the spawn record at release (0x0023428A, in the battle-unit slot release 0x00234200).

name: currentWaypointX
meaning: The x of the current waypoint, the locomotion block's step point +0x70: the waypoint selector 0x00383670 writes the chosen waypoint's x here (0x00383713), its z at +0xF8 (0x00383718) and the position's y at +0xF4 (0x00383721), with the address passed by the combat navigation step 0x00325BB0 (0x00325C51). The solver-context builder 0x00336710 copies x, y and z as three dwords (0x00336757, 0x0033675D, 0x00336763) and sets its own w to 1.0. The three are written and copied as separate dwords; the one wider access is the action precondition check 0x00301830's 16-byte read from +0xF0 (0x003018C1).

name: currentWaypointY
meaning: The y of the current waypoint (+0xF0 x, +0xF8 z): the waypoint selector 0x00383670 writes the position's y here (0x00383721), and the solver-context builder 0x00336710 copies it as a dword (0x0033675D).

name: currentWaypointZ
meaning: The z of the current waypoint (+0xF0 x, +0xF4 y): the waypoint selector 0x00383670 writes the chosen waypoint's z here (0x00383718), and the solver-context builder 0x00336710 copies it as a dword (0x00336763).

name: span00FC
meaning: the fourth dword of the locomotion block's step point +0x70 (unit +0xF0): the solver context copies only its x, y and z and sets its own w to 1.0 (0x00336757-0x00336769); zeroed by the reuse reset (0x00236BF0)

name: pathGoal
meaning: The goal the path solver works toward, a 16-byte vector: 0x00319110 (0x0031911C) and the path reset 0x003291B0 (0x003291E0) write it with movups. The action precondition check 0x00301830 reads it (address at 0x0030188E, movups read at 0x00301887 on the next pass), the solver-context builder 0x00336710 reads it (0x00336770), and the path builder 0x00383620 reads it (0x00383639) through the address the combat navigation step 0x00325BB0 forms (0x00325C15, 0x00325C60).

name: secondaryTarget
meaning: A second target vector, written beside the goal +0x100 with 16-byte movups stores by 0x00319110 (0x00319130) and the path reset 0x003291B0 (0x003291F8); the solver-context builder 0x00336710 reads it (0x00336792).

name: followGoalPosition
meaning: The party-follow goal position: the party-follow goal apply 0x003246C0 (called only from 0x00234590 at 0x0023485C) stores lanes 0-2 (0x00324737, 0x0032474E, 0x00324765) from the follow-destination lookup 0x00339A60's output +0x00, which is the first 16-byte group of the follow-table entry whose first byte matches the unit's +0xEA9 (table 0x022C7E00, stride 0x60, groups from 0x022C7E30; 0x00339A9D-0x00339B53) or otherwise the follow target's position from 0x002646C0 (0x00339AC3-0x00339AF6, 0x00339B62-0x00339B9A); the goal decoder 0x00312730 reads it as one 16-byte group in its order-0x4124 arm (0x00312AA3) after checking the unit looked up from +0x24 exists and is not this unit (0x00312A91-0x00312AA1) and again in its order-0x4022 arm (0x003128CB), and the move handler 0x002FDA60 passes it on to 0x003291B0 (0x002FDAE9-0x002FDAFE); lane 3 (+0x12C) is never stored by 0x003246C0 and is read only within the group; zeroed by the reuse reset 0x00236A60's memset of +0x80..+0x68F (0x00236B12-0x00236BF0).

name: followGoalVector2
meaning: The party-follow goal's second vector: 0x003246C0 stores lanes 0-2 (0x0032477C, 0x00324793, 0x003247AA) from 0x00339A60's output +0x10, the matched follow-table entry's second 16-byte group or, without a match, the follow target's position again. 0x00312730's order-0x4124 arm reads it as one group (0x00312AB5), and 0x002FDA60 passes it as the third argument of 0x003291B0, the path reset 0x003291B0 (0x002FDAE9-0x002FDAFE). Lane 3 (+0x13C) is as for +0x12C. Zeroed by the reuse reset 0x00236A60 (0x00236B12-0x00236BF0).

name: solvedStepX
meaning: The x of the solved step: the step solver 0x00336CE0 writes x, y and z as three floats (0x00336DE1; +0x144 at 0x00336DEF, +0x148 at 0x00336DFD). The locomotion position publisher 0x00300310, handed +0x140 by 0x003003F0 (0x00300415), compares it (0x0030034A ucomiss), reads it (0x00300388) and loads the 16 bytes from +0x140 with movaps (0x00300391, 0x0030039F, 0x003003CB); the combat navigation step 0x00325BB0 forms its address at 0x00325D3B.

name: solvedStepY
meaning: The y of the solved step: written by the step solver 0x00336CE0 (0x00336DEF), and compared and read by the locomotion position publisher 0x00300310 (0x00300357 ucomiss, 0x00300383).

name: solvedStepZ
meaning: The z of the solved step: written by the step solver 0x00336CE0 (0x00336DFD), and compared and read by the locomotion position publisher 0x00300310 (0x00300365 ucomiss, 0x0030037B).

name: span014C
meaning: the fourth dword after the locomotion block's detour point copy +0xC0-+0xC8, which the solver 0x00336CE0 writes as three floats (0x00336DE1-0x00336DFD); zeroed by the reuse reset (0x00236BF0)

name: approachDiameter
meaning: The approach diameter: the `FCP` install 0x00239E10 stores twice the effective approach radius +0x17C here (0x0023A017 read, 0x0023A03F store). The standard action-state advance 0x00304850 overwrites it, through the locomotion block base unit+0x80, with a float (0x00304CA0) or with 0.1 (0x3DCCCCCD, 0x00304CBA).

name: followApproachDiameter
meaning: The fourth float of the party-follow goal that the party-follow goal apply 0x003246C0 stores on every party unit (from the field frame orchestrator 0x00234590 at 0x0023485C, when a navigation dataset is loaded; see the frame update order page): -1.0 first (0x003246FE), then the value the follow-destination lookup 0x00339A60 computes (local +0x50): the first float of the matched follow-table entry's +0x20 group (0x022C7E30 + 0x60 x i + 0x20, 0x00339B27-0x00339B53) or, without a match, the larger of two radii from 0x00265090 plus the constant 0x008C5F6C (0x00339B07-0x00339B22, 0x00339BCC-0x00339BDB), unless bit 0x20 of 0x02089340 is set (0x003247B7-0x003247C1), beside the goal position +0x120..+0x128 and the second vector +0x130..+0x138 (0x00324737-0x003247AA); the order-goal decoder 0x00312730 returns it through its fifth argument for order 0x4124 (arm 0x00312A91, selected at 0x00312983; 0x00312AC0-0x00312ACB) and the move handler 0x002FDA60 stores it into the locomotion state's approach diameter +0x150 (0x002FDAE3-0x002FDAF3: [rsp+0x30] to [rdi+0xD0], rdi = unit + 0x80); the reuse reset 0x00236A60 zeroes it with its memset of +0x80..+0x68F (0x00236B12-0x00236BF0).

name: solverScalarA
meaning: A float of the locomotion solver: the step solver 0x00336CE0 (0x00336D95) and 0x0033A240 (0x0033A334) write it, the combat navigation step 0x00325BB0 stores esi into it (0x00325D1E, 0x00325D46), the world-actor snapshot 0x00236300 sets it to 0 (0x00236359), and the movement-intent apply 0x0023A070 reads it (0x0023A0EB).

name: motionYaw
meaning: The unit's motion yaw: written by the world-actor snapshot 0x00236300 (0x00236328), 0x003003F0 (0x0030041E), 0x00307300 (0x00307A03), 0x00311F70 (0x003120A7), the step solver 0x00336CE0 (0x00336DA6) and 0x0033A240 (0x0033A345); the solver-context builder 0x00336710 reads it (0x003367E1).

name: currentHeading
meaning: The locomotion state's current heading (st+0xE0; st = BattleUnit+0x80): read as `cur` by the angle approach 0x00334120 in every solver, written by the solver publish (0x00336DC5/0x0033A35E, source ctx+0xBC) and by the facing publish (0x00300426/0x00310B00/0x003120AF, source = caller-supplied facing, unnormalized). A yaw the party combat stance writes; copied to spawn record +0x74 at release.

name: fcpParam4
meaning: A float tunable, `FCP` parameter 4. The `FCP` install 0x00239E10 passes its address (lea at 0x00239ED4) to 0x003204E0 with parameter index 4. 0x003204E0 stores the authored float from 0x002ECE50 at 0x0032053D, then, by parameter index, divides it by the scale 0x00265240 returns (0x00320560, 0x0032056A) or multiplies it by that scale (0x00320576, 0x0032057A), and multiplies it by the time-base scale at 0x01DFE0BC (0x003205B5, 0x003205B9); its integer path stores the result of 0x002ECE80 at 0x00320590. No other instruction in the access table reaches it.

name: fcpParam5
meaning: A float tunable, `FCP` parameter 5. The `FCP` install 0x00239E10 passes its address (lea at 0x00239EE6) to 0x003204E0 with parameter index 5. 0x003204E0 stores the authored float from 0x002ECE50 at 0x0032053D, then, by parameter index, divides it by the scale 0x00265240 returns (0x00320560, 0x0032056A) or multiplies it by that scale (0x00320576, 0x0032057A), and multiplies it by the time-base scale at 0x01DFE0BC (0x003205B5, 0x003205B9); its integer path stores the result of 0x002ECE80 at 0x00320590. No other instruction in the access table reaches it.

name: fcpParam3or10
meaning: The slow turn rate, `FCP` parameter 3, or 10 for a spawn-backed unit (stats record byte +0x05 = 1) whose definition row byte +0x13 is not 0xFF (0x00239E3D-0x00239E5A). It is st+0xEC on the locomotion state, read as the step argument of the angle approach 0x00334120 (0x00336595/0x00336650/0x0033A665/0x0033A68E/0x0033B3D8/0x0033CE8D), selected by a flag against st+0xF0, the fast rate. The `FCP` install 0x00239E10 passes its address (lea at 0x00239E9B) to 0x003204E0, which stores the authored value unclamped at 0x0032053D; by parameter index it then divides it by the scale 0x00265240 returns (0x00320560, 0x0032056A) or multiplies it by that scale (0x00320576, 0x0032057A), and multiplies it by the time-base scale at 0x01DFE0BC (0x003205B5, 0x003205B9); the integer path stores at 0x00320590. The reuse reset zeroes it.

name: fcpParam25
meaning: A float tunable, `FCP` parameter 25. The `FCP` install 0x00239E10 passes its address (lea at 0x00239EF8) to 0x003204E0 with parameter index 25. 0x003204E0 stores the authored float from 0x002ECE50 at 0x0032053D, then, by parameter index, divides it by the scale 0x00265240 returns (0x00320560, 0x0032056A) or multiplies it by that scale (0x00320576, 0x0032057A), and multiplies it by the time-base scale at 0x01DFE0BC (0x003205B5, 0x003205B9); its integer path stores the result of 0x002ECE80 at 0x00320590. No other instruction in the access table reaches it.

name: motionPitch
meaning: The unit's motion pitch: written by the world-actor snapshot 0x00236300 (0x00236339), the step solver 0x00336CE0 (0x00336DB7) and 0x0033A240 (0x0033A356); read by the movement-intent apply 0x0023A070 (0x0023A0C0) and the solver-context builder 0x00336710 (0x003367ED).

name: fcpLength0or7
meaning: A float length tunable, `FCP` parameter 0, or 7 for a spawn-backed unit (stats record byte +0x05 = 1) whose definition row byte +0x13 is not 0xFF (0x00239E3D-0x00239E5A). The `FCP` install 0x00239E10 passes its address (lea at 0x00239E80) to 0x003204E0, which stores the authored float from 0x002ECE50 at 0x0032053D, then, by parameter index, divides it by the scale 0x00265240 returns (0x00320560, 0x0032056A) or multiplies it by that scale (0x00320576, 0x0032057A), and multiplies it by the time-base scale at 0x01DFE0BC (0x003205B5, 0x003205B9); its integer path stores the result of 0x002ECE80 at 0x00320590. No other instruction in the access table reaches it.

name: effectiveApproachRadius
meaning: The job-scaled approach radius; in the unit it is this radius, not the stats record's status timers at the same offset. The `FCP` install 0x00239E10 copies `FCP` length +0x180 here (0x00239F6B) and stores twice its value into +0x150 (0x0023A017); the world-actor snapshot 0x00236300 then stores the value 0x00233A20 computes from +0x180 (call at 0x002363FA, store at 0x002363FF).

name: fcpLength1or8
meaning: A float length tunable, `FCP` parameter 1, or 8 for a spawn-backed unit (stats record byte +0x05 = 1) whose definition row byte +0x13 is not 0xFF (0x00239E3D-0x00239E5A). The `FCP` install 0x00239E10 passes its address (lea at 0x00239E66) to 0x003204E0, which stores the authored float from 0x002ECE50 at 0x0032053D, then, by parameter index, divides it by the scale 0x00265240 returns (0x00320560, 0x0032056A) or multiplies it by that scale (0x00320576, 0x0032057A), and multiplies it by the time-base scale at 0x01DFE0BC (0x003205B5, 0x003205B9); its integer path stores the result of 0x002ECE80 at 0x00320590. 0x00239E10 then copies it to +0x17C (0x00239F65), and 0x00233A20, called by 0x00236300 (0x002363FA), reads it and multiplies by it (0x00233A32, 0x00233A72, 0x00233A88).

name: fcpLength2or9
meaning: A float length tunable, `FCP` parameter 2, or 9 for a spawn-backed unit (stats record byte +0x05 = 1) whose definition row byte +0x13 is not 0xFF (0x00239E3D-0x00239E5A). The `FCP` install 0x00239E10 passes its address (lea at 0x00239EBA) to 0x003204E0, which stores the authored float from 0x002ECE50 at 0x0032053D, then, by parameter index, divides it by the scale 0x00265240 returns (0x00320560, 0x0032056A) or multiplies it by that scale (0x00320576, 0x0032057A), and multiplies it by the time-base scale at 0x01DFE0BC (0x003205B5, 0x003205B9); its integer path stores the result of 0x002ECE80 at 0x00320590. 0x00239E10 then reads it (0x0023A006) and passes it with the unit's actor to 0x002E86B0.

name: candidatePositionY
meaning: **the candidate-position y adjustment at activation** (page)

name: collisionExtentA
meaning: The first of two collision extents: the world-actor snapshot 0x00236300 forms the addresses of +0x18C and +0x190 (0x002363DA, 0x002363D3), and the float-pair copy 0x003DA710, called by 0x00265090 (0x002650A5), writes the pair (0x003DA717 here). The solver-context builder 0x00336710 reads it (0x003367C2) and takes the larger of it and +0x190 (0x003367CA maxss).

name: collisionExtentB
meaning: The second of two collision extents: the world-actor snapshot 0x00236300 forms its address (0x002363D3), the float-pair copy 0x003DA710, called by 0x00265090 (0x002650A5), writes it (0x003DA721), and the solver-context builder 0x00336710 takes the larger of +0x18C and it (0x003367CA maxss).

name: movementStateD4Snapshot
meaning: A snapshot float of the movement state: the world-actor snapshot 0x00236300 stores it (0x002363F2), its only recorded access. In the unit it is this float, not the licence page's 46-byte mask.

name: fcpParam27
meaning: A float tunable, `FCP` parameter 27. The `FCP` install 0x00239E10 passes its address (lea at 0x00239F0A) to 0x003204E0 with parameter index 27. 0x003204E0 stores the authored float from 0x002ECE50 at 0x0032053D, then, by parameter index, divides it by the scale 0x00265240 returns (0x00320560, 0x0032056A) or multiplies it by that scale (0x00320576, 0x0032057A), and multiplies it by the time-base scale at 0x01DFE0BC (0x003205B5, 0x003205B9); its integer path stores the result of 0x002ECE80 at 0x00320590. No other instruction in the access table reaches it.

name: presentationYOffsetRamp
meaning: A presentation y-offset ramp, a float: the `FCP` install 0x00239E10 sets it to 0.08 (0x3DA3D70A, 0x0023A035), and 0x003057D0 reads it (0x0030583D) and stores it back (0x00305867).

name: orderRangeBand0
meaning: Locomotion-order range band 0: the advance copies the action block's +0x6D4 here when it hands the order to locomotion (0x00304BF3), the first of a three-dword mirror of +0x6D4..+0x6DC; zeroed by cancel. No recorded access on any route reads it.

name: orderRangeBand1
meaning: Locomotion-order range band 1, copied from the action block's +0x6D8 (0x00304BFF); the second of the +0x1A0..+0x1A8 mirror. 0x00339630 reads it as a float, as a stop distance: the unit's own at 0x0033967E and 0x00339694 and the target's at 0x00339687.

name: orderRangeBand2
meaning: Locomotion-order range band 2, a copy of the unit's own +0x6DC (0x00304C0F): the last of a three-dword run, +0x1A0 from +0x6D4, +0x1A4 from +0x6D8 and +0x1A8 from +0x6DC, written back to back at 0x00304BF6/0x00304BFF/0x00304C0F, which publishes part of the +0x6B0 region into the +0x80 region. 0x00339630 reads it as a float, as a stop distance (0x0033969D).

name: fcpParam32
meaning: A float tunable, `FCP` parameter 32. The `FCP` install 0x00239E10 passes its address (lea at 0x00239F4E) to 0x003204E0 with parameter index 32. 0x003204E0 stores the authored float from 0x002ECE50 at 0x0032053D, then, by parameter index, divides it by the scale 0x00265240 returns (0x00320560, 0x0032056A) or multiplies it by that scale (0x00320576, 0x0032057A), and multiplies it by the time-base scale at 0x01DFE0BC (0x003205B5, 0x003205B9); its integer path stores the result of 0x002ECE80 at 0x00320590. No other instruction in the access table reaches it.

name: fcpParam31
meaning: A float tunable, `FCP` parameter 31. The `FCP` install 0x00239E10 passes its address (lea at 0x00239F3C) to 0x003204E0 with parameter index 31. 0x003204E0 stores the authored float from 0x002ECE50 at 0x0032053D (movss dword ptr [rbx], xmm0), then, by parameter index, divides it by the scale 0x00265240 returns (0x00320560, 0x0032056A) or multiplies it by that scale (0x00320576, 0x0032057A), and multiplies it by the time-base scale at 0x01DFE0BC (0x003205B5, 0x003205B9); its integer path stores the result of 0x002ECE80 at 0x00320590. 0x00320576 and 0x003205B5 are mulss xmm0, dword ptr [rbx], arithmetic on the field as a float, so it is a float, like fcpParam32 beside it at +0x1AC.

name: span01B4
meaning: bytes +0x134 to +0x13F of the locomotion block, between its sidestep odds +0x130 and its direction +0x140; zeroed by the reuse reset (0x00236BF0)

name: overrideVector
meaning: An override vector of 16 bytes, written with movups by 0x00329B00 (0x00329B40), the same function that sets and clears bit 0x200 of the locomotion flags +0x1F0 (0x00329B33, 0x00329B52). No instruction in the access table reads it.

name: locomotionTargetHandle
meaning: The locomotion target handle: the standard action-state advance 0x00304850 stores it (0x00304BE3 mov dword ptr [rbx + 0x150], eax, rbx = unit + 0x80), and the solver-context builder 0x00336710 reads it twice (0x003369B3, 0x003369C5 mov ecx, dword ptr [rsi + 0x150]). These three are integer moves; two further recorded accesses use movss, and no float arithmetic touches it, so it is a uint32.

name: span01D4
meaning: bytes +0x154 to +0x15F of the locomotion block, between its target handle +0x150 and its goal kind +0x160; zeroed by the reuse reset (0x00236BF0)

name: orderStateWord1E0
meaning: The order's state marker: the advance sets it to 3 when it hands the order to locomotion (0x00304BD3), in the same block as the literal 1 at +0x0C0; no recorded access reads it.

name: span01E4
meaning: bytes +0x164 to +0x16F of the locomotion block, between its goal kind +0x160 and its flags +0x170 (unit +0x1F0); zeroed by the reuse reset (0x00236BF0)

name: locomotionFlags
meaning: A dword of locomotion flags. In the unit: bit 0x4 is set or cleared by the `FCP` install 0x00239E10 from `FCP` parameter 24 (0x00239F73, 0x00239F7C); bit 0x100 is cleared by the action-state advance 0x00307BE0 (0x00307BFC); bit 0x200 is set and cleared by 0x00329B00 (0x00329B33, 0x00329B52); bit 0x1000 is set by 0x002392D0 (0x00239320) and tested by the world-actor snapshot 0x00236300 (0x0023638E); bit 0x2000 is set and cleared by 0x0023A120 (0x0023A136, 0x0023A146); bits 0x3000 are tested by the navigation gate 0x00325D90 (0x00325D96). Through the locomotion block (its +0x170): the combat navigation step 0x00325BB0 sets and clears bits 0x1 (0x00325C89, 0x00325C92), 0x2 (0x00325CB0, 0x00325CB9), 0x8 (0x00325CC9, 0x00325CD2) and 0x10 (0x00325CF4, 0x00325CFD), tests bit 0x400 (0x00325D0F) and reads and writes the dword (0x00325D29, 0x00325D4F); the standard action-state advance 0x00304850 sets and clears bit 0x20 (0x00304C08, 0x00304AB2), and the action cancel 0x003105D0 clears it (0x00310751); the step solver 0x00336CE0 stores the dword (0x00336DD3) and the solver-context builder 0x00336710 reads it (0x00336827).

name: placementMode
meaning: The placement mode, 1, 2 or 3: the `FCP` install 0x00239E10 stores esi here (0x0023A02E), 1 by default, 2 for a spawn-backed unit (stats record byte +0x05 = 1), and 3 when bit 0x8 of +0x1F6 is also set, after a call to 0x00236210 (0x00239FEC-0x00239FFE). The combat navigation step 0x00325BB0 reads it (0x00325C06), and 0x003357B0 compares it with 3 (0x0033596E).

name: fcpParam26
meaning: A byte from `FCP` parameter 26: the `FCP` install 0x00239E10 installs parameter 26 into a stack slot (lea r8, [rsp + 0x68] at 0x00239F2C) and stores its low byte here (0x00239F88). No instruction in the access table reads it.

name: heightProbeGate
meaning: The height-probe gate byte, computed by the `FCP` install 0x00239E10 and stored at 0x00239FD4: 1 for a unit whose stats record byte +0x05 is 0; otherwise from the class row +0xE68 byte +0x18, 8 when its bit 0x10 is set and 1 + (bit 0x20 set) when it is not, with bit 0x4 added when bit 0x40 is set (0x00239FAB-0x00239FD1). The spawn activation 0x0023A410 tests bit 0x8 (0x0023A49E).

name: ownerSlotIndex
meaning: The owner slot index: the world-actor snapshot 0x00236300 stores it (0x00236314), and the solver-context builder 0x00336710 reads it (0x00336805).

name: span01F8
meaning: the eight bytes between the locomotion block's slot byte +0x177 (unit +0x1F7) and the navigation path state at +0x200; zeroed by the reuse reset (0x00236BF0)

name: navigationPathState
meaning: The unit's navigation path state, the whole 0x490-byte child: currentNodeIndex, pathEndpoints, the 128-byte predecessor table and the 1024-byte nodePositionXZ table.

name: animationEventFlags
meaning: A dword of animation event flags. The event handlers set bits: the reaction-animation handler 0x003250F0 bit 0x1 (0x003251BE), the action timeline handler 0x00325260 bit 0x2 (0x00325695), 0x0030BC40 bit 0x4 (0x0030BC8F, after testing it at 0x0030BC46; read at 0x0030BC96), and the actor timeline handler 0x00319F50 bit 0x8 (0x0031A031). The standard action-state advance 0x00304850 holds its address in r12 (0x00304886), stores r14d (0x00304971, 0x00304DE7), reads it (0x00304F91), sets bit 0x1 (0x00304FBE) and tests it (0x00304FC3). Cleared to 0 by 0x00308270 (0x003082D5), 0x00309990 (0x003099D5), the resolved presentation dispatch 0x0030FE10 (0x0030FE16), the action cancel 0x003105D0 (0x00310658) and 0x00313120 (0x003132C3).

name: presentationSlot0
meaning: The first of three presentation slot bytes, 0xFF when free. The presentation slot acquire 0x0030CFB0 tests it for 0xFF (0x0030CFBF) and stores the slot it takes (0x0030D056), through the base +0x690 that the standard action-state advance 0x00304850 passes (0x00304E24). Read and set back to 0xFF by the standard action-state advance 0x00304850 (0x00304B6F, 0x00304B7A; also read at 0x00304E2C), 0x00306760 (0x00306766, 0x0030678B), the resolved presentation dispatch 0x0030FE10 (0x0030FE23, 0x0030FE3D), 0x00310780 (0x00310812, 0x00310825) and 0x00313120 (0x003132C9, 0x003132E3). The reuse reset sets it to 0xFF (0x00236A8C).

name: presentationSlot1
meaning: The second presentation slot byte, 0xFF when free; the reuse reset sets +0x695..+0x696 to 0xFFFF (0x00236A7C). 0x00306760 (0x0030677C cmp 0xFF, 0x00306785 store), the resolved presentation dispatch 0x0030FE10 (0x0030FE2E, 0x0030FE37) and 0x00313120 (0x003132D4, 0x003132DD) fill it when it is 0xFF. The standard action-state advance 0x00304850 (0x00304B80, 0x00304B8B), 0x00306760 (0x00306877, 0x00306891), 0x00308270 (0x00308289, 0x00308295), 0x00309990 (0x00309A49, 0x00309A55) and the action cancel 0x003105D0 (0x00310611, 0x0031061D) read it and set it to 0xFF; 0x0030BC40 (0x0030BC52) and 0x0030CA50 (0x0030CA50) read it.

name: presentationSlot2
meaning: The third presentation slot byte, 0xFF when free (set with +0x695 by the reuse reset, 0x00236A7C): 0x00306760 fills it when it is 0xFF (0x00306882, 0x0030688B), and the standard action-state advance 0x00304850 (0x00304B91, 0x00304B9C) and the action cancel 0x003105D0 (0x00310624, 0x00310633) read it and set it to 0xFF.

name: span0697
meaning: the byte after the three bytes +0x694-+0x696 the reuse reset sets to 0xFF and 0xFFFF, before the combat stats record pointer +0x698; zeroed with the slot by 0x00234480 (0x002344D2)

name: statsRecord
meaning: Pointer to this unit's 0x1C8-byte BattleStatsRecord. It is always a BattleStatsRecord, but its storage owner depends on the unit kind. The unit-definition apply 0x0023A570 takes kind = definitionId >> 8 (0x0023A626 test esi,esi / 0x0023A62E cmp esi,1) and binds different objects per kind. Kind 0 (party): +0x698 = *(0x02EBF190) + 8 + slot*0x1C8, the BattleSystemState array element (0x0023AAAA mov r15, [rip->0x02EBF190] ... 0x0023AAC1 add r15, rcx, stored at 0x0023ABFA); +0x6A0 = 0 (0x0023AAB1 xor ebp,ebp); +0xE68 is not written, and the reset at 0x00236AC2 leaves it 0. Because the binder computes that element's address, 0x0031B770 finds a unit by comparing this field for equality with it. Kind 1 (spawn-backed): +0x698 = the SpawnKeep entry + 0x80 (0x0023A776 call 0x00236100, the primary-entry resolver, 0x0023A77B mov rbp,rax, 0x0023A787 sub rax,-0x80, saved to [rsp+0x90] at 0x0023A795 and reloaded into r15 at 0x0023AA15/0x0023AA2F before the same store at 0x0023ABFA), initialised by the stats-record initialiser 0x0023AC80 on entry+0x80 at 0x0023A7A9 when [rbp] & 5 == 0; +0x6A0 = the SpawnKeep entry itself (0x0023AC01); +0xE68 = the .ard slot-0 class row. The function has no other rbp or r15 assignment. The byte +5 tested at 0x0023425D is the stats record's own byte 5.

name: spawnRecord
meaning: The owning SpawnRecord (0x250), installed from the primary-entry resolver 0x00236100 and null-tested before any use of it in the installer.

name: span06A8
meaning: the eight bytes between the spawn record pointer +0x6A0 and the command word +0x6B0; zeroed with the slot by 0x00234480 (0x002344D2)

name: commandStanceFlags
meaning: A flags word. Bit 0x1 is the party combat-stance entry flag (set at 0x00312F33). Bit 0x2 marks a command that is issued and waiting to be committed: IssueCommand clears it (0x00311D81) and sets it (0x00311D8C), and CommitAction (0x0030F865..72) and the five action-state resets consume and clear it; four functions clear it with and dword ptr [...], 0xFFFFFFFD.

name: actionPhaseLiterals
meaning: **the action phase (literals 2, 5, 9 by the action code)** (page)

name: aiOrderSubgroup
meaning: The AI order subgroup byte: the reuse reset clears it (0x00236BA3), and the next-action selector 0x00305AB0 reads it into r8d (0x00305C34) as it selects the next order.

name: pendingResultCount
meaning: The count of pending results, a byte: the action commit 0x0030F760 sets it to 1 (0x0030F894), the target-set builder 0x0030D160 compares and stores it (0x0030D205, 0x0030D249), the target processor 0x00307300 reads and stores it (0x003073D7, 0x0030743B, 0x0030744B), and the action cancel 0x003105D0 zeroes it (0x0031060A). Readers compare it with an index or 0: 0x002FEAD0 (0x002FEB45), the target preview 0x00303830 (0x00303854, 0x0030395B), 0x0030C0E0 (0x0030C149), 0x0030C210 (0x0030C276), the formula target preview 0x00385680 (0x00385735), 0x004698C0 (0x004698FD) and the post-result event dispatch 0x00469EC0 (0x0046A01E, 0x0046A120).

name: comboCountByte
meaning: The combo count, an unsigned byte: TryContinueComboSequence writes it (0x0030FA79), cancel clears it with a word store (0x003106EB), and RollAndStoreComboCount (0x0038868A) and EvaluateTargetPreview (0x003857C6) read it zero-extended; a fourth function compares it with 0.

name: savedAndRestoredAcross
meaning: **saved and restored across the combo continue, cleared with `+0x6B7`** (page)

name: pendingResultSlotIndex0
meaning: The head of pendingResultSlotIndices, the battle-slot index list written at commit from byte +8 of the reservation-stash row (0x0030F878..8E); read at 0x00385756 by the formula target preview 0x00385680.

name: span06BA
meaning: bytes +0x6BA to +0x6BF at the head of the action state +0x6B0-+0xB9F, which 0x0030EDA0 restores as a whole from the saved block at [+0xB88] (the copy loop 0x0030EDB6-0x0030EE07 nine times 0x80 bytes, then 0x70 bytes at 0x0030EE09-0x0030EE44)

name: actionScopedBlockA
meaning: A 16-byte block of the action state: the action precondition check 0x00301830 stores it with movups (0x00301A0F), and the candidate buffer builder 0x0030F130 passes its address on (0x0030F219). The action snapshot carries it: the action-state snapshot 0x0030EFF0 reads it (0x0030F06B) and the action-state restore 0x0030EDA0 writes it back (0x0030EDCF), in their 0x80-byte copy loops.

name: actionScopedFloat
meaning: Four bytes written both as an integer dword and as a float: 0x00238AB0 (0x00238AC6) and the action precondition check 0x00301830 (0x003019FA) store a float, the candidate buffer builder 0x0030F130 reads it (0x0030F140) and adds it (0x0030F231 addss), and the reuse reset stores a dword 0 (0x00236BA9). The action cancel 0x003105D0 zeroes it with the next four bytes in one qword store (0x0031070E), a two-field zeroing store rather than an 8-byte field. The action snapshot carries it (0x0030F073 read, 0x0030EDD7 write).

name: effectiveRangeBand0
meaning: Effective range band 0: the range-band computation 0x002FEB80 writes it through its fourth out-pointer (0x002FED0F), and the advance copies it, when it hands the order to locomotion, into orderRangeBand0 +0x1A0; cancel clears it (0x0031074B, ebp = 0).

name: effectiveRangeBand1
meaning: Effective range band 1, written through the fifth out-pointer of the range-band computation 0x002FEB80 (0x002FED21); cancel clears it with two qword stores (0x00310707/0x00310744 cover +0x6D8..+0x6DF).

name: effectiveRangeBand2
meaning: Effective range band 2, written through the sixth out-pointer of the range-band computation 0x002FEB80 (0x002FED32); read and written in the same function, and copied into +0x1A8.

name: aiOrderSetVariant
meaning: Pointer to the selected AI order set variant: the order-set variant selector 0x00239040 (0x00239081, 0x00239093) and the unit-definition apply 0x0023A570 (0x0023A95E, 0x0023AB9F) store it, the reuse reset zeroes it (0x00236BC4), and the next-action selector 0x00305AB0 reads it (0x00305C3E). The action snapshot carries it (0x0030F07B read, 0x0030EDDF write).

name: aiOrderSetA
meaning: Pointer to AI order set A: written by 0x00301140 (0x0030126B), 0x0030F2D0 (0x0030F331) and the party combat stance entry 0x00313400 (0x00313458); zeroed by the reuse reset (0x00236BBD); read by the next-action selector 0x00305AB0 (0x00305B95).

name: aiOrderSetD
meaning: Pointer to AI order set D: the unit-definition apply 0x0023A570 stores it (0x0023ABB5), the reuse reset zeroes it (0x00236BB6), and the next-action selector 0x00305AB0 reads it (0x00305C61). The action snapshot carries it (0x0030F083 read, 0x0030EDE7 write).

name: aiOrderSetB
meaning: Pointer to AI order set B: written by the effective-stats rebuild 0x002FEF30 (0x002FF9CC), 0x00300140 (0x00300155), the unit teardown 0x00300E40 (0x00300E68), 0x00301140 (0x0030119C), the next-action selector 0x00305AB0 (0x00305C25, 0x00305C45), the execution timeout check 0x0030AF30 (0x0030AFB2) and the command issuer 0x00311CF0 (0x00311DE1), most of them beside +0x748; zeroed by the reuse reset (0x00236BAF); read by the next-action selector 0x00305AB0 (0x00305C05).

name: actionStateFlags
meaning: a 32-bit flags word. Bits `0x1` and `0x2` are cleared together and bit 0x2 is set and tested individually; the byte-granular test is a sub-field read of this dword, not a separate byte

name: span0704
meaning: bytes 4 to 7 of the action block +0x700, copied with it to the commit copy +0x718 and the cancelled copy +0x730 by the reuse reset (0x00236B5C-0x00236B80); restored with the action state by 0x0030EDA0 (0x0030EDEF)

name: actionContextPtr
meaning: The committed order record, an AiOrderRecord pointer; -1 or non-zero gates an action in progress. The action commit 0x0030F760 stores its second argument here (0x0030F7F9) and reads no field of it, and the action cancel 0x003105D0 clears it (0x00310722). The sources are a gambit set's record (set + 0x20 + 0x18k, 0x00305DE0), the unit's own issued record +0xBA0 (0x00305B19), the static records 0x01EEC298 / 0x01EEC2B0 (0x00305C86 / 0x003130CB) and itself (0x0030FA4D). Readers go through it to +2 (signed), +4 (flag tests, the sign among them) and +6.

name: targetFocusHandle
meaning: The target focus handle, resolved by the focus-handle resolver 0x0031B7E0; written at commit (0x0030F800) and cleared at cancel (0x00310729).

name: actionId
meaning: The committed action id: stored by CommitAction (0x0030F806), cleared by CancelAndResetCurrentAction (0x0031071B), and compared with registers across the target-selector and eligibility paths.

name: span0716
meaning: the two bytes after the action id +0x714, copied with the target focus handle +0x710 as one qword to +0x728 and +0x740 (0x00236B6A-0x00236B95); restored by 0x0030EDA0 (0x0030EDF7)

name: actionBlockSnapshot
meaning: A copy of the action block +0x700..+0x70F taken right after the commit stores (0x0030F80D, 0x0030F823); read by CancelAndResetCurrentAction (0x003106B9).

name: committedTargetAndActionCopy
meaning: A copy of the target focus handle +0x710 and the action id +0x714 as one qword: the action commit 0x0030F760 stores it (0x0030F82A) and the reuse reset copies it (0x00236B95), both with movsd; the action cancel 0x003105D0 reads it (0x003106CC) to fill the cancelled copy +0x740.

name: lastCancelledActionBlock
meaning: The cancelled action's record, a copy of the action block +0x700..+0x70F: the action cancel 0x003105D0 stores it (0x003106D7) and the reuse reset copies it (0x00236B72), both with movups; the action-target resolver 0x003014C0 tests its bit 0x1 (0x003015C2). The action snapshot copy loops reach it (0x0030F060, 0x0030EDB6).

name: lastCancelledTargetId
meaning: The cancelled action's target focus copy, the u32 half of the +0x710 {targetFocusHandle, actionId} pair that cancel copies here (0x003106CC..E3); the next commit compares its own target and id with this pair to drop a queued repeat (0x0030F84E..857).

name: lastCancelledActionId
meaning: The cancelled action's id, the u16 half of the +0x740 pair: the action commit 0x0030F760 compares its own action id with it (0x0030F84E) to drop a queued repeat, the target-selector evaluator 0x00301AD0 compares it (0x00301B6A), and the standard action-state advance 0x00304850 reads it (0x00304ADE, 0x00304B1A).

name: span0746
meaning: the cancelled copy's counterpart of +0x716, written by the qword copies into +0x740 (0x00236B8D; 0x003105D0 at 0x003106E3); restored by 0x0030EDA0 (0x0030EDCF)

name: relationActorHandle
meaning: A relation actor handle: written by the effective-stats rebuild 0x002FEF30 (0x002FF9D3), 0x00300140 (0x0030015C), the unit teardown 0x00300E40 (0x00300E6F), 0x00301140 (0x003011A3), the next-action selector 0x00305AB0 (0x00305C2C, 0x00305C4C), the execution timeout check 0x0030AF30 (0x0030AFB9) and the command issuer 0x00311CF0 (0x00311DDB), in each case beside +0x6F8; zeroed with +0x74C by the reuse reset (0x00236BD2); read by the relation-mode test 0x0030BD00 (0x0030BE2A).

name: relationWordB
meaning: A dword written beside +0x748 by the effective-stats rebuild 0x002FEF30 (0x002FFA31), 0x00300140 (0x003001B3), the unit teardown 0x00300E40 (0x00300EC5), 0x00301140 (0x00301202) and the execution timeout check 0x0030AF30 (0x0030B01A). No instruction in the access table reads it.

name: groupTargetFocusEffective

name: groupTargetFocus

name: actionScopedWord758
meaning: An action-scoped word set to the sentinel 0xFFFF at reset (0x00236BD9), its only recorded access.

name: span075A
meaning: the two bytes after the word +0x758 the reuse reset sets (0x00236BD9); restored by 0x0030EDA0 (0x0030EDD7)

name: actionAgeCounter
meaning: The action age counter behind the execution timeout. It is incremented only when the progress pair at +0x768/+0x76C has been reached (0x00307C33 jl skips the increment otherwise), and the execution timeout check 0x0030AF30 compares it against a scaled threshold: 0x0030AF91 tests the word at +0x714 against 0x21E to choose a multiplier of 10 or a computed one, multiplies by the truncated float scale (0x0030AFA0 cvttss2si), and 0x0030AFA7 cmp / jle decides whether the action has run too long.

name: actionProgressAccumulator
meaning: The action progress accumulator: it counts up by 0x002F9F10() = 100 per qualifying advance (0x00304A1A..30) toward the threshold +0x764. The advance reaches it through the shifted action-block base (rsi+0xB0 on the +0x6B0 block) with cmp and add at 0x00304A20/0x00304A30, and SnapshotAndSuspendActionState reads it with movups at 0x0030F07B on the copy loop's pass 1 (0x0030F0C5 is the copy loop's tail at +0xB40/+0xB50/+0xB60). The reuse reset clears it with a dword store.

name: actionProgressThreshold

name: actionProgressCurrent
meaning: The current half of a progress pair. Two independent functions load the target at +0x76C and compare this against it as current >= target: the action-state advance 0x00307BE0 at 0x00307C27/0x00307C2D and the step-distance computation 0x00339BF0 at 0x00339CA5/0x00339CAB. Reaching the target is what lets the age counter at +0x75C advance.

name: actionProgressTarget
meaning: the target half of the pair at +0x768. Loaded first in both comparison sites, which is what identifies it as the bound rather than the value.

name: committedActionDword770
meaning: The committed-action state dword: CommitAction writes it (0x0030F832), as do 0x002FF9DA, 0x00300E75, 0x00300163 and SnapshotAndSuspendActionState, none of them clearing a span; the action-commit path compares it, and the teardown, stats-rebuild and status-transition paths read it.

name: releasedEffectHandle
meaning: An effect handle, -1 when no handle is held: 0x00329F80 tests it for -1 (0x00329F86) and stores a handle (0x0032A045); 0x00319420, handed the action state at +0x6B0 (from 0x00304EB6), reads it (0x00319429) and sets it back to -1 (0x00319441); the reuse reset sets it to -1 (0x00236BE6).

name: targetBuffer
meaning: The action target buffer. The action commit 0x0030F760 passes it by address: 0x0030F7A7 and 0x0030F7C6 lea rcx, [rbx+0x778], and the target-buffer search 0x00316D70 reaches it through the route arg0+0x778.

name: span0980
meaning: the eight bytes after the target buffer +0x778-+0x97F, inside the action state 0x0030EDA0 restores (0x0030EDEF)

name: targetResultEntries
meaning: Thirty-two result entries, one per target buffer slot and indexed by the same value. The target-entry processor 0x003191B0 finds a slot by walking the target buffer's entries from +0x780 with add rcx, 0x10, then uses that index here; the preview path clears an entry the same way.

name: suspendedActionStateCopy
meaning: Pointer to the saved action state: the action-state snapshot 0x0030EFF0 stores the snapshot slot here (0x0030F0F1), one of the 8 slots of 0x4F0 bytes at 0x022BEFC0, and the action-state restore 0x0030EDA0 reads it at its entry (0x0030EDA0) to copy the state back.

name: actionScopedDwordB90
meaning: The unit's what-was-used-on-me mask, operand-store kind 10: zeroed at reset (0x00236BE0), written at 0x00329F29 (the operand-store writer's case-10 arm, from 0x00312170 and 0x002FE660), and read at 0x0032127C (from the enemy AI selector 0x00301AD0, opcodes 0x36/0x37 mode 3).

name: span0B94
meaning: the last twelve bytes of the action state +0x6B0-+0xB9F, after the dword +0xB90 the reuse reset clears (0x00236BE0); restored by 0x0030EDA0's tail copy (0x0030EE44)

name: issuedCommandOrder
meaning: The issued command's order record, an embedded AiOrderRecord. SelectAndCommitNextAction commits unit + 0xBA0 when unit flag 0x4000 is set (0x00305B19), so its fields are read through +0x708 like any set record: +0x00 actionSelector (IssueCommand writes it, 0x00311D7A); +0x02 actionParameter, read through +0x708 at +2; +0x04 flags (IssueCommand ORs in 0x8000, read through +0x708 as the sign, 0x00308736 / 0x00328604); +0x06..+0x17 selectors, +6 read through +0x708 (0x002FE682).

name: commandedActorHandle
meaning: the commanded actor handle (or the unit's own) stored by IssueCommand once status layers admit it (writer 0x00311DB0: mov [rbx+0xbb8],eax); read by roster-walk teardown 0x00301310 and passed as r9d to the call at 0x00305B34

name: span0BBC
meaning: the four bytes between +0xBB8 and +0xBC0, before the perception candidate count +0xBC4; outside the 0x4F0 bytes 0x0030EDA0 restores (they end at +0xB9F)

name: perceptionCandidates
meaning: The perception candidate cache, the second instance of the same type. The perception cache refresh 0x00324F20 establishes it with lea rdi,[rcx+0xbc0] and tests its flags byte directly (0x00324F32 test byte ptr [rdi], 1), the bit the reset preserves. The target-selector evaluator 0x00301AD0, the enmity propagation 0x003219D0 and the periodic HP credit builder 0x00386860 all walk it from its count at +0xBC4 and its entry base at +0xBC8.

name: reservedItemId
meaning: The reserved consumed item, 0xFFFF when no item is reserved: the execution resource preparation 0x0030EF20 (0x0030EF93), the execution resource consumption 0x00305640 (0x003056BA) and 0x00308270 (0x003082B2) store it; the reserved resource refund 0x00300280 reads it (0x003002A5) and stores di (0x003002D0); 0x003037A0 (0x003037F9) and the engage auto-attack commit 0x00312FA0 (0x003130AB) read it; the reuse reset sets it to 0xFFFF from bx (0x00236AFC). Zero from the pool-slot memset 0x002344D2, inside the 0xF50 slot, until the first reset.

name: span0DCA
meaning: the two bytes after the reserved consumed item +0xDC8 (set to 0xFFFF by the reuse reset, 0x00236AFC), just past the 32 entries of the perception cache +0xBC8-+0xDC7

name: stanceRecheckDeadlineTick
meaning: The tick at which the party combat stance is checked again: the stance recheck seed 0x003081E0 tests it for 0 (0x003081F1) and seeds it (0x0030825C), the party stance computation 0x00308130 compares the tick with it (0x003081B2), and the party combat stance entry 0x00313400 sets it to 0 (0x00313439); 0x00301140 (0x0030124A), 0x00307C70 (0x00307CC7), the engagement flag update 0x00307D10 (0x00307D7C) and 0x0030F2D0 (0x0030F318) also write it.

name: flag30ExpiryTick
meaning: An expiry tick: 0x00301140 stores it (0x003012DB), the periodic combat maintenance 0x00310DB0 compares it with the current tick (0x00310DF4), and the reuse reset zeroes it (0x00236AEB).

name: perSlotDwords
meaning: Thirty-two per-slot dwords cleared as a block: 0x003176C0, called at the end of the reuse reset (0x00236C1F), forms the address (0x003176C5) and zeroes all 32 with rep stosd (0x003176D3). The access table has no other access to them.

name: previewGilAmount
meaning: The gil amount the target preview computed: the target preview 0x00303830 (0x00303954) and the recursive target preview 0x00303A00 (0x00303B2E) store it, the execution resource consumption 0x00305640 reads it (0x00305712), and the reuse reset zeroes it (0x00236AE5).

name: reservedGil
meaning: The reserved gil cost: the execution resource preparation 0x0030EF20 (0x0030EFC0), the execution resource consumption 0x00305640 (0x003056B3) and 0x00308270 (0x003082C0) store it; the reserved resource refund 0x00300280 reads it (0x003002D7) and zeroes it (0x003002F5); 0x00303BD0 compares it (0x00303C8F), and the engage auto-attack commit 0x00312FA0 reads it (0x003130C1). Zero from the pool-slot memset 0x002344D2, inside the 0xF50 slot.

name: span0E5C
meaning: the four bytes between the reserved gil cost +0xE58 and the definition row pointer +0xE60; zeroed with the slot by 0x00234480 (0x002344D2)

name: unitDefinitionRow
meaning: Pointer to the unit's definition row, in the enemy table 0x02EBF120 or the party table 0x02EBF130; written by ApplyUnitDefinition (0x0023A915, 0x0023ABC3).

name: ardClassRow
meaning: The .ard slot-0 class row (84 bytes, table base 0x02EBF150), selected by the spawn row's word +0x00. It is not a second home for +0x698: +0x698 is the BattleStatsRecord and +0xE68 the class row, two different objects that no reader treats interchangeably. The class row's +5 is the unit's type byte, not the stats record's +5, which is the spawn-backed test the lethal path uses at 0x003007F4. Kind 1 only: for a kind-0 (party) unit the installer never writes it and the reset at 0x00236AC2 leaves it 0, which is why 0x003879F1 null-tests it before use. The SpawnKeep entry's +0x80 stats page reaches +0x698, never this field.

name: rewardBaseRow
meaning: Pointer to the reward base row: the unit-definition apply 0x0023A570 stores it (0x0023A9A5); the experience reward 0x002F8BB0 (0x002F8C7E, 0x002F8D12), the licence-point reward 0x002F90C0 (0x002F9136), the defeat reward and loot pass 0x00312280 (0x0031253F) and 0x00317090 (0x003170C4) read it from the defeated unit.

name: rewardPerLevelRow
meaning: Pointer to the reward per-level row: the unit-definition apply 0x0023A570 stores it (0x0023A9F4); the experience reward 0x002F8BB0 (0x002F8C73, 0x002F8D07), the licence-point reward 0x002F90C0 (0x002F912B), the defeat reward and loot pass 0x00312280 (0x00312534) and 0x00317090 (0x003170BA) read it from the defeated unit.

name: innateAugmentSource
meaning: **the innate augment source, from btlAtelSetAbility (bit-reversed halves)** (page)

name: codeStatusesFromBtlatelsetstatus
meaning: **code-3 status immunities from btlAtelSetStatus, installed into +0x38 by the recompute mode-5 pass** (page)

name: span0E94
meaning: the four bytes after the dword +0xE90 the reuse reset clears (0x00236B19), before +0xE98; zeroed with the slot by 0x00234480 (0x002344D2)

name: spawnGroupId
meaning: 1-based spawn group id; 0 = not in a group. Indexes the ledger at 0x02EC13C0 + (id-1)*0x18

name: spawnGroupMode
meaning: bit 0x1 = mode 1 (immediate arm), bit 0x2 = mode 2 (teardown skips 0x0025AB30/0x002697E0). The writer is a read-modify-write that preserves every other bit, so bits under mask `0xFC` are live state this field does not claim

name: bitBitStatusApplied
meaning: **bit 0x1 / bit 0x2: status 8 / 2 applied by a party-side source** (page)

name: span0E9B
meaning: the byte after +0xE98-+0xE9A, before +0xE9C; zeroed with the slot by 0x00234480 (0x002344D2)

name: verbFlagWord
meaning: A flag word: 0x002392D0 clears bit 0x1 (0x0023932A) and ORs in eax (0x00239339), and 0x003229A0 reads it (0x003229C4).

name: targetedBySlotMask
meaning: A mask of the slots targeting this unit: 0x00307300, on the target unit, clears bits of it with an and-mask (0x00307511), the action cancel 0x003105D0 clears bits of it on each unit (0x0031069C), and the unit teardown 0x00300E40 compares it with esi (0x00300EEE).

name: selectorSlotMask
meaning: A slot mask: the action commit 0x0030F760 reads and writes it on the units it selects (0x0030F94E, 0x0030F962), and 0x00310780 does the reverse (0x003107D1, 0x003107EA); 0x00322050 (0x00322059), 0x00322080 (0x003220A3) and the reuse reset (0x00236ADF) zero it. Readers test it against a slot bit or 0: 0x002FEAD0 (0x002FEB24), the target-selector evaluator 0x00301AD0 (0x00301D7D, 0x00303380), the target eligibility check 0x003083B0 (0x00308520, 0x003085A0), the bounded selector scalar 0x00308C20 (0x00308D10) and 0x0030C210 (0x0030C240, 0x0030C260).

name: selectorCounter
meaning: A count kept with the mask +0xEA4: the action commit 0x0030F760 increments it (0x0030F959) and 0x00310780 decrements it (0x003107DD); 0x00322050 (0x00322063), 0x00322080 (0x003220AD) and the reuse reset (0x00236AD8) zero it; the target-selector evaluator 0x00301AD0 compares it with 3 (0x00301E95) and reads it (0x00302123), and 0x00386860 compares it (0x0038698C).

name: slotIndex
meaning: the slot own index in the pool - written from the allocator scan counter, so slot i always carries i

name: span0EAA
meaning: the two bytes after the slot index +0xEA9, before +0xEAC; zeroed with the slot by 0x00234480 (0x002344D2)

name: hpStagePulsePhase
meaning: A float phase: 0x002FE950 sets it to 1.0 (0x3F800000, 0x002FE9D3), reads it (0x002FE9DD) and stores it back (0x002FEA8C); 0x002FEAB0, called from the unit-definition apply 0x0023A570 (0x0023AC24), resets it with +0xEB0 in one qword store (0x002FEAB2).

name: hpStageReached
meaning: The HP stage reached: 0x002FE950 compares it with ecx (0x002FE9C5), stores ecx (0x002FE9CD) and reads it sign-extended (0x002FEA22); 0x002FEAB0 resets it with +0xEAC in one qword store (0x002FEAB2).

name: tail0EB4
meaning: the bytes from +0xEB4 to the end of the 0xF50-byte unit; 0x0031AD90 returns the address +0xED0 inside them (0x0031AD92); zeroed with the slot by 0x00234480 (0x002344D2)

name: slotCount
meaning: number of BattleUnit slots (0x20)

name: requestId
meaning: the stream request id, -1 idle: 0x003EB100 stores -1 when it starts a stream (0x003EB12F); the worker 0x003EADE0 stores the request 0x0032E780 returns (0x003EAE4C, 0x003EAE59; 0x003EAFA7) and passes it to 0x0032E4D0 (0x003EAE7C, 0x003EAE7E)

name: unobservedSpan004
meaning: Alignment before the pointer. The reset 0x003EB050 clears them with the dword +0x00 as one qword (0x003EB059) and then sets that dword to -1 (0x003EB060). Zero at load: the storage is in the .data tail past the raw end 0x01F7E400, which the loader fills with zeros.

name: ring
meaning: the script-allocated ring buffer: 0x003EB180 stores it with its size (0x003EB180, 0x003EB187); the worker 0x003EADE0 reads into it (0x003EAE3D, 0x003EAE97, 0x003EAF29); 0x003EB010 frees it through 0x003697F0 and clears it (0x003EB02A-0x003EB038)

name: bufferBytes

name: openLoadId
meaning: the load id of the stream open: state 3 stores the return of 0x002DF660 (0x003EAEA0); state 4 waits until 0x002DEE90 reports it done (0x003EAEB9), and so does the release 0x003EAD10 in states 3-5 (0x003EAD50, 0x003EAD6C); 0 once play starts (0x003EAEF0); zeroed by 0x003EB050 (0x003EB081) and 0x003EB100 (0x003EB122)

name: stream
meaning: the spoken-line stream's handle, written by 0x0021D770 (0x0021D7C0) through the address state 3 passes to 0x002DF660 (0x003EAE93; 0x002DF660 -> 0x001DC2E0 -> 0x00211270 -> 0x0021D770); read by play 0x002DF680 (0x003EAEE8), the still-playing query 0x002DF630 in state 7 (0x003EAF00) and the release's stop 0x002DF690 when not 0 (0x003EAD81); zeroed by 0x003EB050 (0x003EB088) and 0x003EB100 (0x003EB122)

name: kind
meaning: always 0x24: 0x003EB100 stores 0x24 (0x003EB10C); the worker 0x003EADE0 passes it as the first argument of 0x0032E400 and 0x0032E780 (0x003EAE26, 0x003EAE44)

name: fileIndex
meaning: the kind-0x24 file's index, 0x003EB100's argument (0x003EB129), from bgmstreamread 0x00354690 (0x0035469E); read for the size query 0x0032E400 (0x003EAE22) and every read 0x0032E780 (0x003EAE41, 0x003EAF6E); zeroed by 0x003EB050 (0x003EB08F)

name: fileBytes
meaning: stream file size: the worker 0x003EADE0 (rbx = 0x02B5E0E0, passed by 0x003EADD0) stores 0x0032E400's return in it (0x003EAE29, 0x003EAE2E), lowers bufferBytes to it when that is smaller (0x003EAE31, 0x003EAE36) and compares bytesRead with it (0x003EAEF8, 0x003EAF4F)

name: bytesRead
meaning: bytes read so far: the worker 0x003EADE0 (rbx = 0x02B5E0E0, passed by 0x003EADD0) sets it to bufferBytes after the first read (0x003EAE4C, 0x003EAE5E), stops the reads when it reaches fileBytes (0x003EAEFB) and adds each read's length (0x003EAF9F)

name: ringCursor
meaning: ring write cursor: the worker 0x003EADE0 (rbx = 0x02B5E0E0, passed by 0x003EADD0) sets it to bytesRead modulo bufferBytes (0x003EAE61, 0x003EAE69; 0x003EAFB1, 0x003EAFB6) and adds it to ring for the next read's destination (0x003EAF61, 0x003EAF67)

name: state
meaning: stream state 1..8: 0x003EB100 sets 1 (0x003EB139); the workers 0x003EAD10 and 0x003EADE0 switch on it (0x003EAD1F, 0x003EADFE), and 0x003EADE0 sets 2, 3, 4, 5 and 8 (0x003EAE63, 0x003EAE8B, 0x003EAEA5, 0x003EAEC9, 0x003EAFAD); 0x003EB150 turns 5 into 6 (0x003EB165-0x003EB16C)

name: armed
meaning: 1 while the stream is in use: set with the state by the word store 0x101 in 0x003EB100 (0x003EB139); cleared by the reset 0x003EB050 (0x003EB052, 0x003EB06A), the release 0x003EAD10 (0x003EAD46, 0x003EAD8D) and by state 7 once the whole file is read and the stream has stopped (0x003EAF10); read by 0x003EAD10 (0x003EAD16), the step 0x003EADE0 (0x003EADF4), 0x003EB0A0 (0x003EB0A0), 0x003EB0D0 (0x003EB0E0) and 0x003EB150 (0x003EB150)

name: pan
meaning: 0x40, handed to the sound layer at play (contract MC-8)

name: volume
