meaning: The token text buffer. Its capacity is set to 0x20 bytes on setup.

name: dyd
meaning: The parser's dynamic lists.

name: source
meaning: The chunk's name.

name: envn
meaning: The interned string `_ENV`, marked so the collector keeps it.

name: decpoint
meaning: The decimal point character, `.` at setup.

name: varname
meaning: the local variable's source name - a LoadString result stored per element

name: startpc
meaning: the first instruction index where the local is live (LoadInt result)

name: endpc
meaning: the instruction index where the local dies (LoadInt result)

name: previous
meaning: The protected call this one is nested in. Saved from LuaState +0x70 on entry and put back on exit.

name: jumpBuffer
meaning: The 0x100-byte register save area for the C setjmp and longjmp pair.

name: status
meaning: The error status of the protected call, 0 when it finishes normally. The throw path writes it and the protected-call routine returns it.

name: value
meaning: The node's value TValue - value_ at +0x00, tt_ dword at +0x08.

name: key
meaning: The node's key TValue inside the NodeKey - key value at +0x10, key tt dword at +0x18.

name: next
meaning: the NodeKey.next chain link for same-main-position nodes

name: signature
meaning: The Lua chunk signature, bytes 1B 4C 75 61: the escape byte followed by 'Lua'. From the immediate 0x61754C1B at 0x0082E4C7.

name: version
meaning: The luac version byte, 0x52: Lua 5.2. The first byte of the immediate 0x04010052.

name: format
meaning: 0 = the official format.

name: endianness
meaning: 1 = little-endian.

name: sizeofSizeT
meaning: 8. First byte of the immediate 0x00040408.

name: sizeofLuaNumber
meaning: 4 - lua_Number is a float in this build, where stock Lua 5.2 on x64 uses double. The consequence: every number in a chunk this build runs is single precision, so integers are exact only to 2^24 = 16,777,216 and a counter or total past that stops incrementing by one.

name: numbersAreIntegral
meaning: 0 - numbers are not integral.

name: luacTail
meaning: The luac tail, bytes 19 93 0D 0A 1A 0A. Assembled from two sources: the dword at 0x01CCD300 (19 93 0d 0a, stored at 0x0082E4E6) and the word at 0x01CCD304 (1a 0a, loaded into edi at 0x0082E4B9). Both were read back from the image and match.

name: next
meaning: the GC chain link, the first member of Lua's CommonHeader

name: tt
meaning: the object's own type tag; 9 for a prototype

name: marked
meaning: the GC mark byte

name: padding000A
meaning: Alignment after the CommonHeader to the first pointer at +0x10. Not written by luaF_newproto, which starts at +0x10 - the gap between the header's three bytes and that store is what sizes it. Lifetime: not initialised as a whole: heap luaF_newproto fills fields; padding unwritten.

name: constants
meaning: the prototype's constant array

name: code
meaning: The bytecode array, counted by the int32 at +0x58. Nulled at birth by `mov qword ptr [rax+0x18], rbx` at 0x0081ED5B (upstream `f->code = NULL`). Lua instructions are 32-bit, so this is a uint32 array, not a byte buffer.

name: nestedPrototypes
meaning: the array of prototypes nested in this one

name: lineinfo
meaning: The opcode-to-source-line map, one int32 per instruction, counted by the int32 at +0x5C. Nulled by `mov qword ptr [rax+0x28], rbx` at 0x0081ED63. Debug information: absent from a stripped chunk, which is why nothing in ordinary execution reads it.

name: locvars
meaning: The local-variable debug table, counted by the int32 at +0x64; nulled by `mov qword ptr [rax + 0x30], rbx` at 0x0081ED75.

name: upvalues
meaning: The upvalue descriptor array (name, in-stack flag and index per upvalue, used to bind a closure's upvalues when it is instantiated), counted by the int32 at +0x50; nulled by `mov qword ptr [rax + 0x38], rbx` at 0x0081ED67.

name: cache
meaning: The last closure created from this prototype, Lua 5.2's reuse cache: if a closure is requested again with identical upvalues the cached one is returned instead of allocating. Nulled by `mov qword ptr [rax + 0x40], rbx` at 0x0081ED5F. It is a weak reference for the collector, which is why it is cleared rather than kept alive.

name: source
meaning: The chunk name used in error messages and tracebacks. Nulled by `mov qword ptr [rax+0x48], rbx` at 0x0081ED80, the last store of the initialiser.

name: upvalueCount
meaning: The number of entries in the upvalue descriptor array at +0x38. Zeroed on its own by a dword store, `mov dword ptr [rax+0x50], ebx` at 0x0081ED6B - the only count the initialiser writes unfused, which is what fixes its width at 4 independently of its neighbours.

name: constantCount
meaning: the number of entries in the constant array at +0x10

name: codeCount
meaning: The number of 32-bit instructions in the bytecode array at +0x18. Written as the upper half of `mov qword ptr [rax+0x54], rbx` at 0x0081ED4F: one qword store zeroing +0x54 and +0x58 together, which is only possible if constantCount and this field are adjacent int32s in that order.

name: lineinfoCount
meaning: The number of entries in the line map at +0x28. Written as the lower half of `mov qword ptr [rax+0x5c], rbx` at 0x0081ED57, whose upper half is nestedPrototypeCount at +0x60 - so this field's position is fixed by the same fusion that fixes that count.

name: nestedPrototypeCount
meaning: the number of entries in the nested-prototype array at +0x20

name: locvarCount
meaning: The number of entries in the local-variable table at +0x30. Written as the lower half of `mov qword ptr [rax+0x64], rbx` at 0x0081ED79.

name: linedefined
meaning: The source line where this function's definition begins; 0 for a main chunk. Written as the upper half of the same qword store at 0x0081ED79 - adjacent to locvarCount, in that order.

name: lastlinedefined
meaning: The source line where the definition ends. Zeroed on its own by `mov dword ptr [rax+0x6c], ebx` at 0x0081ED7D.

name: gclist
meaning: the gray-list link: reallymarkobject 0x0081AE20 picks its tag-9 arm 0x0081AF5F from the switch at 0x0081AE4D, stores the gray list head global +0x80 here (0x0081AF66) and makes the prototype the head (0x0081AF6A). luaF_newproto steps over it, between lastlinedefined +0x6C and the byte triple +0x78.

name: numparams
meaning: The number of fixed parameters the function declares: the low byte of `mov word ptr [rax + 0x78], bx` at 0x0081ED6E, which zeroes it and the byte after it as one word, so the two are 1-byte fields.

name: is_vararg
meaning: Set when the function takes `...`. Written as the high byte of the same word store at 0x0081ED6E.

name: maxstacksize
meaning: The number of registers the function needs - the VM reserves this many stack slots per frame. Written separately by `mov byte ptr [rax+0x7a], bl` at 0x0081ED72, immediately after the word store; a byte store beside a word store is what separates the third field from the pair.

name: padding007B
meaning: Tail alignment to the declared 0x80. Not written; bounded by maxstacksize ending at +0x7B and the allocation size 0x80, which luaF_newproto passes as `lea r8d, [rdx+0x77]` with rdx holding the tag 9. Lifetime: not initialised as a whole: heap luaF_newproto fills fields; padding unwritten.

name: z
meaning: The input stream.

name: buffBuffer
meaning: The token buffer's storage.

name: buffN
meaning: The token buffer's bytes in use.

name: buffSize
meaning: The token buffer's capacity.

name: dyd
meaning: The parser's dynamic lists.

name: mode
meaning: The accepted chunk kinds. Tested at the start of the load.

name: name
meaning: The chunk name.

name: next
meaning: the GC chain link, the first member of Lua's CommonHeader

name: tt
meaning: the object's own type tag; 8 for a thread

name: marked
meaning: the GC mark byte, the third member of CommonHeader

name: status
meaning: thread status

name: unobservedSpan000B
meaning: Five bytes between the status byte and the stack pointer that no access reaches. lua_newthread 0x00813F20 allocates the state through 0x0081A620 and 0x00823670 without clearing it, so these bytes hold the allocator's contents.

name: top
meaning: the first free slot on the value stack

name: l_G
meaning: the shared global state

name: ci
meaning: the call record for the frame currently executing

name: oldpc
meaning: the last program counter the hooks saw (oldpc): luaD_poscall 0x0081DC10 stores the savedpc +0x38 of the frame it returns to (previous +0x10) here while the hook mask +0x48 has bit 0x2 or bit 0x4 (0x0081DC2D, 0x0081DC4A-0x0081DC52). The hook dispatcher 0x008233F0 compares the current frame's savedpc with it only while the mask has bit 0x4 (0x00823469, 0x008234A6), and stores the current frame's savedpc here on every pass (0x008234D8, 0x008234DC).

name: stack_last
meaning: The last usable stack slot: the allocation end less Lua's reserved extra stack slots.

name: stack
meaning: the base of this thread's value stack allocation

name: stacksize
meaning: the number of TValue slots in the stack allocation

name: nestingCounter0044
meaning: `nny`, the number of calls on this thread's stack that cannot yield. It is raised and dropped around calls (0x0081D932, 0x0081D953) and around the parser (0x0081DF63, 0x0081E037), set to 1 for a new thread (0x00813FA4), set to 0 while `lua_resume` runs and back to 1 after it (0x0081E383, 0x0081E3FB), tested by `lua_yieldk` (0x0081E424), and restored by a protected call that fails (0x0081DB56, 0x0081DB92).

name: counterWord0046

meaning: the mode region 0xB is currently sized for: 0x0037B3D0 frees and re-allocates the region only when +0x00 differs from it; then the setters store the applied mode

name: pendingMovieMemoryMode
meaning: a deferred mode request (4 = no request): 0x0037B490 stores it (caller 0x003DD6C0), the per-frame gate 0x002E65A0 applies it through 0x0037B2F0, and 0x0037B3D0 resets it to 4 (also 4 at boot); read by script verb 0x0297 usemoviememory (0x0037B380)

name: movieScreenSize
meaning: the movie screen size: script verb 0x058C setmoviescreensize stores it (a negative value becomes 3), verb 0x058D getmoviescreensize returns it; 3 at boot

name: _Left
meaning: The left child. From the descent 0x0070D360: when the node key at +0x20 is at or above the search key it remembers the node and descends [node+0], which is where a lower_bound goes left. The opposite assignment to EastlRbTreeNodeBase, where +0x00 is the right child.

name: _Parent
meaning: The parent node. This offset separates the `MSVC` tree node from EastlRbTreeNodeBase, where +0x08 is the left child; a rotation written against the wrong layout reparents into a child slot.

name: _Right
meaning: The right child - the fall-through branch of the descent 0x0070D360 when the node key is below the search key. In EastlRbTreeNodeBase this displacement is the parent.

name: _Color
meaning: The node colour, 0 red and 1 black - the same encoding EastlRbTreeNodeBase uses, and a shared convention rather than evidence of a shared type. The insert 0x00712F60 writes 1 at 0x0071301E, 0x00713022, 0x00713094, 0x0071310B, 0x0071310F, 0x00713182 and finally 0x007131FD (the root) and 0 at 0x0071302E, 0x007130A0, 0x0071311B.

name: _Isnil
meaning: `MSVC` _Isnil: non-zero marks the header (sentinel) node at which every walk stops. `EASTL`'s rbtree_node_base ends at +0x19 and has no such member, so this byte tells at a glance which family a node pointer belongs to.

name: pad01A
meaning: Tail padding to the 8-byte alignment the three pointers force. Derived from a measured neighbour: the payload begins at +0x20, measured twice - 0x0070D360 compares the key at [node+0x20] and returns the mapped value at [node+0x28], and the tidy 0x0071F3A0 does lea rcx,[rsi+0x20] into the payload destructor 0x0071EE70 before freeing the node - so the header ends at +0x20 and _Isnil ends at +0x1A. Lifetime: not initialised as a whole: a heap node built by _Buynode, with the padding unwritten.

name: mt
meaning: the standard MT19937 state vector. Seeded by the textbook recurrence mt[i] = 0x6C078965 * (mt[i-1] ^ (mt[i-1] >> 30)) + i for i in 1..623

name: index
meaning: The draw cursor of the gameplay instance. Seeding sets it to 624, exhausted, so the first draw after a seed twists before returning anything; setting it otherwise would desynchronise by one draw at once. The graphics instance at 0x01F7F600 keeps its index in another layout: a uint32* cursor at +0x9C0 and a uint32 count at +0x9C8, both reset by its twist 0x0018EE20 (count 0x270 = 624 at 0x0018EECD, cursor to the array base at 0x0018EED8), so this uint32 field is the gameplay instance's only.

name: threshold
meaning: progress threshold, read as two bytes

name: track
meaning: track selected once progress exceeds the threshold; 0 = no track (-1 returned)

name: packedStartLength
meaning: start field id = low 11 bits, run length = high 5 bits; read as two bytes (unaligned)

name: ladderCount
meaning: number of MusicLadderEntry after the header

name: defaultTrack
meaning: the track before any ladder entry applies

name: ladder
meaning: ladderCount entries, 3 bytes each

name: magic
meaning: the file's magic "MUS0" (4D 55 53 30 in musicctrl.bin); read by no instruction: the pointer 0x02B5E0D0 is written by 0x003EAB60 (0x003EAB78) and read only by 0x003EAA70 (0x003EAA7D) and 0x003EAB90 (0x003EAB90, 0x003EABC5), which read from +0x04 (0x003EAA88, 0x003EAB9A) and +0x08 (0x003EAA9C, 0x003EABB6)

name: maxFieldId
meaning: inclusive upper bound on the field id (0x003EAA88); sizes the page array for the fixup (0x003EAB9A)

name: page
meaning: one word per 128 field ids: 0 = no runs; else table-relative on disk, absolute after 0x003EAB90

name: slots
meaning: the four music track slots

name: musicInfoTable
meaning: the bound musicinfo table: 2-byte records {u8 flags, u8 track}; 0x00360C70 loads it as resource kind 9, id 6 (0x0032E400(9, 6) gives the size, rbx = 0x0036A190(size), 0x0032E620(9, 6, rbx, size, desc) queues the load) with completion callback 0x00360B40, which stores its 32-bit argument zero-extended here; 0x00361010(i) answers record i's flag bit 0x1

name: pendingMusicCommand
meaning: the queued music command record (from 0x002F16B0): kind 5, or kind 8 while +0x70 is set, with completion callback 0x00361460, which clears this; 0x00360D60 answers whether one is pending; a new request is refused while it is set

name: musicHoldFlag
meaning: set by 0x00360D50 (called from 0x00280140); cleared by 0x00360D30 (called from 0x00261F90) and by 0x00361080 (the callback 0x00361170 / 0x00361200 put in their command records), each then tail-jumping 0x002DE050; while it is set 0x003614E0 queues a music request as the kind-8 command (handler 0x00361340), first calling 0x00360D70 (flag every live slot for release) when 0x002DEC00 answers negative.

name: magic
meaning: 'GRMI01' in the shipped file (ch and in copies byte-identical); the reader does not compare it.

name: selectorCount
meaning: number of MapRef-derived selectors (776 shipped); a selector >= this reads as 0

name: packedBits
meaning: first byte of the bitstream: 9 bits per (selector, weather slot), read MSB first

name: prev
meaning: the list's back link; 0 at the head. Doubly-linked with +0x08 on whichever list the entry sits on - free head 0x0215FD60 or live heads 0x0215FD58/0x0215FD78

name: next
meaning: the forward link; 0 at the tail. Every id-walk chases it: 0x002E3DD5/0x002E3DF5 mov rax,[rax+8]; allocator pops via 0x002E25F6

name: auxHandle
meaning: a secondary handle cleared at allocation and, when nonzero, released through 0x00369800 (the audio-family handle release) at 0x002E93F2 during 0x002E9360

name: boundId
meaning: The entry's key: what SecondaryContext.boundResourceId matches and what find-by-id compares (0x002E3DD0/0x002E3DF0, `cmp [rax+0x14], ecx`). The allocator stores it from its argument (0x002E2603); the entry is released through 0x0017F040. The model-key mapper 0x002ED6F0 reads the key's low 16 bits as N (0x002ED6F0) and its third byte (mask 0xFF0000) as a tag (0x002ED6F7/0x002ED6FA); the top byte (mask 0xFF000000) is ignored. It outputs a kind and stride * N; the default arm (0x002ED840) gives kind 1, stride 1 and returns 1, other arms return stride - 1 (0x002ED726, 0x002ED73E). Over all 256 tags the kinds are 1, 13, 14, 15, 16, 18, 19, 20, 22, 23, 24, 25 and 34. The size guard 0x002E9920 indexes stride * N + 1, or N + 0x43 for kind 1 (0x002E9946-0x002E9950), plus the lane; for tag 0x6D lanes 1..15 become 1 and lanes 16..31 become lane - 14 (0x002E9959-0x002E9992); a mapper return below 1 gives size 0 with no size query (0x002E9954/0x002E99AD), which happens for kinds 15, 16, 18, 20, 24 and 25. The name request 0x002EAD50 adds 0x33 for kind 1 instead (0x002EAD84-0x002EAD95, 0x002EADDF-0x002EADE4) and requests without a positive-size test (0x002EADEA-0x002EAE08).

name: stateFlags
meaning: Bit 0x2 (0x02) is the ready flag the wait states test through 0x002E4C20 (movsx; and 2). Cleared on alloc and release.

name: pinFlags
meaning: release gate: find-by-id refuses cleanup while the bits under mask `0x3` are set (test [rax+0x19],3 at 0x002E3E0B). The allocator preserves only bits `0x8`/`0x40`/`0x80` (and 0xC8 at 0x002E25F2)

name: slotIndex
meaning: The slot's own index, 0-127: the initialiser 0x002EA320 stores each slot's ordinal here (0x002EA361) and it is the low half of the packed handle (id = 0x8000 or slot, with the generation stamp in the high 16 bits).

name: refcount
meaning: positive count blocks cleanup: find-by-id releases the entry only when it is 0 or less, a signed compare (cmp word [rax+0x1c],0 / jg skip at 0x002E3E04; the same after each decrement at 0x002E6839, 0x002EB858 and 0x002EEB79); cleared on alloc, word-written on release

name: subTableIndex
meaning: index into the 0x120-stride sub-table at 0x02161DA0 (rax+rax*8 shl 5), or -1 when unset. Its entry's +0x5C must equal this record's stamp +0x24 before use (0x002E939D/0x002E4C4B)

name: clearedWord20
meaning: A word the allocator clears (0x002E260A); the allocator, release and find bodies have no other access to it.

name: pad22
meaning: Alignment between clearedWord20 (+0x20, which the allocator clears at 0x002E260A) and generationStamp (+0x24). None of the 63 functions that reference the list heads or the pool (0x0215FD40..0x02161DA0) touches it: the allocator 0x002E25E0 stores the words +0x20 (0x002E260A) and +0x26 (0x002E2613) beside it, the initialiser 0x002EA320 writes +0x00, +0x08, +0x1A, +0x1C, +0x1E and +0x24 (0x002EA361-0x002EA377), and every +0x22 operand in those bodies (0x002E26B9, 0x002E4E7B, 0x002E6A48, 0x002E6EFC, 0x002E9479, 0x002E94A7, 0x002EA3A3) is on the 0x120-stride sub-record table at 0x02161DA0, and no rip-relative reference falls at 0x0215FDC2 + 0x40 * i. The pool is zero at load and these bytes stay zero.

name: generationStamp
meaning: The generation counter, the packed handle's high half; incremented both on allocate (0x002E25EC) and on release (0x002E944B), so a stale handle's stamp never matches a live entry.

name: requestMask
meaning: Per-lane request bits. The allocator zeroes them with +0x2C (0x002E260F). 0x002EB9D0 sets bit (1 << lane) when a sub-resource is requested (0x002EB9F4-0x002EBA09). The explicit non-negative arm sets the lane's bit (lane & 31, with no lane < 32 check) before its size query (0x002EBA07/0x002EBA09, query 0x002EBA0C), so a failed query leaves the bit set without setting +0x2C; when the bit is already set the arm only tests +0x2C and does not query again (0x002EBA02 -> 0x002EBA26). The negative-lane arm searches 1 <= lane < min(mapper return, 32) (cmovg 0x002EBA61, loop 0x002EBA70-0x002EBAB7), marks every candidate it queries (0x002EBA84), and returns the first lane that already has both its +0x28 and +0x2C bits (no query, 0x002EBA7B/0x002EBAAE/0x002EBAB1) or, newly marked, has a positive size; a lane with +0x28 set and +0x2C clear is skipped.

name: readyMask
meaning: Per-lane positive-size bits. The allocator zeroes them with +0x28 (0x002E260F). 0x002EB9D0 sets the lane's bit when the size guard 0x002E9920 returns a positive size: test/jle at 0x002EBA11/0x002EBA13 before the store 0x002EBA15 on the explicit-lane arm, and 0x002EBA8C/0x002EBA8E before 0x002EBA94 on the search arm; 0x002EBA26 tests it. 0x002E9920 maps the key to a file index and tail-calls the size query (0x002E9988, 0x002E99A8), or returns 0 when the mapper returns below 1 (0x002E9954/0x002E99AD). The size query 0x0032E400 only reads the override table 0x022C51F0 (0x0032E40F-0x0032E428) or, through 0x0046DE70, the baseline table 0x02EC3EE0 (0x002DF960-0x002DF977), and rounds a positive size up to 64 (0x0032E43F-0x0032E448). The bit is set before the bridge 0x002EB5E0's allocation through 0x002E2660 (0x002EB61B), its generation check (0x002EB643) and its leaf calls, none of which clear it, so a set bit means a positive size was seen for the lane, not that the data is loaded.

name: subResourceIds
meaning: three resource ids released one by one through 0x003A0F80 during 0x002E9360 (the rdi-walk loop at 0x002E93C4-0x002E93DF); all three seeded -1 on alloc

name: subResourceIdB
meaning: sub-resource id, element B of the released triple

name: subResourceIdC
meaning: sub-resource id, element C of the released triple

name: tailDword3C
meaning: The record's last dword. Neither the allocator 0x002E25E0 (stores +0x10 to +0x38) nor the initialiser 0x002EA320 writes it, and the release and find bodies do not touch it.

name: boundEntries
meaning: the bound-entry list: the per-frame gate step 0x002E6700 moves each entry here from +0x20 after loading it; find-or-create 0x002EB540 walks it before +0x20; 0x002EAEB0 takes an entry off it (or off +0x20) onto +0x30

name: entryFreePool
meaning: the free head of the 128-record NameBindingEntry table: the allocator 0x002E25E0 pops it (the new head is the popped record's +0x08); the initialiser points it at the table

name: subRecordList
meaning: the primary list of allocated sub-records (node +0x00 / +0x08): 0x002EB690 moves a record off it onto +0x28 and the per-frame gate step 0x002E6880 moves every +0x28 record back onto it; 0x002E9470 unlinks a released record; walked by 0x002ECB70 / 0x002ECBE0

name: subRecordFreePool
meaning: the sub-record free head the allocator 0x002E2660 pops; the initialiser points it at the sub-record table 0x02161DA0

name: pendingEntries
meaning: the entries find-or-create 0x002EB540 created since the last frame (pushed here with bit 0x8 of byte +0x19 set); walked after +0x00 by the finders; the per-frame gate step 0x002E6700 loads each one (0x0032E400 / 0x0036B160 into +0x10), clears bit 0x8, moves it onto +0x00 and then empties this list

name: unpermittedSubRecords
meaning: the sub-record list 0x002EB690 moves a record to when a requested bit lies outside the record's permitted union (+0x24 / +0x28 / +0x34), adding that bit to +0x28; the per-frame gate step 0x002E6880 runs 0x002E6EB0 on each record here, moves it back onto +0x10 and empties this list

name: entryReleaseQueue
meaning: the entries waiting to be released: 0x002EAEB0 moves an entry here from +0x00 / +0x20; the per-frame gate 0x002E65A0 (and 0x002E6D60) drains it from its tail, calling 0x0041E490 on the entry's +0x10 unless bit 0x8 of +0x18 or bit 0x4 of +0x19 is set, and 0x002E9360 unlinks each entry and returns it to the free pool +0x08

name: releaseSweepList
meaning: the sweep list of sub-records with a serviced bit (embedded node +0x10 / +0x18): 0x002EAFA0 pushes, 0x002E6900 retires the tail

name: listPrev
meaning: back link of the primary sub-record list; heads 0x0215FD68 (live) / 0x0215FD70 (free) / 0x0215FD80 (newly-permitted). 0 at head

name: listNext
meaning: forward link of the primary list. Popped by the allocator and chased on migration

name: pendingPrev
meaning: Back link of the second embedded list node (the node lives at rec+0x10; head 0x0215FD90 stores &rec+0x10, not rec).

name: pendingNext
meaning: forward link of the pending node; pushed onto head 0x0215FD90 when a registered bit is serviced

name: slotIndex
meaning: the record's own index 0-31, written by the startup init loop; the allocator copies it into the owner NameBindingEntry's +0x1E

name: ownerEntrySlot
meaning: slot index of the owning NameBindingEntry, or -1 unbound; lets 0x002E4E50 re-find the owner at 0x0215FDA0+slot*0x40 and revalidate the stamp

name: registeredMask
meaning: presence bits guarding valueIds[]: bit i set means valueIds[i] holds a live id. Bit-test accessor 0x002E4C30 returns it; 0x002EE1D0 gates the array read on it; 0x002EAFA0 tests it before pushing the pending node

name: requestedMask
meaning: Request bits: the queue leaf 0x002EB690 sets bit (1 << lane) here (0x002EB6CC) when the bit is not already in the permitted union +0x24, +0x28 and +0x34 (0x002EB6A1-0x002EB6C7); this mask is one of the three members of that union. The allocator 0x002E2660 zeroes it (0x002E26D1).

name: servicedMask
meaning: serviced/consumed bits: 0x002EAFA0 sets bit i after teardown, 0x002EB690 clears it on re-request; already-serviced bits short-circuit 0x002EAFA0

name: zeroedDword30
meaning: A dword the allocator 0x002E2660 zeroes as the low half of its qword store over +0x30/+0x34 (0x002E26D9); the 16 functions that reference the sub-record table have no access of their own at this offset.

name: preRegisteredMask
meaning: The third member of the permitted union (+0x24, +0x28 and +0x34) that the queue leaf 0x002EB690 tests (0x002EB6A1-0x002EB6AF). 0x002E4E50 clears bit i here in the same pass that sets it in +0x24, so bits move from this mask to registeredMask. The allocator zeroes it as the high half of its qword store at 0x002E26D9.

name: liveMaskByName
meaning: Live flag mask written by the by-id path 0x002ECAB0 (it locates the owning entry by boundId, then sets or clears the bit); bit 0x1 is maintained as an any-set aggregate when permitted. OR'd with +0x3C at the refcount-zero tests.

name: liveMaskAlt
meaning: A second live mask, read together with liveMaskByName (+0x38) as one mask: 0x002E3F00 loads it and ors in +0x38 before its bit tests (0x002E3F92/0x002E3F95, 0x002E3FD3/0x002E3FD6), and 0x002EB890 does the same before deciding whether a counter that reached zero clears its bit (0x002EB90D/0x002EB910). The allocator 0x002E2660 zeroes it as the high half of its qword store over +0x38/+0x3C (0x002E26C9); no other store with this displacement exists in the name-binding code 0x002E0000-0x002F0000.

name: liveMaskByEntry
meaning: Live flag mask written by the by-pointer path 0x002ECA30 (the caller already holds the entry); same permitted-union gate and bit 0x1 aggregate. Whole-table cleared by the 0x002E6570 reset sweep; bit-tested by 0x002E9C60.

name: latchedMask
meaning: one-shot latch mask: 0x002ECBA0 sets bit i and bit 0x1 only when its flag arg == 1 (0x002ECBCE-0x002ECBD4); 0x002E9470 zeroes it when it frees the record (0x002E94AF)

name: groupBitmasks
meaning: A 128-bit bitset indexed by a group selector: the queue leaf 0x002EB690 ors (1 << lane) into +0x48 + group * 4 (0x002EB6C2), indexing by sign32(group) with no bound of its own (0x002EB6BF/0x002EB6C2), so the group must be 0..3; every caller passes group 0 (the scheduler's phases 0 and 6 and the wrapper 0x002EB490). The allocator 0x002E2660 zeroes both qwords (0x002E26A5, 0x002E26A9).

name: zeroedDword58
meaning: A dword the allocator 0x002E2660 zeroes (0x002E26AD); the 16 functions that reference the sub-record table have no other access to it.

name: ownerGenerationStamp
meaning: Copy of the owning NameBindingEntry's generationStamp at bind time; every accessor compares it against the entry's live +0x24 and bails on mismatch - the stale-handle defence. Re-stamped by 0x002EAEB0 when the owner is re-listed.

name: valueIds
meaning: per-bit value array, slot i valid iff registeredMask bit i: read by 0x002EE1D0 (hashed via 0x0020E620 into CharacterRenderRecord +0x42C/+0x430) and 0x002E4E50 (id -> 0x0036B130/0x0036D170/0x0041E580); walked 32-wide by 0x002ECBE0 -> 0x0036C5D0 per nonzero; zeroed on alloc

name: bitRefcounts
meaning: Per-lane nesting counters, 32 words. The queue leaf 0x002EB690 adds its delta (r8w) to the counter at +0xE0 + 2 * sign32(lane) (0x002EB690/0x002EB696) with no lane bound, so the lane must be 0..31; 0x002EB890 decrements them. When a counter reaches zero or below, the counter is reset to zero if its bit is still live in +0x38 or +0x3C, else the bit is torn down through 0x002EAFA0 (0x002E3F00). The initialiser zeroes all 32 (0x002EA3B6) and so does the allocator 0x002E2660 (0x002E2697). The bridge 0x002EB5E0 calls the leaf twice when the generation matches (0x002EB643/0x002EB647), lane 0 first and then the selected lane (0x002EB64F-0x002EB661), so a selected lane 0 is counted twice. The scheduler 0x002EE430's phase 0 tries lanes 1..31 with delta 0 and group 0 until one is accepted (0x002EE49E-0x002EE4CA); its phase 6 passes the byte the equipment routine 0x003203B0 outputs (0..255), refusing only a negative value (0x002EE894/0x002EE896), with delta 1 and group 0 (0x002EE89C-0x002EE8A6); the wrapper 0x002EB490 fixes delta 1 and group 0. Delta 0 still clears and sets masks. With the US equipment rows, every row the routine admits (kind byte +7 below 32, 0x00320418) maps to 0..15; a row of kind 32 or more takes the -1 arm, which reads the map's count high byte (0) at table + 3 (0x00320424-0x0032043C).

name: vtable
meaning: the class vtable - the walk at 0x00876490 never touches +0x00 (it reads name/next only); every static node's class resolves from the RTTI locator this field holds.

name: name
meaning: The node's name, compared byte by byte. Read twice in one body: 0x00876494 loads it from the incoming node (`mov r10, qword ptr [rcx + 8]`) and 0x008764C0 from each listed node (`mov rax, qword ptr [r9 + 8]`), and 0x008764D0-0x008764E1 is the byte loop that compares them with `movzx`/`sub`/`jne` and terminates on a zero byte: a C string, not a counted one.

name: next
meaning: The forward link. Read at 0x008764E7 (`mov r9, qword ptr [r9 + 0x10]`) as the advance of the search loop, with `test r9, r9` as its termination, so the list ends on a null next rather than a sentinel index. The head is a standalone pointer global, not a node: 0x00876490 stores a node into the head at 0x008764FA when the name is not found, which is what makes this register-if-absent rather than a lookup.

name: value
meaning: the node's value - the page declares it int32 at +0x18 in the stride-0x20 node layout (name +0x08, next +0x10, value +0x18)

name: unobservedTail001C
meaning: The tail of the 0x20-stride record, in caller-supplied node storage; the registry walk 0x00876490 reads only the name +0x08 and the next link +0x10 of a node (0x008764C0, 0x008764E7).

name: tables
meaning: per-family command table; 12 of 16 families share the default table 0x01F26720

name: count
meaning: number of commands; 1,496 / 212 / 147 / 1 / 104

name: zero04
meaning: 0 in all five tables; no accessor

name: cellSizeAxisA
meaning: Divisor turning a world offset into a cell index on the first axis ('idiv ecx' at 0x00384025 with ecx = movzx byte [rbx]); also the first factor of the rectangle's extent at 0x00383F9D.

name: cellSizeAxisB
meaning: The same for the second axis - the divisor at 0x00384001 and the extent factor at 0x00383FB9.

name: cellCountAxisA
meaning: Cells along the first axis, and therefore the row stride of the grid cell index array: 0x0038400A multiplies the second cell index by it before adding the first.

name: cellCountAxisB
meaning: Cells along the second axis. Used at 0x00383FB5 as the extent factor; the grid's total cell count is countA*countB.

name: originAxisA
meaning: The rectangle's minimum corner on the first axis. Signed - both bodies use 'movsx' (0x00383F64, 0x0038400E, 0x00383790), so the map rectangle may lie at negative world coordinates.

name: originAxisB
meaning: The minimum corner on the second axis, read with 'movsx' at 0x00383F7D/0x00383FDB/003837 9C.

name: encodedRefCellIndex
meaning: Encoded reference to a u16 array of cellCountAxisA*cellCountAxisB entries - the broad-phase grid itself. 0x00383FD3 resolves it and 0x0038402C reads 'movzx ecx, word ptr [r9 + rax*2]' at the row-major cell index. 0xFFFF means empty: 0x00384031 compares against it and returns the failure value 0xFF. A non-sentinel entry is a byte offset into encodedRefCellLists, not an index - 0x00384042 adds it to that pointer unscaled.

name: encodedRefCellLists
meaning: Encoded reference to a byte stream of per-cell region-id lists. 0x00383F2E resolves it; a cell's entry is the stream plus the u16 from encodedRefCellIndex, and the list is a run of region id bytes terminated by 0xFF (0x0038404F 'cmp byte ptr [rdi], 0xff', 0x003840F2 'inc rdi', 0x003840F5). Each id indexes NavRegionRecord. 0x00384160 fixes up this field and +0x08 in place at 0x00384239-0x003842A0, which is how their being encoded references is known independently of use.

name: gridWidth
meaning: The grid width in cells, the row stride of the grid cell arrays. The builder stores it at 0x0039265D as cvttss2si((w + cellSize - 1.0) / cellSize), the grid cell count along the first axis of the map rectangle, and 0x00392683-0x00392689 multiply [0x02AEE064] by it for the total cell count. The query reads it (`mov r11d, [0x02AEE060]` at 0x00391313, into ebx at 0x0039179E) and indexes the grid cell arrays with width * row + column (0x00391877-0x0039187C); `lea eax, [rbx-1]` at 0x00391808 and 0x0039182F with cmovg clamps both column indices to it inside the clamp-and-walk span 0x00391800..0x003918F1.

name: gridHeight
meaning: The grid height in cells, the row count. It has two writers. The value comes from 0x00392654 `mov dword ptr [0x02AEE064], ebx`, with ebx = cvttss2si((h + cellSize - 1.0) / cellSize) for the map rectangle's extent h on the second axis. 0x00392710 zero-fills it with the whole block, the 0x460 bytes at 0x02AEE060, by a tail jump to the memset thunk 0x00861EC0 (0x00392725-0x00392738). Four functions load it with a qword load (`mov rcx, qword ptr [0x02AEE064]` at 0x0039132B, 0x00391810 and 0x00391B3E, `mov rdx, qword ptr [0x02AEE064]` at 0x003922CF), which also reaches the four bytes after it (0x02AEE068, which no instruction names), and use only the low half: after the load at 0x00391810, `lea eax, [rcx-1]` at 0x0039181F and 0x00391841 with cmovg clamps the row indices to it, and the row loop `cmp edi, r14d` at 0x0039184E runs between them.

name: unobservedSpan008
meaning: Eight bytes no instruction in the image names: 0x02AEE068 has no rip-relative reference, and the qword load of gridHeight at 0x02AEE064 (0x0039132B) reaches its first four bytes without using them. The block 0x02AEE060 is in .bss, so the loader zeroes it.

name: originAxisA
meaning: The grid origin on the first axis, the map rectangle's minimum corner: subtracted from a world coordinate before the divide by the grid cell size and cvttss2si (`subss xmm0, [0x02AEE070]` at 0x003917A8 and 0x003917F0 in 0x00391710, and at 0x003914FE in 0x00391410). 0x00392590 stores it from the first out-parameter of 0x00383740, which converts a signed 16-bit map header field: `movss [rsi], (float)(int16)[hdr+4]` at 0x00383790.

name: vestigialStackCopy074
meaning: A float the builder 0x003924B0 copies from stack memory nothing writes: 0x003925D2 loads [rsp+0x24] and 0x003925DB stores it here, while 0x00383740, the only producer of that buffer, writes four floats at [rsp+0x20], [rsp+0x28], [rsp+0x30] and [rsp+0x38] (0x00383790, 0x003837AE, 0x003837E5, 0x00383821). 0x02AEE074 is referenced once in the image, by this write, so no instruction reads it; in the block [0x02AEE060, 0x02AEE0C8) only it and 0x02AEE084, the other cell fed from unwritten stack, have that property; it holds whatever the stack held.

name: originAxisB
meaning: The grid origin on the second axis, the map rectangle's minimum corner, used as +0x10 is: `subss xmm4, [0x02AEE078]` at 0x003917C3 and `subss xmm0, [0x02AEE078]` at 0x003917CB, each divided by the grid cell size and truncated; the pair is applied to the caller's vector at +0x00 and +0x08. 0x003925A0 stores it from 0x00383740's second out-parameter, `movss [rdi], (float)(int16)[hdr+6]` at 0x003837AE.

name: unobservedSpan01C
meaning: No rip-relative mov operand in the image references these bytes in [0x02AEE000, 0x02AEE200); a float write through movss is not excluded. Lifetime: zero from the loader (image 0x02AEE060 in .bss, zero at rest).

name: boundsMaxA
meaning: The map rectangle's maximum corner on the first axis. 0x003925B1 (`movss [0x02AEE080], xmm7`) stores 0x00383740's third out-parameter, which 0x003837E5 computes as origin + (float)(u8[hdr+0] * u8[hdr+2]), a tile count times a tile size. 0x003924B0 takes boundsMaxA - originAxisA as the rectangle's width.

name: vestigialStackCopy084
meaning: A float the builder copies from stack memory nothing writes, the mirror of +0x14: 0x003925E3 loads [rsp+0x34] and 0x003925F4 (`movss [0x02AEE084], xmm1`) stores it here; 0x00383740 never writes [rsp+0x34], and 0x02AEE084 is referenced once in the image, by that write.

name: boundsMaxB
meaning: The map rectangle's maximum corner on the second axis. 0x003925C1 (`movss [0x02AEE088], xmm9`) stores 0x00383740's fourth out-parameter, computed at 0x00383821 as origin + (float)(u8[hdr+1] * u8[hdr+3]). 0x003924B0 takes boundsMaxB - originAxisB as the rectangle's height.

name: unobservedSpan02C
meaning: No rip-relative mov operand in the image references these bytes in [0x02AEE000, 0x02AEE200); a float write through movss is not excluded. Lifetime: zero from the loader (image 0x02AEE060 in .bss, zero at rest).

name: cellSize
meaning: The divisor of the world-to-grid transform: loaded once into xmm5 at 0x0039178A and used for every axis in the body ('divss xmm0, xmm5' at 0x003917B0, 0x003917D3, 0x003917D7, 0x003917F8). A coordinate offset from an origin and divided by this yields a cell index, so this is the grid cell size in world units.

name: unobservedSpan034
meaning: No rip-relative mov operand in the image references these bytes in [0x02AEE000, 0x02AEE200); a float write through movss is not excluded. Lifetime: zero from the loader (image 0x02AEE060 in .bss, zero at rest).

name: cellBitsetArray
meaning: The per-cell bitset array and the base of the grid's one allocation. 0x0039266A calls 0x00384580 for cellCount * (0x24 + 1) + 0x24 bytes, 0x00392677 stores the base here and 0x0039267E memsets it, with no null test between, all in the builder 0x003924B0. Each cell owns 0x24 bytes (288 bits): the query computes cell index * cellBitsetBytes + this base (0x00391888-0x00391894, also `add r9, [0x02AEE0A0]` at 0x003913A6) and ors the record byte by byte into the working mask (0x003918A0-0x003918C1). The mark 0x00392200 sets bit (id % 8) of byte (id / 8) in the record of cell row * gridWidth + column (bts), with no id range check; its callers' ids span 0..287. 0x004690B0 gates each mark: it returns 1 when the circle's centre lies in the rectangle widened by r along one axis (two bands, bounds inclusive), or when a corner is strictly inside the disk, so a circle touching a side counts and one touching only a corner does not; a NaN operand fails every test that reads it. 0x00384580 returns 0x0036A190's result unchanged; 0x0036A190 can return null through its retry body 0x0036BFE0.

name: cellByteArray
meaning: The navigation grid's per-cell count, one byte per cell, row-major gridWidth x gridHeight. 0x003926DF sets it to base + cellCount * 0x24, and the next carve starts cellCount bytes later (0x003926E9), inside cellBitsetArray's block. Each mark increments the grid cell's byte (0x0039242B, `inc byte`); the rebuild clears the bytes (0x003927D9) and so does the allocation memset 0x0039267E. The query loads it (`mov rax, [0x02AEE0A8]` at 0x00391380, again at 0x00391870) and `cmp byte ptr [rcx + rax], r12b` at 0x00391882 with rcx = width * row + column skips a zero cell at 0x00391886, a cell with no marked id. The count wraps at 256.

name: workingCandidateMask
meaning: The query's working mask, one cell bitset wide (0x24 bytes). 0x003926F3 sets it to base + cellCount * 0x24 + cellCount, the final 0x24 bytes of the allocation (the + 0x24 term in the size at 0x00392666). The query 0x003912E0 clears cellBitsetBytes bytes of it at every entry (0x003912F9..0x0039130E, after `mov rcx, [0x02AEE0B0]` at 0x00391302), ors each visited cell's bitset into it (`or byte ptr [rdx + rcx - 1], al` at 0x003918B3), and then walks it bit by bit against the NavSlotPointerArray at 0x02AEE0C0 (load at 0x00391900, `test byte ptr [r15 + rax], bl` at 0x00391907), one bit per element. The allocation memset 0x0039267E clears it as well.

name: cellBitsetBytes
meaning: The width of one cell's bitset in bytes, the constant 0x24 (36 bytes, 288 bits), stored by 0x003924CB before anything else in the builder. It is the stride into cellBitsetArray (0x00391857 loads it, `imul edx, r9d` at 0x00391888), the inner loop's trip count (0x003918B7-0x003918C1) and the query's mask-clear length (`movsxd r8, dword ptr [0x02AEE0B8]` at 0x003912F9). The population builder's three id phases (0..127, 0x80 on, 0xA0 + i) cover ids 0..287, the 288 bits exactly.

name: elementCount02AEE0BC
meaning: The element count of the NavSlotPointerArray at 0x02AEE0C0: 0x0039195C compares the walk counter with it right after `add rsi, 8` advances the array cursor, and `cmp dword ptr [0x02AEE0BC], edi` at 0x003918DC bounds the same walk.

name: currentNodeIndex
meaning: The region the mover is in along its held route, an index into nextRegion (+0x10) and nodePositionXZ (+0x90). The portal-waypoint path builder 0x00382FF0 stores it when it builds a route (0x003830A0, where it equals the start region 0x00383081 stores at +0x04, and 0x003835B8 after a search). The waypoint selector 0x00383670 reads it (0x00383699), follows nextRegion from it while 0x00383A30 reports the position inside the next region (0x003836B0-0x003836D8), reads that region's waypoint from +0x90 (0x003836F8) and stores the advanced region back (0x00383700). The state sits at BattleUnit +0x200.

name: heldRouteStartRegion
meaning: The start region of the route currently held, or 0xFF for no route: 0x00382FF0 clears it on entry (`mov dword ptr [r8 + 4], 0xff` at 0x00383037), stores the located start region (`mov dword ptr [rsi + 4], edi` at 0x00383081) and restores 0xFF when the search fails (0x003835E4). The slot is a dword while region ids are bytes elsewhere in this type.

name: heldRouteGoalRegion
meaning: The goal region of the route currently held, or 0xFF for no route. 0x0038302F 'mov dword ptr [r8 + 8], 0xff', 0x00383084 'mov dword ptr [rsi + 8], r13d', 0x003835EB resets it. Together with heldRouteStartRegion this is what lets the search skip work when the held route still applies - step 4 of the search follows nextRegion from the start and returns 0 if the chain reaches the goal, refreshing only the goal's waypoint.

name: noRouteMemory
meaning: A two-deep cache of (start, goal) region pairs for which a search failed, newest first; the search consults it before doing any work, and a repeat of either pair returns -1 without searching. 0x003839C0 empties both two-byte slots with 0xFFFF (`lea rax, [rcx + 0xc]`, `mov word ptr [rax], 0xffff`, stride 2, twice). 0x00382FF0 accesses the slots byte by byte (0x003835CB `movzx eax, byte ptr [rsi + 0xc]`, 0x003835D9 `mov byte ptr [rsi + 0xc], dil`), so each slot is a pair of one-byte region ids and 0xFFFF is the empty pair. An unreachable goal costs one full search and then nothing until the pair changes or the cache is emptied.

name: nextRegion
meaning: The successor chain of the held route: next[region] is the region to enter after this one, and 0xFF ends the chain. 0x003839F0 fills all 128 bytes with 0xFF (`lea rax, [rcx + 0x10]`, `mov byte ptr [rax], 0xff` 0x80 times). 0x00382FF0 writes it (`mov byte ptr [r13 + rsi + 0x10], 0xff` at 0x0038308D and 0x00383104, `mov byte ptr [rsi + r15 + 0x10], r14b` at 0x00383532) and reads it at 0x003830E3 while following the chain forward from the start region. The search keeps its working set in its own stack frame (`lea rbp, [rsp - 0xC40]`, `sub rsp, 0xD40`): distance at rbp-0x80 filled with 0x7FFFFFFF (0x0038315A-0x00383171), settled at rbp+0x180 filled with 0 (0x0038318B-0x00383197), predecessor at rbp+0x380 filled with -1 (0x00383176-0x00383185) and an eight-byte entry point per region at rbp+0x580 (0x003831AB), regionCount entries each; it then walks the predecessors back from the last region settled and writes next[pred] = cur here.

name: nodePositionXZ
meaning: The waypoint of each route region, 128 (x, z) float pairs, indexed by region. 0x003836F8 reads [self + region * 8 + 0x90] for the region currentNodeIndex receives one instruction later (0x00383700 `mov [rdi], esi`); 0x00383707 and 0x0038370D take the low and high floats into an output triple's +0x00 and +0x08, while the height +0x04 comes from another object (0x0038371D `mov ecx, [r14+4]`). 0x00382FF0 writes it (0x00383096, 0x003835BD). Neither reset routine touches it (0x003839C0 resets +0x0C and 0x003839F0 resets +0x10). 128 elements, 0x400 bytes; the type is 0x490.

name: vertexIndex0
meaning: Index into NavMeshVertex. Selected by constant 0 at 0x00D112B0 and by the wrap entry at 0x00D112BC.

name: vertexIndex1
meaning: Index into NavMeshVertex, selected by the constant 1 at 0x00D112B4 ('movsxd rcx, dword ptr [rbp]' at 0x00382D73 with rbp = 0x00D112B0 + 4).

name: vertexIndex2
meaning: Index into NavMeshVertex. The constant table's third entry is 2 and the walk wraps after it; the reading rests on that table rather than on the instruction that uses entry 2, which is in a part of 0x00382D10 not read here.

name: regionId
meaning: The region this triangle belongs to; with the three u16 vertex indices it fills the eight-byte element. 0x00383A30 walks the whole triangle table and filters by it: `movzx ecx, word ptr [rax + r15 + 6]` at 0x00383AC8, then `cmp ecx, r13d` at 0x00383ACE against the caller's region id, skipping the triangle when they differ. A region's triangles are also reachable through NavRegionRecord's index list at +0x14 (0x00383F10).

name: positionAxisA
meaning: First component. Differenced against another vertex's +0x00 to form an edge vector at 0x00382D9C.

name: positionAxisB
meaning: The vertex's second coordinate, +0x04 of element i of the 8-byte vertex array (0x00382DCF/0x00382DDA). The base is the pool 0x0020E600 returns for NavRunStateBlock +0x0C, and i is a uint16 vertex number from a polygon's vertex-index list (0x00382DB8, and 0x00383B58 `movzx ebx, word ptr [r14 + rcx*2]`); the same pattern reads +0x00 beside it (0x00382D91, 0x00383B31).

name: vertexIndexA
meaning: Index into NavMeshVertex, read at 0x0038390D and scaled by 8 into the pool at 0x00383918-0x00383924. The first endpoint of the portal edge handed to 0x00382EA0.

name: vertexIndexB
meaning: The portal's second endpoint vertex, read at 0x00383936 and resolved at 0x00383950 (`lea rdx, [rax + rbx*8]`). It is +0x02 of element i of the 8-byte portal array; the base is the pool 0x0020E600 returns for NavRunStateBlock +0x14, and i is a uint16 portal number from a portal-index list (0x00383392 and 0x00383D1D in the path builders, 0x00383892 `movzx edi, word ptr [rax + rcx*2]` in 0x00383850).

name: gateMarker
meaning: Whether the portal is gated by a map-id override: 0xFF means ungated. 0x003838CC compares it with 0xFF and skips the check when equal; otherwise the portal is gated on 0x0032A780 with mapId (+0x05) as the argument, whose result must be 0 or 1 or the portal is impassable (0x7FFFFFFF at 0x003838E6). An ungated portal is open when the mover class's bit of moverClassMask (+0x06) is set. It is +0x04 of element i of the 8-byte portal array; the base is the pool 0x0020E600 returns for NavRunStateBlock +0x14, and i is a uint16 portal number from a portal-index list (0x00383392 and 0x00383D1D in the path builders, 0x00383892 `movzx edi, word ptr [rax + rcx*2]` in 0x00383850).

name: mapId
meaning: The map id whose script override gates the portal, the sole argument to 0x0032A780 (`movzx ecx, byte ptr [rax + rdi*8 + 5]` at 0x003838D3), which reaches 0x0026E300. The byte indexes the script's map-id override table at 0x0209A3E0, two dwords per id (a present mask and a state mask), and the mover class picks the bit through the six-entry table at 0x00915760, {23, 25, 26, 27, -1, 24}: no override for that bit returns 0 and the class mask decides; an override with the bit clear returns 1, open; with the bit set, 2, closed; class 4 (entry -1) returns -1, closed. The shipped meshes use under 30 distinct map ids, not one above 31. It is +0x05 of element i of the 8-byte portal array (pool from 0x0020E600 for NavRunStateBlock +0x14; portal numbers from 0x00383392, 0x00383D1D and 0x00383892 in 0x00383850).

name: moverClassMask
meaning: The mover classes allowed through: 0x003838B4-0x003838C4 build 1 << class from the caller's fifth argument and `test byte ptr [rax + rdi*8 + 6], r8b`; a clear bit makes the portal impassable (0x003838F0 falls to 0x7FFFFFFF). The class is BattleUnit +0x1F4 placementMode: 1 by default, 2 for a spawn-backed unit, 3 when bit 0x8 of BattleUnit +0x1F6 is also set. The shipped masks are 0x2F on 32,467 portals, 0x08 (class 3 only) on 19,374, 0x00 on 324, 0x0C on 8 and 0x2B on 1: a walkable core plus a skirt only class-3 movers may enter. It is +0x06 of element i of the 8-byte portal array (pool from 0x0020E600 for NavRunStateBlock +0x14; portal numbers from 0x00383392, 0x00383D1D and 0x00383892 in 0x00383850).

name: unobservedTail007
meaning: The eighth byte. 0x00383850 reads +0x00, +0x02, +0x04, +0x05 and +0x06 and never this one. The portal table's other reader, 0x00383C90, may read it. Lifetime: resource data (table inside the loaded map-ctrl pack).

name: portalIndex
meaning: 0 = no portal between the two regions (0x00383896 returns 0x7FFFFFFF); otherwise an index into NavPortalRecord (index 0 is that table's reserved sentinel)

name: unobservedSpan000
meaning: Lifetime: resource data (table inside the loaded map-ctrl pack).

name: triangleCount
meaning: The number of entries in the triangle list at +0x14. Read as the loop bound at 0x0038407C ('cmp r15w, word ptr [rax + rdx + 2] ; jae') and again at 0x003840E9.

name: unobservedSpan004
meaning: Lifetime: resource data (table inside the loaded map-ctrl pack).

name: triangleIndices
meaning: u16 indices into NavMeshTriangle, read at 0x003840A9 as 'movzx ebx, word ptr [rax + rdx*2 + 0x14]' with rdx = regionId*0x11 + i. Each is multiplied by 8 to form a NavMeshTriangle base (0x003840C0) and handed with the query position to 0x00382D10; a return of 1 ends the search and yields the region id. The length seven is the record's remaining space, not a count read from the image - 0x22 - 0x14 = 14 bytes = 7 entries. It is an upper bound the layout permits.

name: headerOne
meaning: The dataset header's first dword, 1 in all 461 shipped sections. No instruction reads it as a field: the whole-buffer copy 0x00378BC0 carries it (memcpy at 0x00378D27, size from the allocation header) before the loader takes the buffer, the loader 0x00384160 rebases +0x0C..+0x20 and +0x28 only (not the count +0x24), and none of the 21 functions that reach the block through 0x02AEDFB0 or the 66 accesses through that pointer touch +0x00. The qword read at 0x003832D6 is 0x00382FF0's second argument reloaded from the stack, not this field.

name: vertexCount
meaning: The vertex count: in all 461 shipped sections it equals the vertex table's length and every triangle and portal vertex index is below it. No instruction reads or writes it through the block pointer 0x02AEDFB0; the 0xFF stores at 0x0038302F and 0x00383037 go through 0x00382FF0's third argument (`mov rsi, r8` at 0x0038301C), not this block.

name: triangleCount
meaning: The triangle count, the trip count of the triangle walk in 0x00383A30: 0x00383A84 zeroes r12d, `cmp r12w, word ptr [rcx + 6]` at 0x00383AAD bounds it, and the loop reads NavMeshTriangle +0x06 (`word ptr [rax + r15 + 6]` at 0x00383AC8) from the table 0x0020E600 resolves for +0x10. r12 counts elements (`inc r12d` at 0x00383C11) while r15 steps bytes (`mov r15d, r12d` at 0x00383AB8, `add r15, 8` at 0x00383C14). The body checks the caller's region id against 0xFF first (0x00383A41). Read only; no writer in the image.

name: portalCount
meaning: The portal count: in all 461 shipped sections it equals the highest region-adjacency entry or that plus one, the portal table's length with or without its zero no-portal entry. No instruction reads or writes it through the block pointer; the store at 0x0038302F goes through 0x00382FF0's third argument, not this block.

name: regionCount
meaning: The region count, read as a word by 0x00382FF0, 0x00383850 (portal traversal cost) and 0x00383C90 (portal waypoint clearance), six reads and no write. It is the row stride of the region adjacency matrix: 0x00383883-0x0038388C in 0x00383850 compute `movzx r10d, word ptr [r11 + 0xa]`, `imul r10d, ebx`, `add r10d, ebp` and index the table 0x0020E600 resolves for +0x1C at scale 2. 0x00383150 reads it (`movzx r8d, word ptr [r8 + 0xa]`) as the element count of the search's four working arrays (0x0038315A-0x00383197).

name: encodedRefVertexPool
meaning: The encoded reference to the mesh vertex pool, NavMeshVertex[] (stride 8, two floats). The loader fixes it up first (0x00384174-0x00384196). It is the block's most-used reference, 19 accesses across six bodies: 0x00382D10 resolves it with 0x0020E600 and indexes the result by a triangle's u16 vertex index at scale 8 (0x00382D91, 0x00382D9C).

name: encodedRefTriangles
meaning: The encoded reference to the triangle table, NavMeshTriangle[] (stride 8). The loader fixes it up at 0x00384199-0x003841B6. The region containment test 0x00383A30 reads it at 0x00383AC0 to walk the triangles, and 0x00383F10 forms an element base from it (`lea rcx, [rax + rbx*8]` at 0x003840C0) for the containment test. The region table is +0x18.

name: encodedRefPortals
meaning: The encoded reference to the portal table, NavPortalRecord[] (stride 8). The loader fixes it up at 0x003841B9-0x003841D6; 0x00382FF0, 0x00383850 and 0x00383C90 read it. 0x00383850 indexes it by the non-zero entry it found in the adjacency matrix: `test byte ptr [rax + rdi*8 + 6], r8b` (0x003838C4), `cmp byte ptr [rax + rdi*8 + 4], 0xff` (0x003838CC), `movzx esi, word ptr [rax + rdi*8]` (0x0038390D) and `movzx ebx, word ptr [rax + rdi*8 + 2]` (0x00383936).

name: encodedRefRegionTable
meaning: The encoded reference to the region table, NavRegionRecord[] (stride 0x22), fixed up at 0x003841D9-0x003841F6 and read by 0x00383F10 and 0x00384160. 0x00383F10 indexes it by a region id byte from the broad-phase cell lists (0x00384078, 0x003840E5); each record carries a count at +0x02 and up to seven triangle indices from +0x14.

name: encodedRefRegionAdjacency
meaning: The encoded reference to the region adjacency matrix, NavRegionAdjacencyEntry[regionCount * regionCount], fixed up at 0x003841F9-0x00384216. The portal-cost evaluator 0x00383850 reads it at 0x00383372/0x00383863/0x00383874 and indexes it as regionA * regionCount + regionB at scale 2 (0x00383883-0x00383892), reading a u16: zero means no connection (0x00383896 tests it and 0x0038389A returns 0x7FFFFFFF, the impassable cost), and a non-zero entry is an index into the portal table at +0x14. The portal clearance adjustment 0x00383C90 also reads it.

name: encodedRefBroadPhaseHeader
meaning: The encoded reference to the broad-phase header, NavBroadPhaseHeader (0x10 bytes), which the loader 0x00384160 fixes up at 0x00384219-0x00384236; the header's own references at +0x08 and +0x0C are fixed up at 0x00384239-0x003842A0. 0x00383740 resolves it with 0x0020E600 and reads the map rectangle from it: minimum corner (float)(int16)[hdr+4] and (float)(int16)[hdr+6] (0x00383790, 0x003837AE), maximum that minimum plus (u8)[hdr+0] * (u8)[hdr+2] and (u8)[hdr+1] * (u8)[hdr+3] (0x003837E5, 0x00383821); 0x003924B0 turns that rectangle into NavGridParams. It heads a coarse lookup grid whose cells hold 0xFF-terminated region id lists: 0x00383F10 rejects NaN, bounds-checks the position against the rectangle, indexes the grid cell array row-major, walks the grid cell's region list and tests each region's triangles until one contains the point.

name: trailerRecordCount
meaning: the number of trailer records at +0x28 (0x20 bytes each; ../Movement-And-Pathfinding/navigation-mesh-and-pathfinding.md: at most 32 used): the per-field-frame sector refill 0x00392740 (from 0x00234590 at 0x00234849) takes the dataset from 0x00383840, clamps this count to 32 (0x00392904 mov edx, 0x20 / 0x00392909 cmp [rax+0x24], edx / 0x0039290C cmovb) and walks that many trailer records; shipped 0 in 433 of 461 sections, otherwise 1 (10), 2 (3), 3 (1), 7 (2), 9 (1), 10 (1), 11 (1), 12 (1), 13 (1), 16 (2), 20 (2), 24 (2) and 32 (1), so the clamp to 32 never cuts a shipped count

name: encodedRef0028
meaning: The encoded reference to the trailer records, NavTrailerRecord28[+0x24], fixed up last (0x003842A3-0x003842CC). The loader 0x00384160 reads it, and so do the population builder 0x00392740 (0x00392920) and the reader at 0x00391597, which decode it through 0x0020E600 after reaching the block through the root getter 0x00383840.

name: zero2C
meaning: The header's last dword before the first table at +0x30: 0 in all 461 shipped sections (the first table offset is 0x30 in every one). name: element
