meaning: Four bytes that no instruction writes: they sit at 0x01F82F04, past the .data raw end 0x01F7E400, so the loader fills them with zeros. The two constant-buffer uploads copy from +0x04 for the shader variable's reflected size (0x001F8166, 0x001F9A24).

name: chrShadowDepthBias
meaning: the scene setting mChrShadowDepthBias, read as an integer by both loaders; the renderer 0x001F5D70 converts it to float (cvtdq2ps) and passes it with +0x24 as the character shadow depth-bias / slope pair

name: requestBit
meaning: the request's bit index (the column, 0..7): the bit it owns in both masks and in the actor manager slot's skip mask +0x201

name: managerRow
meaning: the entry's row (actor manager 0..4): the index into the pending / active masks

name: state
meaning: 0 idle, 1 registered (skipstart), 2 running (begun); 0x00360650 answers whether it is 2; the end clears it

name: unobservedSpan03
meaning: A byte with no access. Zero at load: the storage is in the .data tail past the raw end 0x01F7E400, which the loader fills with zeros.

name: registrantId
meaning: the registering script actor's word +0x00, stored by the registration: script verb 0x051A skipstart (handler 0x0034D3A0) passes word [actor] as the third argument

name: begun
meaning: 1 once the skip begin has run for this entry, 0 at registration; returned by 0x003604A0 (script command 0x0034F160)

name: armed
meaning: 1 from registration until the end; the begin refuses an entry that is not armed

name: entries
meaning: the skip request slots, row = actor manager (0..4), column = request index (0..7); manager 0 is refused by the begin

name: skipSavedMusic
meaning: the music value the skip begin saved (0x002DEBE0(-1), which answers dword 0x0215EF44 - the value 0x002DEC00 also answers) before it calls 0x002DEDD0; the skip end 0x003608D0 resumes through 0x00361620 when it is not negative; 0x00360960 sets it and the two words after it; returned by the getter 0x003604C0, which verbs 0x0363 getnowmusicno (0x003549D0) and 0x02C7 musictrans (0x00340260) call

name: savedWord284
meaning: The second argument of the music save 0x00360960(music, this, resume) (0x0036096B): the skip exec 0x00360710 writes it as 0 (0x00360785, ebp = 0 since 0x00360720), the verb bodies 0x00343C60, 0x00345010, 0x00345B60, 0x00346C00 and 0x00350EC0 pass 0 (0x00343CAB, 0x00345041, 0x00345BEF, 0x00346CA2, 0x00350EF8), and 0x00342F80 passes its frame's +0x0C dword (0x00342FE6). No function reads it: its rip-relative references are the two stores, and none of the 21 functions that access the block reads it.

name: skipSavedResumeArg
meaning: set to 1 by the skip begin and by 0x00360960 (third argument); passed on the stack to 0x00361620 when the skip end resumes the music

name: anyManagerSkipActive
meaning: 1 while any of managers 1..3 has a skip active (active mask rows 1..3 non-zero), recomputed by 0x003606E0; cleared by the initialiser; returned sign-extended by 0x003606A0, which 0x00361810 (called from 0x00361BF0 / 0x00361CF0 and 0x003631B0) calls at 0x00361B93

name: unobservedSpan28D
meaning: Three bytes with no access. Zero at load: the storage is in the .data tail past the raw end 0x01F7E400, which the loader fills with zeros.

name: pendingMask
meaning: One mask per manager row: bit k is set while request k is registered and has not begun; the registration sets it, and the begin and the end clear it. 0x003606B0 tests rows 1..3, and the engine path 0x00360880 begins the first pending request of managers 1..3.

name: unobservedSpan2A4
meaning: Four bytes between the two masks with no access. Zero at load: the storage is in the .data tail past the raw end 0x01F7E400, which the loader fills with zeros.

name: activeMask
meaning: per manager row: bit k set while request k's skip is running (begun); set by the begin, cleared by the registration and the end; 0x00360670 and 0x003606E0 test rows 1..3

name: elapsed
meaning: tick counter: the dispatcher adds (i16)stepIncrement every pass; when it reaches duration the +0x08 completion callback fires and the slot frees. A task that sets stepIncrement = 0 owns the dword itself - the party-read task uses it as its 6-state machine state (0x0037C730 writes 1..5, duration 4 is the terminal)

name: duration
meaning: The threshold elapsed counts toward; copied into +0x00 by the completer and set by callers (0x0037C910 writes 0x0A; 0x002F1C50 writes global01DFE0B4-or-1 x arg).

name: onComplete
meaning: completion callback, invoked once with rcx=record when elapsed>=duration, then the slot's busy bit clears; may be null. 0x002F1C50 installs 0x002F18A0; 0x002F1710 runs it for the head task 0x022BE7D0

name: onTick
meaning: per-pass callback invoked each dispatched tick while the slot is gated in; 0x0037C910 installs the eleven-state machine 0x0037C3F0, 0x0037C980 installs 0x0037C730

name: slotIndex
meaning: the slot's own index 0-31, written by the allocator; completers/dispatchers turn it into the busy-mask bit (1 << slotIndex)

name: stepIncrement
meaning: Signed per-tick delta added to elapsed; allocator and completer write 1, callers may write 0 to pause (0x0037C910 leaves its task paused - the callback advances state itself).

name: taskTag
meaning: a findable tag: 0x002F1A30 walks the busy slots comparing movsx(word,+0x1E) against its arg; the default dispatch variant also skips records whose tag == 1

name: dispatchGate
meaning: dispatch enable for the r14d==1 variant: the pass skips records whose gate byte is 0; allocator writes 1, the wait-API writes 0

name: scratch21
meaning: Three bytes between dispatchGate and flagByte with no access; the +0x23 byte written by 0x0037C730 lands on a 0x00263750 return value, not on this record.

name: scratchDword24
meaning: A dword that no instruction of the allocator, the dispatcher or the completer accesses.

name: callbackFlags
meaning: scratch flag byte for callbacks: the tick cb 0x002F18D0 tests bit 0x4; allocator zeroes the +0x28 dword

name: scratch29
meaning: The rest of the +0x28 dword the allocator zeroes; no other access reaches these bytes.

name: taskScratch2C
meaning: A 12-byte span before callbackParam that no instruction of the allocator, the dispatcher or the completer accesses.

name: callbackParam
meaning: a callback-supplied parameter: tick cb 0x002F18D0 reads it as edx for the 0x003587B0 call

name: tailPad3C
meaning: The record's tail, which no instruction of the allocator, the dispatcher or the completer accesses. Zero at load: the records sit in the loader-zeroed part of .data (0x022BDEC0).

name: fadeStartTimer
meaning: A double the layer start 0x002EFA70 zeroes when it restarts a layer whose state is 2 (finished), on the path that also sets 0x01F8127C / 0x01EEBADC to 1 when they are 0; 0x001C2F50 subtracts it from a time value (0x0017D8D0) and compares the difference with a constant.

name: overrideColour
meaning: the one-shot fade colour script verb 0x00BA fadecolor sets (four bytes from cl, dl, r8b, r9b); the next layer start copies it into the record's colour and clears +0x0C

name: overrideColourArmed
meaning: 1 after fadecolor; the next layer start uses +0x08 and clears it; the reset clears it

name: fadeKindHigh
meaning: the high nibble of the descriptor's kind byte (record +0x09): script verb 0x00BC fadetrans sets it; a start with a non-zero direction over a non-free layer reloads it from that layer's previous kind byte; reset to 3 after every layer start and by the reset

name: unobservedSpan00E
meaning: Two bytes with no direct reference. Zero at load: the storage is in the .data tail past the raw end 0x01F7E400, which the loader fills with zeros.

name: layers
meaning: the seven screen-fade layer records; every fade to black or white the game shows is one of them

name: fadePriority
meaning: the descriptor's priority byte (record +0x0B): script verb 0x00CF fadeprior sets it; a start with a non-zero direction over a non-free layer reloads it from that layer's previous priority; reset to 0 after every layer start and by the reset

name: fadeKindLow
meaning: the low nibble of the descriptor's kind byte (record +0x09): script verb 0x0158 fadelayer sets it; a start with a non-zero direction over a non-free layer reloads it from that layer's previous kind byte; reset to 6 after every layer start and by the reset

name: effectFadeHandle
meaning: the single effect-fade handle beside the layers, driven by verbs 0x0268 efffadein / 0x0269 efffadeout through 0x002EFD50 / 0x002EFD80 / 0x002EFDC0; cleared by the reset

name: beginHandler
meaning: The async begin entry. The records begin at 0x01EED708 (table+8+32N) and end at 0x01EF9208: the count word 0x5D8 = 1496 sits at table+0. 277 of the 1496 records carry a begin entry, every one inside .text; most verbs have no begin entry, because most are immediate and carry only the result entry at +0x18.

name: pollHandler
meaning: The async poll entry. The records begin at 0x01EED708 (table+8+32N) and end at 0x01EF9208: the count word 0x5D8 = 1496 sits at table+0. 230 of the 1496 records carry a poll entry, every one inside .text; 27 records carry a poll without a begin, a real shape of the table.

name: unusedSlot
meaning: A slot that is null in every record: all 1496 of this family, and all 1,960 records of the five command tables. The records begin at 0x01EED708 (table+8+32N) and end at 0x01EF9208, with the count word 0x5D8 = 1496 at table+0. The 32-byte record declares the slot and nothing fills it, so nothing may dispatch on it; the one non-null value once counted at +0x18 was the filler past the table's end.

name: resultHandler
meaning: The immediate result entry, the common case: 1234 of the 1496 records carry one, every one inside .text. The records begin at 0x01EED708 (table+8+32N) and end at 0x01EF9208, with the count word 0x5D8 = 1496 at table+0.

name: verb5D1Value
meaning: The value the script verb 0x5D1 (unkCall_5d1 in the verb table) stores: its handler 0x0033F870 pops an int (the value-stack int pop 0x00267E10) and stores it (0x0033F87C); the title-return gate 0x00360120 zeroes it through 0x00357B00 when the field is torn down (the game over page); read through 0x00357780 by the main-loop draw 0x0022B0B0, which runs the UI-root update 0x002450B0 on the root 0x0208EA40 only while it is non-zero (0x0022B694-0x0022B6A4), and by 0x00252A70 (from the main-loop draw 0x0022B0B0 at 0x0022B646, and from 0x0022B7E0), which updates root 0x0208EA28 and then 0x0208EA40 only while it is zero (0x00252AF0-0x00252B0C) - a non-zero value moves root 0x0208EA40's update into the main-loop draw 0x0022B0B0's own pass (the subsystem update flags page: 0x0208EA28 / 0x0208EA40 / 0x0208EA48 / 0x0208EA50 are the four UI root objects); rip-relative references: the store, the clear and the read; its one address load (0x00339AAD) is the end bound of 0x00339A60's walk over the 0x60-byte table at 0x022C7E00 (0x00339AA4-0x00339AC1), not an access; image-base-relative scan clean.

name: authoredBracket
meaning: Authored begin/end bracket: verb 0x05CD (0x00341030) sets 1, verb 0x05CE (0x003413E0) sets 0; non-zero makes the script stand-down gate fire every step. Accessed at 0x022C7F84 by 0x00229590, 0x0025DF00, 0x002AEB20, 0x00341030, 0x003413E0, 0x0034CF90.

name: commandWaiting
meaning: 'a script command is still waiting': 0x00357760 zeroes it before a bytecode step, the waiting-command handlers raise it, 0x00357770 returns it after. Accessed at 0x022C7F88 by 0x0033F8E0, 0x003401F0, 0x00340C70, 0x003414E0, 0x00341D70, 0x00342450.

name: kind00
meaning: 6, stored by the resolver 0x00262440 (0x00262667); `PUSHP` then overwrites it with the original width nibble (descriptor18 >> 28, 0x00268150) and pushes its low byte as the pushed value's source kind (0x00268180 / 0x00268185) (check P).

name: kind04
meaning: The value kind (check K): 2 (float) when descriptor bit 0x8000000 is set, else the resolver's r13w, 1 (integer) on the class routes (0x00262650 / 0x00262657); `POPV` reads it signed (0x00267E84) and converts the popped value by it before the store.

name: unobservedSpan06
meaning: Two bytes the resolver does not write. The reference lives in its callers' stack frame, bound to 0x30 bytes, and no clear covers it on the route, so these bytes hold what the frame left until the first write.

name: source08
meaning: the word at the resolver's second argument (0x00262676 / 0x0026267A)

name: operand0A
meaning: the variable operand, the resolver's r9w (0x0026248D) - the table index

name: tableDescriptor0C
meaning: the operand table entry's descriptor dword (read at 0x0026247C, stored at 0x00262492)

name: address10
meaning: The resolved base: the class base selected by descriptor bits under mask `0x7000000` plus the low 24 bits (0x00262639..0x00262661); 0x0026D530 and `PUSHV` index it.

name: descriptor18
meaning: The final descriptor: the bits under mask `0xF0000000` select the width that 0x0026D530 and `PUSHV` dispatch on (0..5; above 5 no access): 0 u8, 1 s8, 2 u16, 3 s16, 4 and 5 dword. `PUSHP` reads it (0x00268118) and pushes the reference low32((d & 0xFFFFFF) + low32(index1C * stride)) or (d & 0x07000000) or 0x70000000, with stride 1, 2 or 4 for widths 0-1, 2-3 or 4-5 (unscaled above 5) and no mask after the add (0x00268166): the class is kept and the width is 7 only while the sum stays below 2^24, so 0x02FFFFFF + 1 gives 73000000 (class 3) and 0x02000000 - 1 gives FFFFFFFF (class 7, width 15, bit 0x8000000 set).

name: index1C
meaning: The element index, read sign-extended by 0x0026D530 and `PUSHV` (0x00262672 stores r10d). For an array (a u16 rank at the array header +4, s32 dimensions from +8) the resolver sums, last dimension first, each stage times the product of the later dimensions (check C): the stage is m = max(subscript, 0) if m < dim (signed 32-bit), else the 32-bit dim - 1 (check A) - min(max(subscript, 0), dim - 1) for strictly positive dimensions, the only case it stays in range; a zero dimension gives -1, a negative one dim - 1, and -2^31 (0x80000000) wraps to 0x7FFFFFFF for every subscript; nothing validates the dimensions. The first popped subscript pairs with the last dimension, and the products, contributions and sum are all 32-bit (imul, imul, add; no overflow branch), so they wrap modulo 2^32 and the store reads the result signed (check L): e.g. dims 65536 x 65536 at (32768, 0) give 0x80000000, read as -2^31. `PUSHP` reads it too (0x00268120) and scales it by the width's stride in 32 bits (check P).

name: value20
meaning: The value: `POPV` stores it before calling 0x0026D530 (0x00267F1A for kind 1; 0x00267EC1, 0x00267ED5, 0x00267EEA for kind 2), and `PUSHV` loads the variable into it (0x00268008). `POPV` converts first, by kind04: kind 1 truncates a float operand with cvttss2si (1.75 -> 1; 2^31 and above, and NaN, give 0x80000000 under masked `MXCSR`) and copies an int raw; kind 2 converts an int with cvtdq2ps, which rounds by the thread's `MXCSR` rounding mode (`POPV` sets no rounding mode): exact for abs(n) <= 2^24, above that the mode decides (16777217 -> 16777216 under nearest-even, 16777218 under round-up; -16777219 -> -16777220 under nearest-even, -16777218 under round-up). An empty stack gives 0. Then 0x0026D530 clamps the signed result by width, so a float >= 2^31 popped into a u8 variable stores 0x00: u8 [0, 255], s8 [-128, 127], u16 [0, 0xFFFF], s16 [-32767, +32768] then the low word (+32768 stores 0x8000, read back signed as -32768), dword raw.

name: unobservedSpan24
meaning: Bytes that the resolver, `POPV`, `PUSHV` and 0x0026D530 do not access. The reference lives in its callers' stack frame, bound to 0x30 bytes, and no clear covers it on the route, so these bytes hold what the frame left until the first write.

name: vtable
meaning: 0x01CB4480 (RTTI FixedList<0, SeadHandle>); slot 0 = 0x007A98E0, the scalar deleting destructor, sized free 0x30

name: capacity
meaning: the node count Init (0x007AA010) allocates; the reset walks node i < capacity (0x007B6AB1)

name: count
meaning: active nodes: insert increments it (0x007AF459), reset and Init clear it

name: nodes
meaning: the node array, capacity x 0x28 after an 8-byte count cookie (Init 0x007AA0AB..0x007AA0E5); array-deleted by the destructor through the element's vector deleting destructor

name: freeHead
meaning: the free chain head: reset sets it to nodes (0x007B6AAA), insert pops it (0x007AF416 / 0x007AF41A)

name: activeHead
meaning: the active list head: insert prepends here (0x007AF44C); reset clears it

name: activeTail
meaning: the active list tail: set when the first node is inserted (0x007AF426); reset clears it

name: vtable
meaning: 0x01CB4530 (RTTI `FixedList<0, SeadHandle>::NODE`), stamped by Init (0x007AA0C1); the array delete calls its slot 0

name: prev
meaning: previous node: free chain links (reset 0x007B6AD0) and active list links (insert)

name: next
meaning: next node: free chain (reset 0x007B6AD9, insert pops through it) and active list (insert 0x007AF440)

name: index
meaning: -1 at Init (0x007AA0CC), the node's own array index after the reset (0x007B6AC4); insert returns it (0x007AF461)

name: flags
meaning: 0 at Init; insert ORs 1 (0x007AF450).

name: payload
meaning: The SeadHandle the node carries (RTTI of the template argument); insert stores its r8 here (0x007AF455).

name: elements
meaning: The six-element bound-entity array: each 0x30-stride element carries one bound entryId and resource pair, its pending parameter vector and its motion-control bytes. Six slots, shown by byte-identical per-element access sequences on all six bases (0x002E35B0, 0x002E8FD0, 0x002E4A40) and the shared mutator 0x00269D60; the element type is SecondaryContextElement.

name: attachInfoEntry0
meaning: Slot 0 of the three-slot attachinfo qword table +0x120..+0x137 (bounded above by movementBody at +0x138): verb 01C8 attachinfo, 0x00355D20, stores its address argument at +0x120 + index x 8 through 0x0026A140 (0x0026A154); the clear 0x0025D480 stores 0 here (0x0025D493).

name: attachInfoEntry1
meaning: Slot 1 of the three-slot attachinfo qword table +0x120..+0x137: verb 01C8 attachinfo, 0x00355D20, stores its address argument here through 0x0026A140 (0x0026A154) for index 1; the clear 0x0025D480 stores 0 here (0x0025D4A1).

name: attachInfoEntry2
meaning: Slot 2 of the three-slot attachinfo qword table +0x120..+0x137: verb 01C8 attachinfo, 0x00355D20, stores its address argument here through 0x0026A140 (0x0026A154) for index 2; the clear 0x0025D480 stores 0 here (0x0025D4AF).

name: movementBody
meaning: A pointer to the actor's movement body - a 0x130-byte entry of the 128-entry pool at 0x02B4E4C0. 0x002E3500 creates the body and stores it here (0x002E3546) after releasing any previous one (0x002E352D); 0x002E3AF0 and 0x002E3D00 null it (0x002E3BB5, 0x002E3D2D). Twenty readers take it, among them the secondary control 0x0025B600, whose cmp qword [ctx+0x138], 0 at 0x0025B644 is a liveness test rather than a value read.

name: presentationYOffsetPrimary
meaning: The primary half of a two-part presentation Y offset: its only recorded writer, the primary-offset setter 0x00269E20, stores it at 0x00269E2C. The two halves are always summed and never used alone: all four recorded readers do `movss xmm, [ctx+0x140]` then `addss xmm, [ctx+0x144]`, at 0x0025BBA0/0x0025BBAC, 0x0025C29E/0x0025C2AA, 0x0026391F/0x0026392B and 0x0026842B/0x00268437, so the effective offset is primary + secondary. At 0x0025BBA0 the sum is added to the world position Y from MovementContext +0x04 to place the presentation. The halves have different setters, so two callers can contribute independently.

name: presentationYOffsetSecondary
meaning: The secondary half of the two-part presentation Y offset: its only recorded writer, the secondary-offset setter 0x00269E40, stores it at 0x00269E4C. Every recorded read is an `addss` onto the primary: all four readers do `movss xmm, [ctx+0x140]` then `addss xmm, [ctx+0x144]`, at 0x0025BBA0/0x0025BBAC, 0x0025C29E/0x0025C2AA, 0x0026391F/0x0026392B and 0x0026842B/0x00268437, so the effective offset is primary + secondary. The halves have different setters, so two callers can contribute independently.

name: movementBodyWeight
meaning: The weight the actor's movement body runs with, held here and pushed into the body at body +0x08: both 0x002685F0 and 0x0026DAC0 load it, take the body pointer from +0x138 and store it with `movss [rcx+8], xmm0`. 0x0026DAC0 is the setter: it writes +0x148 first (0x0026DACC) and then re-pushes. 0x00266530 initialises it to 1.0f (0x00266847). 0x00265950 is a plain getter returning 0.0f when the context is null. All of them reach the context through the actor's +0xC0.

name: tailByte14C
meaning: A signed byte past the six-element array: 0x002E6090 stores its second argument here (0x002E609C) through the actor's +0xC0, together with +0x14D, and the getter 0x002657E0 returns it sign-extended (0x002657FB) for an actor whose kind bits (`and al, 0xe0`) are 0x60, else 1 (0x00265803).

name: tailByte14D
meaning: A signed byte past the six-element array: 0x002E6090 stores its third argument here (0x002E60A9) through the actor's +0xC0, together with +0x14C, and the getter 0x00263FC0 returns it sign-extended (0x00263FDB) for an actor whose kind bits (`and al, 0xe0`) are 0x60, else 0 (0x00263FE3).

name: zeroTestedByte14E
meaning: A byte read as a zero-or-not gate: 0x002E6330 tests it with `cmp byte ptr [rax + 0x14e], 0` (0x002E638C) after finding the movement body at +0x138 non-null. 0x00266530 stores 1 here (0x0026685D) just after initialising +0x148 to 1.0f.

name: attachFlags
meaning: The attach flags byte. 0x002E3AF0 clears bit 0x1 (0x002E3B80 `and byte ptr [rax + 0x14f], 0xfe`) and 0x0025D480 clears bit 0x4 (0x0025D4BD) after zeroing the three slots (0x0025D493-0x0025D4AF); bit 0x2 is fightMode, written by 01A7 setfightmode and 02E1 clearforcerelax through 0x002E8540 (`and byte ptr [r8 + 0x14f], 0xfd` / `or` at 0x002E854C, 0x002E855B); bit 0x4 is attachInfoPresent, set by 01C8 attachinfo through 0x0026A140 (0x0026A163 `or byte ptr [rax + 0x14f], 4`) alongside the +0x120 table store.

name: pad150
meaning: An alignment byte between the byte +0x14F and the byte +0x151, with no access among the 599 recorded accesses (123 functions) of the context and no block copy over it; zero from the records block's memset at allocation (0x00267A8B).

name: presentationFlags
meaning: The presentation flags byte; 0x002E5180 clears bit 0x4 (0x002E51BD `and byte ptr [rax + 0x151], 0xfb`). Bit 0x2 is floatStatus (01E1 setfloatstatus through 0x0026A7C0, 0x0026A7D1); bit 0x8 is shadowVisible (010E showshadow, 010F hideshadow, 0112 and 0410 partyshowshadow through 0x002ECD80, 0x002ECD9C, gated on kind 3); bit 0x10 is ambient (0116 setambient, 0117 resetambient, 04E0 and 04E1 fetchambient through 0x0026AD40, 0x0026AD4C); bit 0x80 is written by the sibling 0x0026AF40 (0x0026AF4C).

name: moveModeOverride
meaning: move-mode override selector read by 0x002681E0 on kind-3 actors: 0 = derive from state (0x003590D0/0x003589B0 compare path), 2 -> resolved mode 3, 3 -> resolved mode 5, anything else -> 2

name: resolvedMoveMode
meaning: low byte of the resolved move mode: 0x002681E0 pushes the computed mode as a WORD to movementBody+0x80 (ctx+0x138) and mirrors its low byte here

name: relaxMotionFlags
meaning: The relax-motion flags byte, written by 02E1 clearforcerelax and 0565 refresh_fightmotion through 0x0026A770: bit 0x2 is set when the second argument is non-zero (0x0026A77C-0x0026A78B) and bit 0x1 when the third is (0x0026A799-0x0026A7AA).

name: pad155
meaning: Alignment after the bytes +0x151..+0x154 (+0x153 is stored at 0x002682B5), with no access among the 599 recorded accesses (123 functions) of the context and no block copy over it; zero from the records block's memset at allocation (0x00267A8B).

name: stopSet5AnimationLive
meaning: stop set 5 (animation rate) live bitset - the folded result of pendingSet +0x15C / pendingClear +0x160; a turn from zero to non-zero or back queues the actor id on its manager list +0x1F0 (0x002269A0, 0x00226A00-0x00226A31)

name: stopSet5AnimationPendingSet
meaning: Pending set-word for stop set 5: writers edit only this word; 0x002269A0 folds it into live +0x158 and zeroes it.

name: stopSet5AnimationPendingClear
meaning: pending clear-word for stop set 5: folded out of live +0x158 (live &= ~pending) by 0x002269A0

name: stopSet4PresentationLive
meaning: Stop set 4 live bitset - presentation override: nonzero forces the script-hide effect for the visibility refresh 0x002E8FD0 (0x002E904A), 0x002E7E90, 0x002E9FE0.

name: stopSet4PresentationPendingSet
meaning: pending set-word for stop set 4, folded into live +0x164 by 0x00226640

name: stopSet4PresentationPendingClear
meaning: pending clear-word for stop set 4, folded out of live +0x164 by 0x00226640

name: stopSet3RenderLive
meaning: stop set 3 live bitset - the render-record +0x284 side; transition hook 0x002E92F0 fires on 0<->nonzero (registry doc sec.5 row 3)

name: stopSet3RenderPendingSet
meaning: pending set-word for stop set 3, folded into live +0x170 by 0x00226640

name: stopSet3RenderPendingClear

meaning: 0..4 selects one slot of the parallel arrays at 0x01F832B0 (dword per slot), 0x01F832F0 and 0x01F83390 (0x20 per slot); -1 (the image value) selects no slot for every reader that bounds-checks it; 0x0020AE70 (via the tail-jump 0x001EC670) indexes 0x01F832B0 with it unchecked (0x0020AE8B read, 0x0020AEEA inc). The setters 0x001EC520, 0x001EC540, 0x001EC620 and 0x001EC680 store their first argument, or -1 when it is above 4 (unsigned); 0x0020A760, 0x0020AC30 and 0x0020AF10 store theirs unclamped (0x0020AC30 and 0x0020AF10 then test it against 4); 0x0020A760 and 0x0020AC30 both always end by storing -1 (each has one exit, after that store)

name: flag
meaning: segment-present flag: the layout writes 1 on each arm that exists (head 0x0019A71C, middle 0x0019A741, tail 0x0019A752) and never clears one - the conditional layout invariant of SR-6 lives on these being 0 at claim time; zeroed by the ctor and the reset

name: pad01
meaning: alignment between the present flag and the buffer pointer: read and written by no instruction in the 25 slow-reader bodies 0x0019A2A0-0x0019B400 - a descriptor is touched at +0x00, +0x08, +0x10 and +0x14 only (ctor 0x0019A2E7-0x0019A351, layout 0x0019A71C-0x0019A759, fill 0x0019A8B2-0x0019A8DB, finish 0x0019AA83-0x0019AB2A, reset 0x0019B140-0x0019B154); operator new(0x18) in the record ctor leaves the bytes indeterminate

name: buffer
meaning: the 0x10000-byte block buffer allocated beside this descriptor (mov ecx,0x10000; call 0x00210EC0; mov [rdi+8],rax) - the inflater/fread target for its block

name: length
meaning: the block's byte length: head arm stores H=min(0x10000-r,N) (0x0019A727), tail arm stores T=R mod 0x10000 (0x0019A759); the finish's tally reads it for head and tail (mov r14d,[rax+0x10] at 0x0019AB65 / add r14d,[rax+0x10] at 0x0019ADCD)

name: offset
meaning: the head block's offset r within its 0x10000 block (0x0019A72F); written only on the head arm - the ctor does not initialise it, so middle and tail descriptors keep uninitialised bytes here

name: cryptoProvider
meaning: CryptAcquireContextW's phProv output cell: the call 0x0019AEBE passes M itself as the first argument, so the provider handle lands here; zeroed beforehand (0x0019AEB3). The call's own return is never tested

name: bank
meaning: the embedded record bank - the builder 0x0019B200 receives M+8 (0x0019AE87 add rcx,8) and fills semaphore/count/records

name: archiveSlots
meaning: the five archive mount slots: 0x0019B070 walks +0x20..+0x40 with a signed index below 5 and mounts the first null; each holds a 0xB0 archive object (alloc 0x0019B0AF, ctor, opener 0x001F4340) or 0; zeroed at construction

name: criticalSection
meaning: the critical section the cleanup enters/leaves around the record release (EnterCriticalSection 0x0019A9CE, LeaveCriticalSection 0x0019AA01); initialized by the ctor's tail call 0x0019AED2. Win64 RTL_CRITICAL_SECTION is 0x28 bytes - +0x48..+0x70

name: pathSkip70
meaning: zeroed at construction (0x0019AE7F); read by the fast lookup 0x0019AEE0 (FL-9) as its path-skip cell

name: qword78
meaning: zeroed at construction (0x0019AE83); no other access observed in the pinned bodies

name: byte00
meaning: zeroed by the ctor (0x0019A355) and by the reset (0x0019B140); no other access in the pinned bodies

name: pad01
meaning: alignment after the ctor's zero byte +0x00 (0x0019A355, reset 0x0019B140): read and written by no instruction in the 25 slow-reader bodies 0x0019A2A0-0x0019B400 (read whole: no memory operand with this displacement on any base, no memset or block copy over the record); indeterminate until a write: 0x0019B200 allocates 8 + 0x98 x N with operator new and runs the constructor without a clear

name: firstBlock
meaning: the index of the request's first 64 KiB block in the archive's block-size table (../Game-Files-And-Data-Tables/bigfile-archive.md 'Read record': block): the planner 0x0019A770 starts from the entry record's firstBlock ([r14] with r14 = handle +0x18, 0x0019A7AB) and adds one per whole block the request's offset skips (0x0019A7D0-0x0019A7F4, summing the u16 block sizes [archive +0x68] into the file offset), then stores it (0x0019A81F); the fill 0x0019A860 walks the block sizes from it one block at a time (0x0019A8B7, 0x0019A900, 0x0019A931, esi incremented per block) and the finish 0x0019AA20 indexes the per-block compressed flags [archive +0x70] and sizes with it (0x0019AA93, 0x0019AA9A)

name: headDescriptor
meaning: the head block's descriptor - allocated 0x18 in the ctor (0x0019A2EF store); its buffer carries the leading partial block when r != 0; flag/length/offset written by the layout's head arm

name: middleDescriptor
meaning: the middle block's descriptor - allocated 0x18 in the ctor (0x0019A320 store); flagged exactly when R >= 0x10000 (0x0019A739-0x0019A741)

name: tailDescriptor
meaning: the tail block's descriptor - allocated 0x18 in the ctor (0x0019A351 store); flagged with length T=R mod 0x10000 when T is non-zero (0x0019A752/0x0019A759)

name: qword20
meaning: zeroed by the ctor (0x0019A36D) and the reset (0x0019B157); the planner 0x0019A770 stores the handle's window here, the qword +0x28 of its fourth argument (0x0019A81B, 0x0019A830); the finish 0x0019AA20 reads it (0x0019AA9F, 0x0019AAB8, 0x0019AB2D, 0x0019AB3D, 0x0019AB49)

name: qword28
meaning: zeroed by the ctor (0x0019A371) and the reset (0x0019B15B); the planner 0x0019A770 stores its second argument, the caller's buffer, here after the claim: it saves rdx in its home slot at entry (0x0019A77F), reloads it into rcx (0x0019A80A) and stores it (0x0019A817); the finish 0x0019AA20 reads it (0x0019AB34, 0x0019AB82)

name: dword30
meaning: zero-initialised flag gating the reset's sized delete of +0x38: the delete runs only when this dword is non-zero (0x0019B15F-0x0019B16B); zeroed again by the reset (0x0019B170)

name: pad34
meaning: alignment after the owned flag +0x30: read and written by no instruction in the 25 slow-reader bodies 0x0019A2A0-0x0019B400 (read whole: no memory operand with this displacement on any base, no memset or block copy over the record); indeterminate until a write: 0x0019B200 allocates 8 + 0x98 x N with operator new and runs the constructor without a clear

name: ptr38
meaning: a pointer to an 8-byte allocation: the reset sized-deletes it (edx=8, 0x00809950) when +0x30 is non-zero; its writer is outside the pinned bodies

name: useCount
meaning: the record's use count: +1 per successful claim (0x0019A6C6), -1 per cleanup under the critical section (0x0019A9D4); the reset runs only when it reaches 0; a 0 count underflows to 0xFFFFFFFF unguarded

name: pad44
meaning: alignment after useCount +0x40: read and written by no instruction in the 25 slow-reader bodies 0x0019A2A0-0x0019B400 (read whole: no memory operand with this displacement on any base, no memset or block copy over the record); indeterminate until a write: 0x0019B200 allocates 8 + 0x98 x N with operator new and runs the constructor without a clear

name: fileOffset
meaning: The archive file offset of the first block read: the planner 0x0019A770 starts from the entry record's offset +0x10 (0x0019A7AE) and, for each of the position >> 16 whole blocks the request skips, adds that block's u16 size from the archive's table +0x68, a size of 0 counting as 0x10000 (0x0019A7BB-0x0019A7F4), then stores the sum (0x0019A83C); the fill 0x0019A860 loads it for its _fseeki64 from the start of the file (0x0019A89E).

name: emittedOffset
meaning: Running bytes-emitted cursor: the planner 0x0019A770 starts it at the request position less its low 16 bits, the bytes in the whole blocks skipped (0x0019A80F, 0x0019A827); the finish reads it (0x0019AB41) and accumulates into it with two qword adds (0x0019AB5D add [rdi+0x50],rax; 0x0019AB8E add [rdi+0x50],rcx). Measured width 8: the adds are 64-bit; the finish's movups copies starting at +0x50 (0x0019AAF6 etc.) are window-copy units covering +0x50..+0x60, not this field's access width.

name: requestedCount
meaning: the requested byte count N: stored by the planner (0x0019A840) and the phase-5 predicate compares the finish tally against it (cmp r14d,[rdi+0x58] at 0x0019ADD1)

name: pad5C
meaning: alignment after requestedCount +0x58: read and written by no instruction in the 25 slow-reader bodies 0x0019A2A0-0x0019B400 (read whole: no memory operand with this displacement on any base, no memset or block copy over the record) - the movups at +0x50 and +0x60 in the finish (0x0019AAF6-0x0019AB02 and the three loops like it at 0x0019AC16, 0x0019ACCE, 0x0019AD6E) belong to its 0x80-byte buffer copy loop, whose source is a descriptor's buffer ([rdx+8], 0x0019AABF) and whose destination the window ([[record+0x20]], 0x0019AAB8-0x0019AABC), not to the record; indeterminate until a write: 0x0019B200 allocates 8 + 0x98 x N with operator new and runs the constructor without a clear

name: entryRecord
meaning: the bigfile entry record the request reads from (the reader handle's +0x18; ../Game-Files-And-Data-Tables/bigfile-archive.md 'Entry record'): the planner copies it in (0x0019A834, r14 = [r9+0x18] from 0x0019A791) after reading its firstBlock (0x0019A7AB) and offset (0x0019A7AE); read back by no body - the finish's movups at +0x60 are its buffer copy loop (see pad5C), not the record; indeterminate until a write: 0x0019B200 allocates 8 + 0x98 x N with operator new and runs the constructor without a clear

name: ptr68
meaning: The archive object, the planner 0x0019A770's sixth argument, stored at 0x0019A838; for a position of 0x10000 or more the planner first reads the block-size table +0x68 from it (0x0019A7BB); read by the fill (mov rax,[rdx+0x68] at 0x0019A873) and the finish (0x0019AA51), which take the same block-size table from its +0x68 (mov r14,[rax+0x68] at 0x0019A891; 0x0019AA55). Also inside the finish's 16-byte copy window, but the scalar reads are field-local. Measured width 8.

name: stream
meaning: The archive stream (`FILE*`) the fill _fseeki64's and freads: stored by the planner (0x0019A848) and used by every fill I/O call.

name: pad78
meaning: between stream +0x70 and phase +0x88: read and written by no instruction in the 25 slow-reader bodies 0x0019A2A0-0x0019B400 (read whole: no memory operand with this displacement on any base, no memset or block copy over the record) (0x0019AE83's [rcx+0x78] is the manager's own +0x78 and 0x0019B41C / 0x0019B455 are 0x0019B400's object); indeterminate until a write: 0x0019B200 allocates 8 + 0x98 x N with operator new and runs the constructor without a clear

name: phase
meaning: the record's phase word: 0 written at claim (0x0019A700), 1 before the fill's I/O (0x0019A887), 2 after (0x0019A98D), 3 at finish entry (0x0019AA47), 5 on T==N and S==0 (0x0019ADD1-0x0019ADDC), 6 in the diagnostic arm (0x0019AE3A); tested by the slow reader (0x0019B033) to pick C-or-0

name: pad8C
meaning: alignment after phase +0x88: read and written by no instruction in the 25 slow-reader bodies 0x0019A2A0-0x0019B400 (read whole: no memory operand with this displacement on any base, no memset or block copy over the record); indeterminate until a write: 0x0019B200 allocates 8 + 0x98 x N with operator new and runs the constructor without a clear

name: claimed
meaning: The claim flag: 0->1 under lock cmpxchg (0x0019A69F), cleared at the last release (0x0019A9E5); zeroed by the ctor wrapper (0x0019A3C1) - and deliberately not cleared by the reset, which leaves it to the cleanup.

name: pad94
meaning: alignment after claimed +0x90, to the 0x98 stride: read and written by no instruction in the 25 slow-reader bodies 0x0019A2A0-0x0019B400 (read whole: no memory operand with this displacement on any base, no memset or block copy over the record); indeterminate until a write: 0x0019B200 allocates 8 + 0x98 x N with operator new and runs the constructor without a clear

name: semaphore
meaning: The record-pool semaphore: CreateSemaphoreW(NULL,N,N,NULL) stored here (0x0019B2C9-0x0019B2DA); the claim waits on it with `INFINITE` (0x0019A670), the cleanup releases one slot (0x0019A9F7); an old non-null handle is closed on rebuild.

name: recordCount
meaning: the record count N, stored before the array is built (0x0019B219) and read by the claim's scan bound (cmp dword [M+0x10],edx at 0x0019A680). N=30 at the only call site

name: pad0C
meaning: alignment between the record count and the array pointer: read and written by no instruction in the 25 slow-reader bodies 0x0019A2A0-0x0019B400 (the builder 0x0019B200 stores the bank's +0x00, +0x08 and +0x10 - 0x0019B2C9-0x0019B2DA, 0x0019B219, 0x0019B2B0 - and the claim reads +0x08 and +0x10, 0x0019A680 / 0x0019A696); the manager builder 0x0019AE70 zeroes the manager's +0x00, +0x20..+0x40, +0x70 and +0x78 but not this dword (manager +0x14), so it holds what the manager's allocation left

name: records
meaning: the record array's element base (allocation+8, past the dword count prefix) or 0 on allocation failure; stored at 0x0019B2B0; the claim walks it stride 0x98 (imul r9,rax,0x98 at 0x0019A696)

name: arcDeg
meaning: candidate heading arc width in degrees; default 180 (0x0023A550)

name: mode
meaning: the candidate's mode byte (the contract's 'byte +0x00 selects the mode'): 0 for tables older than version 0x33; 0x00234AF0 takes its own branch when it is 0; 0x002374E0 branches on 1 and 2

name: unobservedSpan001
meaning: Bytes no instruction addresses on their own; they travel with the entry when it is copied. The record lives on its callers' stack, and 0x003DFD00 zeroes all 0x30 bytes (six qwords) on entry, so they hold 0.

name: regionWidth
meaning: the placement region's width w (../Enemy-Spawning/enemy-spawning.md): 0x002374E0(point, rec) halves it (0x0023750D, x 0.5 at 0x01CEBB70) and accepts a type-1 record while abs(x) <= w/2 (0x002375D5-0x002375F1) and a type-2 record while x^2/(w/2)^2 + z^2/(d/2)^2 <= 1 (0x00237563-0x00237598), x being the candidate point in the record's frame (0x00325EA0 with centre +0x10 and heading +0x1C); filled from the field-data table entry by 0x003DFD00

name: regionDepth
meaning: the placement region's depth d (../Enemy-Spawning/enemy-spawning.md): 0x002374E0 halves it (0x00237515) and tests the candidate's z against d/2 (type 1: 0x002375F3-0x00237607; type 2: 0x00237579 / 0x00237581 in the ellipse test)

name: unobservedSpan00C
meaning: Bytes no instruction addresses on their own; they travel with the entry when it is copied. The record lives on its callers' stack, and 0x003DFD00 zeroes all 0x30 bytes (six qwords) on entry, so they hold 0.

name: position
meaning: the authored position x, y, z (the contract's '+0x10 carries the authored position'): 0x00234AF0 copies it to its output; 0x002374E0 reads it in the mode-2 arm

name: heading
meaning: the region's heading (../Enemy-Spawning/enemy-spawning.md: 'heading +0x1C'): 0x002374E0 passes it as the rotation (xmm3) with the centre +0x10 to 0x00325EA0, which transforms the candidate point into the record's frame for both the box and the ellipse tests (0x0023753D / 0x002375AF, calls 0x0023755E / 0x002375D0); written by the table copy 0x003DFD00 (0x003DFD96 / 0x003DFD58)

name: unobservedSpan020
meaning: Copied from the table entry for table versions 0x33 and above (0x003DFD5D, 0x003DFD63) and 0 otherwise; no instruction reads them on their own. The record lives on its callers' stack, and 0x003DFD00 zeroes all 0x30 bytes (six qwords) on entry.

name: counters
meaning: 64 word counters; the row the toggle selects is reset to 1 each (0x002339DA mov eax,1; 0x002339E2 rep stosw, ecx 0x40)

name: autoSpawnMinPlayerDistance
meaning: the automatic spawn's minimum player distance (39.0 by default): verb 300B's third float; read by the automatic entry selection 0x00235720

name: autoSpawnMaxPlayerDistance
meaning: the automatic spawn's maximum player distance (42.0 by default): verb 300B's second float; read by 0x00235720

name: nativeLifecycleRange
meaning: The range outside which a native-lifecycle spawn is retired (43.0 by default; compared squared): verb 300B's first float; read by the native-range retire check 0x002350C0.

name: lastFieldId
meaning: the field the last area transition entered (0x003148F0's current field id at that transition); -1 after the reset

name: fieldTwoAgoId
meaning: the field from two transitions ago: the rotation keeps the spawn banks when the field being entered equals it and the window has not elapsed; then it takes the old +0x00

name: transitionStamp
meaning: the game clock (0x0032A150, raw tick counter) at the last area transition; the window test subtracts it (unsigned); never restored by a load, 0 after the reset

name: member_mask
meaning: one bit per member the group waits for. Written per member by 0x00306E60: set when script verb 0x3030 btlAtelSetEventFlagGroup registers the unit (via 0x00239710), cleared when range retirement (0x002350C0) removes it; zeroed by the reset. A zero mask completes on the first death, but the only writer of the unit's group id registers it in the same call

name: dead_mask
meaning: one bit per member confirmed dead; set idempotently by a death, cleared for that member whenever it is registered or unregistered, zeroed by the reset

name: flags
meaning: bit 0x1 = completion signal pending: set on the mode-1 arm at once, or by 0x00307110 after the death reaction is handled; consumed once per field frame by 0x00307030, which clears it and posts the group number to u16 slot 3 of the table at *(0x02098E68); cleared by the reset with and 0xFE

name: padding
meaning: Padding to the 0x18 stride after the flags byte +0x10. No recorded access of the table (10 functions, whose +0x10 accesses are the flags byte) reaches here, and no rip-relative reference falls inside 0x02EC13D1 + 24 * g for the 64 entries. The table is in .bss, zero at load, and its writers touch the two masks and the flags byte only, so these bytes stay zero.

name: previousFieldId
meaning: the field id this image was captured from

name: mostRecentFieldId
meaning: the most recent field id

name: headerPad04
meaning: The header's last 12 bytes, always 0 in the save data. The writer 0x00233440 clears the whole image first (memset 0x20010 at 0x00233451), copies the two banks from +0x10 and +0x10010 and stores only the two field ids at +0x00 and +0x02 (0x00233529-0x0023353A). The restorer 0x00233550 reads +0x00, +0x02 and the second bank only. The save buffer's clear (0x002EF5F0, memset 0x56690 at 0x02164280) and its copies (0x002EF740) move these bytes with the payload. The recorded accesses at +0x4 are the 0x02099FF0 bank copy 0x00269A20 and those payload copies, not header fields.

name: bank2
meaning: the second spawn-keep bank; the page places it at image +0x10

name: bank1
meaning: The first spawn-keep bank, at image +0x10010 as the page places it. The 0x10-byte header and the two 0x10000-byte banks add up to 0x20010, the image's own size.

name: keepWindowSeconds
meaning: how long, in seconds, a field's spawn-keep bank survives a round trip: the area transition keeps the banks when it returns to the field from two transitions ago within this many seconds (ticks per second = frame-rate base 0x01DFE0B8 x 30.0); verb 0x306C btlAtelSetMapJumoKeep sets it, a negative value restoring 300; 300 at battle-storage init; read by the getter 0x00235330

name: lifecycleFlags
meaning: The entry's lifecycle flags word (field map section 2.3). Bits 0x1, 0x4 and 0x80 are the only bits any instruction touches: two sites clear bits with and masks (the transient-state reset 0x00236860 clears with 0xFFFFFF7A at 0x002368AA) and three test bits (the previous-entry selector 0x002354F0 tests bit 0x4 at 0x0023555C).

name: pad04
meaning: Alignment between the flags +0x00 and deathCount +0x08. No instruction addresses these bytes on their own among the recorded accesses of the records (94 functions, through the lane map, the slot and the bank). Only whole-record copies move them: the bank loops 0x00233780, 0x00233440 and 0x00233550 (128-byte movups pairs) and the history copy 0x00235360 (0x00235460-0x002354DD). They are zero from the pool memset (0x9400 = 64 x 0x250, allocated at 0x00236957 and cleared at 0x0023696E; the spawn record fields page).

name: death_count
meaning: How many times this entry has died; read only by the script death-count query 0x0050F660, through 0x00235F50.

name: wDeathLimit
meaning: The death limit: the authored base plus a random range, row.b_00 + rand % (row.b_01 + 1), or 0 when the base is 0 (0x002395FC..623). The death-limit getter 0x00235EF0 reads it (0x00235F3A).

name: last_death_second
meaning: A second-stamp, not a tick-stamp: the reader divides the frame counter by the frame rate before subtracting this.

name: respawn_cooldown
meaning: The cooldown. Native code does not fix its unit: nothing native compares it against the elapsed seconds, so the unit is a script-side convention.

name: spawnHistoryCounterCopy
meaning: A copy of the spawn-history counter: the row's byte +2 before its increment at a fresh spawn (field map), written as a single byte from bl.

name: pad13
meaning: Alignment byte between historyCounter +0x12 and the byte +0x14. No instruction addresses it on its own among the recorded accesses of the records (94 functions, through the lane map, the slot and the bank). Only whole-record copies move it: the bank loops 0x00233780, 0x00233440 and 0x00233550 (128-byte movups pairs) and the history copy 0x00235360 (0x00235460-0x002354DD). It is zero from the pool memset (0x9400 = 64 x 0x250, allocated at 0x00236957 and cleared at 0x0023696E; the spawn record fields page).

name: bStealAvailabilityFlags
meaning: Steal-slot availability bits 0x1, 0x2 and 0x4, set at a fresh spawn from the row words +0x32, +0x34 and +0x36 and cleared one slot at a time by ApplyTargetResult and ApplyResultMetadata (and 0xFB, 0xFD, 0xFE).

name: pad15
meaning: Alignment byte between the byte +0x14 and the byte +0x16. No instruction addresses it on its own among the recorded accesses of the records (94 functions, through the lane map, the slot and the bank). Only whole-record copies move it: the bank loops 0x00233780, 0x00233440 and 0x00233550 (128-byte movups pairs) and the history copy 0x00235360 (0x00235460-0x002354DD). It is zero from the pool memset (0x9400 = 64 x 0x250, allocated at 0x00236957 and cleared at 0x0023696E; the spawn record fields page).

name: bScriptSelection
meaning: The script's selection index, 0xFF for no selection; bits 0x1 and 0x4 of the flags clear when it changes. GetScriptSelection reads it (0x0023618A). It belongs to the selection state reset at teardown: 0x0023708B mov word ptr [rcx + 0x16], 0xff writes 0xFF here and 0 into the byte +0x017 in one word store.

name: bPersistenceKey
meaning: The active persistence key. SelectContinuousEntry matches history-bank entries on it and copies the committed, pending or released entry over this one; the fresh path restores it from +0x18. Teardown zeroes it as the high half of the word store at 0x0023708B that sets +0x016 to 0xFF.

name: bPersistenceRestoreValue
meaning: The authored key the two resets restore +0x17 from: row.b_06 when the table's byte +1 is set, else 0.

name: bEnmityDecayTimer
meaning: The enmity decay timer, one byte. The periodic enmity decay 0x00321530 reads it, adds 1, and compares against [0x01DFE0B8] * [0x008F8D80]: below the interval it stores t+1, at or above it calls the all-combatant enmity write 0x00321D30(unit, -10, 0) to decay every combatant and stores 0. It is also the enmity table's header: the per-combatant enmity vector begins immediately after it - the highest-enmity search 0x00321630 indexes the same base as table[id + 1].

name: threatByPartyId
meaning: One threat byte per party-definition id 0 to 39, accessed as table[id + 1] from the base +0x19 (table[0] is the decay timer). Reads at 0x0032160D, 0x003216AE, 0x003217CA, 0x00321906, 0x00321A73 and 0x00321C26; a store at 0x00321E7F (through 0x00321E40); fill loops walk a pointer from +0x1A (0x00321975/0x003219A3, 0x00321CA6/0x00321CD9, 0x00321E16). Every walker stops at id 0x28 (0x00321DA3, 0x003217D8, 0x003219AA, 0x00321CE0, 0x00321E1F). Every access is gated by 0x00322C50(2, id), which for class 2 requires 0 <= id < dword [[0x02EBF130] + 4] (0x00322C9A..0x00322CAF, 0x0032302E, 0x00323039), the party definition table's row count: 40 in the shipped battle_pack, row size 128 in all nine language copies. A table with more than 40 rows would let the single-id paths reach past +0x41; the walkers would not. No instruction addresses one threat byte at a fixed displacement. The record-wide 16-byte copy in the continuous-entry selector 0x00235360 (0x0023547E, 0x00235486, 0x0023548E, 0x00235496) and the bank save and restore copies 0x00233440 and 0x00233550 move the bytes whole.

name: copiedSpan0042
meaning: Bytes moved only in bulk: by the 16-byte movups steps of the record-wide copy in the continuous-entry selector 0x00235360 (0x00235492 read, 0x00235496 write, rcx = record + 0x80, a run of 26), by the bank save and restore copies 0x00233440 and 0x00233550, and by the pool memsets at creation (0x0023696E, 0x00236999). No instruction addresses +0x42..+0x4F at a fixed displacement or another width, over the 21 functions that reference 0x0208E690/0x0208E698 and the BattleUnit +0x6A0 consumers. The first two bytes of the +0x40 move are threatByPartyId entries 38 and 39.

name: afPersistedWorldPosition
meaning: The persisted world position, 16 bytes stored whole by PublishLocomotionPosition, ProcessActionTarget and the candidate paths. Three initialisers write it in the same instruction pair as +0x060, from the same source register.

name: ctorZeroedDword40

name: pad44

No instruction reaches it: not one among the recorded accesses of the context, not one in an image-wide walk of every +0xB8 load (three callee levels) or of every steering-cursor +0xF0 load (132 functions; the slots' +0x4C stores 0x00266154 and 0x002661D2 are the nearest), and no block copy covers the context. Zero from the record memset 0x00267A8B.

name: ctorZeroedDword4C
meaning: ctor-zeroed dword - the +0x4C dword store at 0x00266154 (both slots); no reader through +0xF0

name: heading_approach_step
meaning: The per-frame cap on the desired movement heading ctx+0xA4 approaching the bearing to the steer target (0x003A1AD0's third argument at 0x002E46FA); written by the turn-limit setter 0x002E5B60.

name: pitch_approach_step
meaning: The per-frame cap on the desired movement pitch ctx+0xA0 approaching the bearing to the steer target (0x003A1AD0's third argument at 0x002E471D); no setter among the record's recorded accesses.

name: turn_step
meaning: 0x3E20D97C = pi/20 = 9 degrees, written as a constant in modes 2 and 3 (0x0026C224). Two readers use it: as the per-frame cap of the facing approach in movement modes 2 and 3 (0x002E5750 -> 0x003A1AD0, floored at 0x3C0EFA35 = pi/360 = 0.5 degrees when a mode is active, 0x002E5806-0x002E5821), and as the divisor that turns a heading delta into mode 4's frame count (0x002690D0, 0x00269345).

name: turn_limit

name: derived_turn_frames

It plays the role +0x68 turn_frames plays on the mode-4 arm. Also written at 0x002EC3B7 and read at 0x002EC46D: two writes and one read in all.

name: flags
meaning: Bitfield packing two fields plus a direction bit: bits 0x7 = the resume shape the dispatcher and the `POP` replay select on (0 and 1 observed); bits 0x38 = the dispatch mode the steer dispatcher 0x002EC3F0 decodes (shr 3, &7 at 0x002EC416-0x002EC419) - mode 1 -> 0x002E7650 for shapes 0 and 1, 0x002E7720 for shape 2 and 0x002E78D0 for shape 3, mode 2 -> 0x002E79A0 for shapes 0 and 1, 0x002E77F0 for shape 2 and 0x002E7860 for shape 3 (0x002EC438-0x002EC4F1); bit 0x40 = the turn direction, set when wrap(target - current) is negative. name: steer_arm_state

The initiator 0x002EBE50 stores its edx argument as is (0x002EBF76, sil = esi = edx) and reseeds the context mirrors on a fresh arm only while this byte is 0 (0x002EBE9C: seed ctx+0xB4 from ctx+0xA8 through 0x00265200). The teardown and reset paths write 0 with the same store that clears the context mirrors: 0x002E6519 (xor ebx, ebx at 0x002E64FF; ctx+0xB4 and ctx+0x224 zeroed at 0x002E6506 and 0x002E650C), 0x002E3043 and 0x002E32BD (r12b, the function's zero register). Values: 0 at teardown, 1 from the mode-4 arm (0x002690D0 calls 0x002EBE50 with edx = 1). Four writes and two reads in all.

name: steerParamByte64
meaning: A byte written by the mode-4 turn arm 0x002690D0 (1, at 0x00269378) and by 0x0026C070 (dl), and read with movzx at 0x00265528.

name: teardown_gate
meaning: non-zero makes mode 0 run the 0x002EBE50 / 0x002E8EE0 teardown before the transition call

name: steerParamWord66
meaning: A word written by the mode-4 turn arm 0x002690D0 (dx, at 0x0026939F) and by 0x0026C330 (cx), and read with movzx at 0x0026554B.

name: turn_frames
meaning: the total frame count of a mode-4 (timed) turn: (i16)((target_heading - heading) / turn_step) from the untimed turn body 0x002690D0 (0x00269338-0x00269351), or [0x01DFE0B4] + frames / [0x01DFE0BC] from the timed turn setter 0x0026C330; the integrator 0x002E5750 divides +0x78 by it (0x00265660 at 0x002E5885); the setter's mode 4 completes when it is <= the FrameLimit time base 0x01DFE0B4 (0x0026C1AE), so that one-shot ends a frame earlier at one frame-rate setting. Was frame_countdown

name: steer_dispatch_flags
meaning: The flag byte the steer dispatcher 0x002EC3F0 consumes. Bit 0x1 is a one-shot latch: when it is set and the packed dispatch mode (+0x62, mask 0x38) is 2, the dispatch runs as mode 1 (test byte [+0x6A], 1 at 0x002EC424, cmovne edx, 1 at 0x002EC42F), and the latch is cleared (and 0xFE at 0x002EC433). The kind-3 setter 0x002EC3C0 sets bit 0x1 to (edx != 0) (0x002EC3D1-0x002EC3E6). The constructor clears bits 0x1 and 0x2 with two and-ops (0x0026617B/86, mirrored at 0x00266201/0C), but both pairs go through the cursor [ctx+0xF0], which points at slot 0 at that moment (0x002660F4, +0xDC = 0), so slot 0's byte is cleared and slot 1's keeps what the record held. Bits 0x4 to 0x80 are touched only by that clear. Five writes and one read in all.

name: pad6B
meaning: Alignment byte between steer_dispatch_flags +0x6A and initiator_turn_step +0x6C in both slots (ctx +0x18B and +0x20B). No instruction reaches it: not one among the recorded accesses of the context, not one in an image-wide walk of every +0xB8 load (three callee levels) or of every steering-cursor +0xF0 load (132 functions; the constructor's qword store at +0x6C, 0x0026615B and 0x002661D9, starts after it), and no block copy covers the context. Zero from the record memset 0x00267A8B.

name: initiator_turn_step

Written by 0x0026AAD0, which two-sided-wraps its float argument and multiplies by the rate global [0x01DFE0BC] before storing (0x0026AB2F/0x0026AB37) - a rate-scaled step, not a bare residual. The writer has six direct call sites, 0x0034EB76, 0x0034F4A6, 0x0034FBF8, 0x00350458, 0x00357BEC and 0x00357D93, and stores only for a class-3 actor (0x0026AAF5-0x0026AAF9). Not the same role as turn_step +0x58, the mode-2/3 cap and mode-4 divisor.

name: steer_target_heading
meaning: The steer channel's target heading, written only through the wrap routine 0x0026A8E0, so always in (-pi, pi]. The mode-4 arm 0x002690D0 passes the active record's target_heading (loaded at 0x00269242, the argument at 0x0026924B); the look-at writers 0x002EC140 and 0x002EC1C0 pass their first argument; the Vec4 path 0x002EC2C0 passes its position-derived heading. The initiator 0x002EBE50 wraps (+0x70 - ctx+0xB4) through 0x003A1C50, where ctx+0xB4 is seeded from the actor's current heading ctx+0xA8 by the getter 0x00265200; that residual gives derived_turn_frames (+0x60). It then copies +0x70 to ctx+0xB4 (0x002EBF01). One write and two reads in all.

name: steer_target_pitch
meaning: The second steer channel's target angle, armed through the wrap routine 0x0026A870 with the second argument of the look-at writers 0x002EC140 and 0x002EC1C0. The mode-4 (pure-heading) arm zeroes it together with its context mirror ctx+0x224 (0x00269275, 0x00269289), and so does the ground-position Vec4 path. The initiator 0x002EBE50 wraps (+0x74 - ctx+0x224) and copies +0x74 to ctx+0x224 (0x002EBF0A); the mirror starts at 0 (level) on a fresh arm. It is read as pitch from the pair convention: the bearing produces yaw and pitch, and the approach-step pair is +0x50 heading and +0x54 pitch. The +0x74 residual is computed and discarded on the initiator path, so no consumer narrows the channel further. Two writes and two reads in all.

name: turn_frame_index
meaning: the elapsed-frame counter of a mode-4 turn, stored as a float: seeded with (float)[0x01DFE0B4] by 0x002690D0 (0x00269367) and 0x0026C330 (0x0026C389), advanced by 0x0026C300 (0x0026C31F) each frame from 0x002E5750 (0x002E5931), read back as an int by 0x00265630 (0x0026564B) for t = +0x78 / +0x68

name: steer_speed_request

The last field, ending exactly at 0x80.

name: state
meaning: The stale flag: 1 makes 0x004742A0 rebuild the camera rows. 0x004745B0 sets it at reset (0x004745B0); 0x004742A0 sets it when 0x002DDCF0 answers non-zero (0x00474343), when the stick yaw is more than 0.3927 from the cached yaw +8 (0x0047436B-0x00474388) and when the stick vector is shorter than 0.01 (0x0047457D), tests it (0x0047435A) and clears it after the rebuild (0x00474435).

name: param04
meaning: 0x12 at init (0x004745B6)

name: float08
meaning: The cached stick yaw: atan2 of the stick vector's two lanes (0x00474355), stored when the rows are rebuilt (0x00474430); a stick yaw more than 0.3927 away from it marks the basis stale (0x0047436B-0x00474388).

name: float0C
meaning: The smoothed output bearing: each call takes the bearing of the camera-space output (atan2, 0x004744EC), wraps its difference from this value into -pi..pi, clamps it to +-0.25 and adds it (0x004744FC-0x00474568); the negated result is the output's +0xC (0x0047456D-0x00474574). 0 at reset (0x004745BD).

name: basis
meaning: The two camera rows, f32[4] each: row 0 at +0x10 and row 1 at +0x20. While the basis is stale 0x004742A0 copies the two 16-byte rows of 0x02AEDF30 that the indices at 0x00D22690 select, zeroes lane 1 (0x004743F6) and passes each to 0x00380800 (0x004743A1-0x0047440E); the output is x = row0[0] v0 - row1[0] v1 and z = row0[2] v0 - row1[2] v1 (0x00474437-0x0047447B), normalised and scaled by the speed (0x0047449D-0x004744E5).

name: vec
meaning: 0x004742A0 output: +0x0 / +0x4 from the basis, +0xC = 1.0. At 0x022C7FD0 the address is taken once, with 2 dword reads and one 16-byte write, in 0x00358C60 and 0x00358CB0.

name: begin
meaning: base of the byte stream; written by 0x008666B0 (0x00866965) and, through the vector address it passes them, by the reserve 0x00866150 (0x008661DD) and the append 0x00865720 (0x0086581A); read by 0x00866200, 0x00866A00, 0x00866A80, 0x00866AD0

name: end

name: capacity

name: lastResult
meaning: the last wrapper result. The open 0x008624D0 stores 0, or -4 (mode 1) / -3 (other modes) when 0x008666B0 returns no cursor; the close 0x008620E0 stores 0 or -3 (0x00866200 non-zero), and -4 without touching the cursor when its argument is non-zero or the cursor is null; the read 0x00862590 and the 0x00862620 call store the inner result times r8d, or -4 when their first argument is non-zero; the seek 0x008625D0 always stores 0; 0x008620D0 and 0x00862490 store 0; 0x008621E0 stores its own return value. The getter 0x00862600 copies it to [r8] when r8 is non-null

name: unobservedSpan0004

The block lies in the zero-filled tail of .data past the raw end at 0x01F7E400, so they stay zero.

name: cursor
meaning: the open cursor object: set by the open 0x008624D0 to 0x008666B0's result (after closing and nulling any previous one through 0x00866200); handed to the inner read 0x00866A00 (0x00862590), the seek 0x00866A80 (0x008625D0), 0x00866AD0 (0x00862620) and the close 0x00866200 (0x008620E0, which nulls it after the call)

name: terminatorConstant
meaning: = 2 in the image; 0x00677030: alloc(len + pad), then memset(buf + len, 0, pad)

name: buffer
meaning: the D3D11 buffer: CreateBuffer's out-pointer

name: shaderResourceView
meaning: the shader-resource view on the buffer

name: unorderedAccessView
meaning: the unordered-access view

name: releasedObject18
meaning: An object released like the views: the release pass 0x0062BB40 calls its vtable slot +0x10 (the IUnknown Release position) and nulls it (0x0062BC58 / 0x0062BC69).

name: pendingCount
meaning: A count the release waits on: the drain 0x0062B090 reads it through 0x00623DB0 and calls Sleep(1) while it is above 0 (a signed test, jle).

name: unobservedSpan0024
meaning: Four bytes the allocator 0x0061CF20 does not write and the release path does not read. The element sits inside its owner or in the array its resize allocates, and neither path clears them, so they hold whatever the storage held.

name: rec0Byte0
meaning: Entry 0's summon effect, 1-based: 0x003B4B60 stores the actor's effect byte +0xCD (0x003B4C3D-0x003B4C44); 0x003B5340 returns the winning entry's (0x003B53A8); 0 from the reset 0x003B53C0 (0x003B53DA).

name: rec0Byte1

name: rec0Flags

name: rec0Pad3

No instruction of the recorded functions references it.

name: rec0Word4
meaning: Entry 0's actor index, -1 for no actor: 0x003B4B60 stores it (0x003B4C37); 0x003B5340 answers 0 when the winner's is -1 (0x003B539F-0x003B53A6); -1 from the reset (0x003B53D0).

name: rec1Byte0
meaning: Entry 1's summon effect, 1-based: 0x003B4B60 stores the actor's effect byte (0x003B4D10); 0x003B5340 returns it when entry 1 wins (0x003B53A8); 0 from the reset (0x003B53F7).

name: rec1Byte1
meaning: Entry 1's priority: 0x003B4B60 stores its second argument (0x003B4D16); entry 1 wins when entry 0's priority is below this (0x003B538C-0x003B5392); 0 from the reset (0x003B53F7, a word store with +0x08).

name: rec1Flags
meaning: Entry 1's state: 1 active, set by 0x003B4B60 (0x003B4D1D); 2 ended, set by 0x003B4B60 (0x003B4CC3) and 0x003B4E50 (0x003B4F5F); 0x003B5340 considers the entry only at 1 (0x003B5377); 0 from the reset (0x003B5400).

name: rec1Pad3
meaning: Gap byte, zero at load: 0x02B40508 lies past .data's raw end 0x01F7E400 (.bss, zeroed by the loader), and the reset 0x003B53C4..0x003B5400 writes field by field +0x00..+0x02, +0x04..+0x0A and +0x0C..+0x10 and skips this byte, so the loader's zero stays. No instruction of the recorded functions references it.

name: rec1Word4
meaning: Entry 1's actor index, -1 for no actor: 0x003B4B60 stores it (0x003B4D03); 0x003B5340 answers 0 when the winner's is -1 (0x003B539F-0x003B53A6); -1 from the reset (0x003B53ED); its low 16 bits are read as the actor index (0x003B4DDE, 0x003B4F0D, 0x003B5057, 0x003B523E, 0x003B5590).

meaning: The suppress bits: with bit 0x1 or bit 0x2 set, 0x003B5340 answers 0, no effect (0x003B5340-0x003B5352); 0x003B53C0 clears both (0x003B53C4) before it queues the read.

name: currentRate

name: stepPerFrame

name: permissionMask

name: permissionMaskHigh

name: fade

name: flag

name: unobserved15
meaning: Gap bytes no instruction addresses. Zero from the enclosing SystemStopRegistry, which is in .bss and zeroed by the loader.

name: records
meaning: Two banks of 28: [0..27] at 0x01FD4160 (contract 'record A') and [28..55] at 0x01FD4400 ('record B'). The apply ANDs A's mask into B's per slot.

name: combined
meaning: The combined masks and fade the last apply computed.

name: dirty

meaning: Gap bytes that no instruction in the registry's functions addresses at a constant address. Zero at load: the storage is in the .data tail past the raw end 0x01F7E400, which the loader fills with zeros.

name: activeRequestBits
meaning: The active-request bitset: or'd by start, and'd by stop, tested by the per-subsystem queries; the apply reads it zero times (SS-1).

name: talkRequested
meaning: 1 while a talk has been asked for and the talk filer has still to file it: 0x0026BC60(1) sets it (0x0026BC62) from the input arbiter 0x00253C70 on the confirm press (0x0025415A) and from the debug verb debug_talkrequire (0x0050DF60); 0x0025AAD0 sets it (0x0025AB15) when it registers a talk candidate; the talk filer 0x00268D10 clears it once it files the talk (0x00268E41), and 0x0025D650 clears it (0x0025D674); 0 at boot (0x002670DD). name: proc

name: parent
meaning: the owning widget. 0x00247930 loads [self+0x10] and ORs bit 0x2000 into the pointee's +0x40, the Widget flags field, so the pointee is a Widget. name: firstChild

name: nextSibling
meaning: The next child of the same parent. The broadcast walk reads it from the child after the recursive call returns, not before (0x002473D8, after the call at 0x002473D3), so a handler that re-links siblings while the broadcast runs is followed by that same broadcast. The release walk 0x002482E0 reads it before the recursion (0x002482F7, then the call at 0x002482FB), so it cannot do this; the two walks differ in the position of this one load.

name: childCount

name: field38

name: flags

That lets a widget be embedded in another object rather than pooled or heap-allocated; ManagerSub0209BE80_57E0 is one. Bits 0x1 and 0x20 together divert 0x00244F00 to 0x00244DD0 before it sends any message (0x00244F14 and eax, 0x21 / cmp al, 0x21).

name: field44

name: table

BattleMenuChildWidget1620's handler calls the setter at 0x0027AEE3 with lea rdx, [rip + 0x69aba0] = 0x00915A80, so that widget's +0x48 is 0x00915A80. The most-passed tables are 0x00D22FE0 (10 sites), 0x00916490 (7) and 0x00D23030 (5). name: tail5C
meaning: The tail that rounds the node to its 8-byte alignment after objectHandle +0x58 (the loot pickups page: read and written by none of the five pool functions). No recorded access of the ten nodes reaches here, and no rip-relative reference reaches 0x02EC0FFC + 0x60 x i. Zero at load (.bss).

name: presenceFlag
meaning: The slot's presence flag, one byte at the start of each 0x20-byte record of the ten-slot pickup pool at 0x022BE7F0 (one record per WorldLootPickupNode). The pool's initialiser tail-jumps 0x002FB250, which clears the flag of all ten slots at 0x022BE7F0 + 0x20 x i. The 0x20 stride is what makes the flag the first byte of a 32-byte record.

name: pad01
meaning: The bytes between the presence flag +0x00 and the position +0x10 (the pad of ../Rewards-EXP-Gil-And-Loot/loot-pickups.md's LootPresenceRecord). 0x002FB250 and 0x002FB2A0 write byte 0 only. 0x002FB2D0 writes byte 0 and the sixteen bytes at +0x10, and 0x002FB310 reads those back. The proximity query 0x002FB150 (from 0x00310DB0 at 0x00311105, the step before the granting retirement 0x00319A00 at 0x00311141) tests byte 0 (0x002FB1E0) and hands +0x10 to 0x004686D0, which reads +0x10 and +0x18 only. Those five functions are every rip-relative access to 0x022BE7F0..0x022BE92F, with not one at 0x022BE7F1 + 0x20 x i, so these bytes keep the load value 0 (.data past its raw end 0x01F7E400, zeroed by the loader).

name: position
meaning: The pickup object's world position, stored when the pickup materialises. 0x002FB2D0 writes it as one 16-byte movdqa from a caller vector (0x002FB2EF-0x002FB2F2), and 0x002FB310 reads the same 16 bytes back (0x002FB327-0x002FB331). The caller 0x00319600 (0x00319739-0x00319775) fetches the position through 0x0028EFC0 from the node's object handle at +0x58, on the same transition that stamps the node with the tick counter 0x0208D45C (advanced by 0x0032A100) and sets its state to 2 (0x00319754, 0x00319757). Sixteen bytes move, and every consumer reads X, Y and Z as separate floats; the fourth lane is described on the page.

name: collected
meaning: pickups collected since the chain last reset it

name: inWorldTick
meaning: 1 while the world tick 0x00314020 runs.

name: deferredModeRequest
meaning: The tick's deferred mode request, -1 = no request (static). Staged by the WorldTransition stagers, consumed once by the tick, which writes -1 back (WT-4).

name: latchedRequest
meaning: The latch half of the deferred mode request pair 0x01EED060 / 0x01EED064 (the frame update order page, -1 for no request): 0x00314410(r) stores r only while the field is negative (0x00314416 cmp / 0x0031441F jge, store 0x0031442B, after 0x0026A5F0(4)), the tick prologue 0x00314020 puts -1 back whenever it is non-negative (0x0031407D-0x00314092) and 0x00314970 resets it (0x00314974); no function reads the stored value, only its sign - the request the prologue runs is 0x01EED064's.
